lte bar lam̐ las sa'i khams la ltung byed ma ser mo g.yas dang po 'khor lo/ snying gar mam̐ las chu'i khams la gsod byed ma nag mo g.yas dang pos rdo rje/ mgrin par pām̐ las me'i khams la 'gugs byed ma dmar mo g.yas dang pos pad+ma/ dpral bar tām̐ las rlung gi khams las pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma sngo bsangs g.yas dang po ral gri/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas 'og ma gri gug g.yon dang pos thod pa dang 'og mas kha ṭ+wām̐ ga 'dzin pa/ gsang gnas su khām̐ las nam mkha'i khams las pad+ma 'bar ba du ba'i mdog can zhal gsum phyag drug ma rtsa zhal dud mdog g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba/ g.yas gsum na gri gug dang*/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gsum na thod pa dang kha ṭ+wām̐ ga dang zhags pa 'dzin pa ste/ rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa rnams g.yas brkyangs pas bzhugs shing ral pa'i cod paṇa can spyan gsum pa phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ lha mo rnams gcer bu skra grol ba/ rang rang gi 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor la g.yas brkyangs pas bzhugs par bsam/ oṃ pra kṛ te shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥpra kṛ ta pa ri pa ri shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod de nga rgyal gzung ngo*// gsum pa srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa ni/ g.yon pa'i mthe bong dang mdzum mo brdab pa'i se gol bya zhing*/ snying ga'i hūm̐ las sngags kyi tshogs phyogs bzhir 'phros par bsams la/ shar du/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha kā yi kaṃ hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa kha dog nag po dang*/ byang du/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa bā tsi kaṃ hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa ljang gu/ nub tu/ gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya tsi tā si hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa dmar po/ lhor/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra dzñā ni kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa ser po rnams tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas gser gyi sa gzhi la thug gi bar khyab pa'i yi ge'i gzugs rnams kha phyir phyogs nas 'khod par bsam/ de nas rang gi 'og tu raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de dang sngags kyi 'od zer las byung ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba gru bzhi pa dang*/

rdo rje dang hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyi steng du rdo rje'i gur dang rwa ba dang*/ rdo rje gur gyi mtshams su rdo rje'i bla bre dang*/ de'i steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa ljang gu'i mda'i drwa ba rnams su gyur par bsam mo// de nas shar du suṃ bha ni sogs las khwa gdong ma nag mo/ byang du gṛh+ṇa sogs las 'ug gdong ma ljang gu/ nub tu gṛh+ṇā pa ya sogs las khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lhor ā na ya sogs las phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor oṃ las gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu hūm̐ las gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du hūm̐ las gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du phaṭa las gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas rdo rje'i tho ba 'dzin cing g.yon rang dang 'dra ba'i lha mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ lte ba man chad phur bu'i rnam pa can 'dzin pa khro zhing rngam pa'i tshul can rnams la/ oṃ sarba bi gh+nān ā na ya dza/ zhes brjod pas lha mo de rnams phyogs bcur song bas phyogs bcu'i 'gegs kyi tshogs thams cad rdo rje rwa ba'i phyi rol du bkug pas/ bgegs thams cad hūm̐ du gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las dbang po la sogs pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad du gyur/ de nas sgo mtshams ma rnams kyis hūm̐ gi sgra drag la ring ba bsgrags pas rang rang gi mdun du me'i dong chen po grub ste/ de rnams su bcug nas/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭān phaṭa/ kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha ro a dzñā pa ya ti sarba bi gh+nān kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum brjod cing spyi bo dang mgrin pa dang snying ga rnams su g.yon gyi phyag mtshan phur bus gdab cing*/ oṃ badz+ra mut+ga ra badz+ra kī la ya a ko ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/

zhes lan gsum brjod pas g.yas kyi phyag mtshan rdo rje tho bas brdungs pas rnam par rtog pa dang bcas pa'i srog bral nas gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi bde ba thob par bya ste/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad rdo rje'i rwa ba la thim pas chu la chu thim pa'i zer ma phyir 'phros pa ltar thig le gzhan du 'phros pa las phyi nas rim pa bzhin me dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ pad+ma 'khor lo rnams kyi rwa ba zlum pos bar mtshams med par bskor zhing 'og gi hūm̐ zhu ba las rdo rje phra mo dpag tu med pas gtams pa'i sa gzhir gyur pas bdag dang 'gro ba thams cad bgegs dang bral bar bsam mo// gnyis pa la gnyis/ rgyu tshogs gnyis bsag pa dang*/ 'bras bu rten dang brten pa bskyed pa'o// dang po la gnyis kyi/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag pa ni/ rang nyid srung 'khor gyi dbus na gnas pa'i snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer sna tshogs phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'og min nas bla ma dang gnyis su med dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par bsam ste/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod pas maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su bzhugs par bsam/ de nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pa lan gsum gyis bsang gtor dang*/ de nas oṃ pra ba ra sat+kā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas zhabs bsil dang*/ oṃ pra ba ra sat+kā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon phul nas/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po dang*/ nye snying gis maṇ+ḍal du me tog phul/ de nas oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dī pe hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra nai wi d+ye hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra shab+da hūm̐/ zhes pas nyer spyod rnams 'bul te phyi'i mchod pa'o// de nas snying ga nas dbyangs yig bcu drug las skyes pa'i rig ma bcu drug dpag tu med pa spros nas dkyil 'khor pa rnams la mchod par bsam zhing*/

oṃ badz+ra wī ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra waṃ se hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mṛ daṃ ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra murdza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ha s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gī tī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dī pe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rū pa badz+ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ra sa badz+ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ spar+ṣe badz+ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod nas mthar snying gar bsdus te yid las byung ba'i mchod pa'o// de nas g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis/ nang mchod gtor zhing rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags brjod pa ni nang gi mchod pa'o// de nas rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// 'gro don rab tu sgrub pa po// yid bzhin nor bu 'dir phyung ba// dpal sdom khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sna tshogs ye shes chen po g.yo// thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs// thugs rje khro ba drag chen po// dpal sdom khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod la/ don yid la dran bzhin du/ bgyis dang bgyid stsal rjes su yi rangs la sogs sdig pa ma lus pa ni skyon rnams ma lus nges par bcom pa yi// mdun du so sor bshag bya slar la yang ni mi byed pa yi sdom pa gzung ba nyid du bya// nyan thos dang ni bse ru bla med rgyal ba rgyal ba'i sras kyis bsags pa'i dge ba la// rjes su yi ni rang zhing byang chub yang dag yongs su bsngo bar bdag gis bya// rgyal ba rin chen la sogs gsum la ji snyed skyabs su 'gro bar bya ba thams cad du ni bsgom// byang chub sems ni rnam par gzung ngo bla na med pa'i lam ni de bzhin bsten// zhes lan gsum brjod pas rgyun bshag byas nas/

oṃ āḥbadz+ra muḥhūm̐/ zhes pas gshegs su gsol zhing maṇ+ḍal bsdu'o// de nas nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang dus nam du yang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang spangs pa'i btang snyoms chen po la gnas par gyur cig ces pas tshad med pa bzhi bsgom mo// gnyis pa ye shes kyi tshogs bsag pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ gnyis pa la gnyis/ rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa dang*/ brten pa lha bskyed pa'o// dang po ni/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sems nyid bar srid kyi ngo bo nā da dmar skya shin tu phra ba'i gzugs kyis langs te/ de las thig le/ de las zla tshes/ de las ha'i mgo bo/ de las khog pa/ de las zhabs kyu ste/ hūm̐ grub nas nam mkhar gnas par bsam zhing*/ de dang dus mnyam du rwa gur la sogs pa srung ba'i 'khor lo rnams kyang yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ de'i nang du yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can/ mtha' gnyis su yaṃ dang bcas pa'i g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bzhin pa'i grwa can raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pa dang bcas pa baṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa grwa bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pa dang ldan zhing lam̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du yi ge suṃ kha dog sna tshogs pa yongs su gyur pa las rin po che'i rang bzhin gyi ri rab/ shar shel/ lho baiḍūr+ya/ nub pad+ma rā ga byang gser las grub pa/ rtse mor lcogs brgyad dang ldan zhing*/ bang rim bzhis mdzes pa suṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/

de thams cad zhu zhing sla ba'i rang bzhin du gyur na ri rab dang 'dres pa las thams cad du zhu ba'i gong bu sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng du chags pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po che'i rang bzhin las grub pa'i ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi phyi nas rim pa bzhin ye shes lnga dag pa'i rang bzhin gyis dkar po dang*/ ser po dang*/ dmar po dang*/ ljang gu dang*/ sngon po'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng na rin po che'i gser gyi pha gu de'i steng du mu tig gi do shal dang do shal phyed pa dang*/ rnga yab dang me tog gi chun 'phyang gis mdzes pa/ steng na bya 'dab las 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i shar bu dang*/ de'i steng na mda' yab pad+ma 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyis spras shing*/ phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la lha mo bcu drug lag na rang rang gi mchod rdzas 'dzin pas/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa 'bul ba sgo bzhi'i steng gi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rin po che'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtse mor/ pad+ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo// g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang ba dan sna tshogs pas mdzes par byas pa/ phyi nang kun tu 'od gsal ba ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa'i phyi rol du dur khrod brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i nang ka ba brgyad dang*/ steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bres pa la/ rin po che'i gnam rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan zhing*/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje dang nor bu rin po che'i spras pa/ 'og gzhi dang steng thog rnams shar sngo/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser ba'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi bcu zhe brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i gdan bsam mo// gnyis pa brten pa bskyed pa la lnga/ lha bskyed pa/ go bgo ba/ ye shes pa gzhug pa/

dbang bskur zhing rgyas gdab pa/ mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba'o// dang po la bzhi'i dang po bsnyen pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo ā li bcu drug g.yas skor dang g.yon skor yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar po me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i ngo bo kā li so bzhi las ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha dang bcas pa g.yas skor g.yon skor yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dmar po mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi dbus su nam mkha'i hūm̐ zhugs/ de las dpal he ru ka'i lha rnams spros/ sems can thams cad he ru ka'i lha tshogs su byas nas de nyid du thim pas rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas gdod ma nas grub pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa spyan drangs nas de nyid la thim pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ nyi zla phyag mtshan thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa las sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad cig car rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo rgyu'i he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal bzhi pa phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar ba/ g.yon ljang ba/ rgyab zhal dmar ba/ g.yas zhal ser ba/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings pa'i rtse mor sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ g.yon gyi cha la zla ba phyed pas brgyan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra s+t+wa/ lnga pa na gri gug drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na kha ṭ+wām̐ ga bzhi pa na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pa na zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/

zhabs g.yas brkyangs shing g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma mnan pa/ mgo bo skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan zhing rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs rnam par grol ba/ de'i pang na shes rab rdo rje phag mo zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis ma/ nu 'bur rgyas shing chags pa'i nyams can sku mdog dang phyag mtshan yab dang 'dra ba las byin pa gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das la legs par 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsgoms nas/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ bsam mo// gnyis pa nye ba'i bsnyen pa ni/ yab kyi gsang ba'i rdo rje mi dmigs pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa yi ge beṃ dmar ser las byung ba'i nor bu dmar ser beṃ gyis mtshan zhing bu ga phaṭa ser pos bkag pa/ yum gyi gsang gnas a las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa beṃ dkar ser las byung ba'i ze'u 'bru beṃ gyis mtshan pa bu ga phaṭa ser pos bkag pa/ de nas yab kyi lte ba dang snying gar yum gyi snying po dang nye snying dang*/ mgrin pa dang dpral bar yab kyi snying po dang nye snying*/ yum gyi lte ba dang snying gar yab kyi snying po dang nye snying*/ mgrin pa dang dpral bar yum gyi snying po dang nye snying bkod la/ yab kyis yum la tsum+bā na dang*/ yum gyis kyang yab la tsum+bā na byas pas phan tshun snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgra dang snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs zhal du zhugs nas lha mo'i pad+mar babs pas gnyis ka bde ba chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bor zhu ste dngul chu'i rdog ma lta bu'i thig ler gyur par bsam mo// gsum pa sgrub pa ni/ de nas mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i thig le de nyid las 'thon nas rang rang gi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la 'dug ste mgrin gcig tu glus bskul te shar nas mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa drug gis/

mnga' bdag nyi ma re re 'gro ba mgron 'bod na// khyod ni ci yi phyir na stong pa nyid la bzhugs// bzhengs shig bzhengs shig 'di dag snying rje'i rang bzhin te// rdo rje 'dzin pa bde chen bdag la 'dod par mdzod// byang nas lā mā la sogs pa drug gis/ gson cig gson cig gzhan gyi dgos pa nub// 'jig rten phyug gang shi ba bzhin du 'gyur// bdag gi pad+ma rgyas la 'dod par mdzod// de ltar 'jig rten kun bder 'gyur bar byos// nub nas dum skyes ma la sogs pa drug gis/ rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag la rol cig rol// lhan skyes rang bzhin brjod du med pa thob// sems rmongs 'jig rten gzhan ni rmongs gyur pas// ji ltar khyod ni stong pa don med 'gyur// lho nas gzugs can ma la sogs pa drug gis/ khyod ni chos rnams kun gyi byed po ste// ji ltar lhan skyes rang bzhin 'gro med bzhugs// bdag la mchog gi don gyi 'dod pa mdzod// ji ltar khyod ni 'jig rten rnam mthun bzhugs// zhes glus bskul nas lha mo rnams thig le la thim pas thig le yongs su gyur pa las 'od zer dang bcas pas hūm̐ yig sngon por gyur/ de nas rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte bar hūm̐ ljang sngon gyis mtshan pa de yongs su gyur pa las gtso bo yab yum skad cig gis yongs su rdzogs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥkā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa ho/ zhes brjod la/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho sku mdog phyed sngo phyed ljang ba zhal bcu bdun pa phyag bdun cu rtsa drug dang ldan pa rtsa zhal phyed nag phyed ljang ba/ g.yas ser/ g.yon ljang*/ rgyab zhal dmar ba/ lhag ma'i zhal rnams bung ba ltar gnag pa/ zhal thams cad mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ ral pa'i cod paṇa can/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje mtshog mar zla ba phyed pas brgyan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/

g.yas kyi lhag ma rnams kyi/ gnyis pas ral gri/ gsum pas mdung rings/ bzhi pas rtse gsum/ lnga pas dgra s+t+wa/ drug pas gri gug bdun pas mda'/ brgyad pas skyes bu gsal shing gis phug pa/ dgu pas tho ba/ bcu pas 'khor lo/ bcu gcig pas cang te'u/ bcu gnyis pas chu gri/ bcu gsum pas dbyug to/ bcu bzhi pas mtshon rtse gcig pa/ bco lnga pas dung*/ bcu drug pas zangs dung*/ bcu bdun pas dbyug gu/ bco brgyad pas rma bya'i mjug sgro/ bcu dgu pas bya rog gi sgro/ nyi shu pas skra'i pir/ nyer gcig pas me thab/ nyer gnyis pas ri bo/ nyer gsum pas dbyug pa/ nyer bzhi pas me long*/ nyer lnga pas pi wang*/ nyer drug pas rkang mgo nyer bdun pas lag mgo nyer brgyad pas glo ba/ nyer dgu pas rgyu ma/ sum cu pas sgra gcan/ so gcig pas lcags sgrog so gnyis pas gdos/ so gsum pas dum+bhu sa/ so bzhi pas nya rgya/ so lnga pas mgo bo med pa'i lus/ so drug pas 'bar ba'i mar me/ so bdun pas 'jigs byed gzugs rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa'i gnyis pas phub rings/ gsum pas mche ba/ bzhi pas gtun shing*/ lnga pas zhags pa/ drug pas thod pa/ bdun pas gzhu/ brgyad pas kha ṭ+wām̐ ga dgu pas posti/ bcu pas phub chung yu ba can/ bcu gcig pas sdigs mdzub/ bcu gnyis pas g.yer kha'i phreng ba/ bcu gsum pas lcags sgrog bcu bzhi pas phrag bco lnga pas dur khrod kyi rdul/ bcu drug pas bho kaṃ ka bcu bdun pas rnga/ bco brgyad pas pags pa rlon pa/ bcu dgu pas skra'i thag pa/ nyi shu pas ro sreg pa'i shing bu/ nyer gcig pas 'phang*/ nyer gnyis pas phub rings/ nyer gsum pas mgo bo/ nyer bzhi pas keng rus/ nyer lnga pas zor ba/ nyer drug pas mig nyer bdun pas mkhal ma/ nyer brgyad pas gnye ma/ nyer dgu pas spen pa/ sum cu pas phur bu/ so gcig pas sa bon gang ba/ so gnyis pas sog le/ so gsum pas khab/ so bzhi pas slud bu bshus kyi pags pa/

so lnga pas sprin/ so drug pas shing*/ so bdun pas lcags kyu rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yas g.yon gyi so bdun pa 'di gnyis kyis rang rang gi phyag mtshan dang glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa thabs gcig tu 'dzin pa/ so brgyad pa gnyis kyis steng du skye gnas kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbur brgyan zhing rlon pa brgya'i do shal can rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan zhing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs rnam par grol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs shing g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma mnan pa bsam mo// bzhi pa sgrub pa chen po ni/ de'i pang na shes rab rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis drag mo'i gzugs can ma/ g.yas pas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje'i gri gug gis phyogs bcur bsdigs pa/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbur brgyan zhing skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ dar gyi cod paṇa dang me tog gi phreng bas brgyan pa/ gcer bu spyan gsum pa/ skra grol ba/ phyag rgya lnga'i brgyan pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das la legs par 'khyud cing yab yum gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam mo// gnyis pa go bgo ba ni/ gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ ljang sngon/ spyi bor zla ba dang 'khor lo la gnas pa'i oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par zla ba dang pad+ma la gnas pa'i āḥdamar po/ snying gar zla ba dang rdo rje la gnas pa'i hūm̐ sngon po/ gtso bo'i thugs kar hūm̐ gnyis kyi bar du raṃ dmar po las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du/ oṃ ha baṃ hā baṃ hi bi hī bī hu bu hūm̐ bū he be hai bai ho bo hau bau haṃ baṃ haḥbaḥhūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa kha dog dkar dmar g.yon skor du sbrul 'khyil ba ltar gnas pa rdo rje sems dpa' dang phag mo'i ngo bo/

de bzhin du mgo bor nyi ma la oṃ na haṃ nā hāṃ ni hiṃ nī hīṃ nu huṃ nū hūm̐ ne heṃ nai haiṃ no hoṃ nau hauṃ naṃ haṃ naḥhaḥhūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa ser zhing sngo ba rnam par snang mdzad dang gshin rje ma'i ngo bo/ spyi gtsug tu nyi ma la oṃ swa hraṃ swā hrāṃ swi hri swī hriṃ swu hruṃ swū hrūṃ swai hroṃ swaiṃ hraiṃ swo hreṃ swau hrauṃ swaṃ hraṃ swaḥhraḥhūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa dmar zhing dkar ba pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma dang rmongs byed ma'i ngo bo/ dpung pa gnyis kyi nang du nyi ma la oṃ ba hraṃ bā hrāṃ bi hriṃ bī hrīṃ bu hruṃ bū hrūṃ be hreṃ bai hraiṃ bo hroṃ bau hrauṃ baṃ hraṃ baḥhraḥhūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa gnag cing ser ba he ru ka dang skyod byed ma'i ngo bo/ spyan gnyis la nyi ma'i steng du oṃ huṃ huṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ haṃ haṃ hāṃ hāṃ hiṃ hiṃ hīṃ hīṃ haiṃ haiṃ hoṃ hoṃ hauṃ hauṃ haṃ haṃ haḥhaḥhūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa dmar zhing ljang ba rdo rje nyi ma dang skrag byed ma'i ngo bo/ mdzod spu'i thad ka'i nang du nyi ma la oṃ pha pha phā phā phi phi phī phī phu phu phū phū phe phe phai phai pho pho phau phau phaṃ phaṃ phaḥphaḥhūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa ljang zhing dud kha rta mchog dang gtum mo'i ngo bo/ 'di las yi ge'i tshogs 'phros pas spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar sngags kyis rdul phra rab tu gyur par bsam/ yang lus kyi phyi rol du snying gar rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo oṃ haḥdakar mo/ mgo bor rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo bo na ma hi ser po/ spyi gtsug tu pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug gi ngo bo swā hā hu dmar po/ phrag pa gnyis la dpal he ru ka'i ngo bo bau ṣa ṭa he nag po/ mig gnyis la rdo rje nyi ma'i ngo bo hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ser po/

yan lag thams cad la rta mchog gi ngo bo phaṭa haṃ ljang gu/ yum gyi lte bar rdo rje phag mo'i ngo bo oṃ bam̐ dmar po/ snying gar gshin rje ma'i ngo bo haṃ yaṃ sngon mo/ khar rmongs byed ma'i ngo bo hriṃ maṃ dkar mo/ mgo bor skyod byed ma'i ngo bo hriṃ hriṃ ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu skrag byed ma'i ngo bo hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu/ yan lag thams cad la tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bo phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rnams bkod do// gsum pa ye shes pa dgug pa ni/ lag pa'i mdzub mo gnyis mdud gung mo gnyis rtse sprad/ mthe bong gnyis kyang rtse sprad de sor mo lhag ma rnams brkyang bar 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar bzhag nas g.yon du bskor/ mig gyen du lta ba dang bcas pas gdong bsgyur rkang pa g.yon pas g.yas pa mnan nas phaiṃ zhes brjod pas snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ chu gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod dang*/ rig ma bcu drug gis sngar bzhin mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas bdag la dgug gzhug bcing mnyes par byas nas/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā yo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing chos thams cad thabs shes dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor du dag la bdag kyang de'i ngo bor dag go zhes nga rgyal bzung nas/ lag pa gnyis rnam lnga 'dod pa'i bskor ba dang mthar 'khyud pa'i tshul bya'o// bzhi pa dbang bskur ba ni/ de nas yang sngar gyi sngags dang phyag rgya dang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las byung ba'i tshul can gyis/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs la sngar bzhin mchod nas/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun// bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyi// khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur cig

/zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sgo mtshams ma rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ dpa' bo rnams kyis/ dbang bskur rol pa'i bde chen po// mkha' 'gro drwa ba'i bde chen po// dgyes chen gsol ba'i bde chen po// gsol mdzad bde ba chen po ste// a la la la la la ho// mchog tu gyur pa'i bde chen po// mkha' 'gro drwa ba'i bde chen po// a la la la la la ho// zhes glu len/ dpa' bo rnams kyis bkra shis brjod// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ yum bzhi rdo rje phag mo dang lngas nam mkha' nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pa blangs nas cung zad yo bar 'dzin bzhin pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes pa dang*/ dbang gi lha thams cad snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs zhal du zhugs thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes zhu ste/ rdo rje'i lam nas rang byung gi bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung nas gtso bo yab yum gyi spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang ste/ bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las yab la mi bskyod pa dang*/ yum la 'od dpag med sprul sku'i rnam pa can gyis dbur brgyan par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sogs brjod pas dbang gi lha rnams rang la bstim mo// lnga pa mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ rig ma bcu drug gis sngar bzhin mchod/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po dang nye snying brjod pas bstod/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar/ bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs nas myang ste/ mchod bstod byed mkhan gyi lha mo rnams rang la bsdus la gzhal yas khang dang lha chu zla lta bu bde ba chen po'i ngo bo la sems mnyam par gzhag go

/gsum pa rdzogs byed kyi yan lag la gsum/ phra thig gi rnal 'byor/ bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i rnal 'byor ro// dang po ni/ rang gi snying gar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros sems can thams cad mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs su byas/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim de yongs su gyur pa las byang chub kyi sems kyi thig ler gyur/ de'i nang du skad cig gis gtso bo yab yum gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa bsgoms la/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis dkyil 'khor gsal bar bsgom pa ni thig le'i rnal 'byor ro// thig le'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhal du zhugs te rdo rje nas 'bru tsam gyi lte bar dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par thig le'i rnal 'byor gyi bar du bsgom zhing mthar snying ga'i rdo rje de de la thim par bsgoms pas du ba la sogs pa'i rtags mthong bar 'gyur te phra mo'i rnal 'byor ro// gnyis pa ni/ dung chen gyi phreng ba bzung ste/ rang gtso bo yab yum du bsams pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las bzla bya'i sngags rnams kyi phreng ba byung ste rang gi zhal nas 'thon yum gyi zhal du zhugs pad+ma nas 'thon pa rdo rjer drangs shing 'khor bar bsams la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa ḍā ki nī dzā la saṃ ba raṃ swā hā/ zhes pas bcom ldan 'das kyi snying po dang*/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa nye ba'i snying po dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje phag mo'i snying po dang*/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po rnams ci nus bzla bar bya'o// gsum pa ni/ rang nyid gtso bor gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad la phog

de thams cad 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur nas srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ de dur khrod dang gzhal yas khang gtso bo la thim pas/ rang gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyi gnas par bya'o// gnyis pa mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ thun mtshams su gtor ma gtang bar bya ste/ de'ang ci 'byor pa'i gtor ma gcig gam gnyis 'du byas la/ oṃ badz+ra khaṇ+ḍa ro hi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ sngo skya las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs can mchog ma gnyis la ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ dmar po las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du gru gsum la mdun nas g.yon skor gyis oṃ dkar po āḥdamar po hūm̐ sngon po rnams yongs su gyur pa las mi mgo skam po'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a dkar po las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i nang du shar du bi dkar po las dri chen/ byang du mu ljang gu las dri chu/ nub tu ma dmar po las sha chen/ lhor ra dmar ser las rang byung*/ dbus su shu dkar po las byang chub kyi sems/ shar lhor go dkar po las ba glang gi sha lho nub tu ku sngon po las khyi'i sha nub byang du da dmar po las rta'i sha byang shar du ha ljang gu las glang po che'i sha dbus su na sngon po las mi'i sha rnams rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa yongs su gyur pa las bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyi kha ṭ+wām̐ ga dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de g.yon du 'khor bas rlung g.yos me sbar te rdzas thams cad zhu nas ser po sla ba'i dngos por gyur pa'i rlangs pa nam mkhar chags pas g.yon skor du ā li dang*/ g.yas skor du kā li'i phreng bar gyur te/ de dag 'dres shing yongs su gyur pa las oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum du gyur/ de las gtso bo yab yum dpag tu med pa spros/

sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par byas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi he ru ka yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ de rnams snyoms par zhugs pas yi ge gsum la thim/ de dag kyang gtor ma la thim/ kha ṭ+wām̐ ga yang zhu bas kha dog dmar po bsil ba phun sum tshogs par bsams te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes yang yang brjod do// de nas pheṃ gyi sgra dang phyag rgya dang mig dang rkang pa'i sbyor ba rnams byas la/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi nam mkhar chos 'byung la gnas pa'i dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa spyan drangs te/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod cing snying gar se gol gtogs so// de nas zhabs bsil sogs gsum dang*/ me tog sogs lnga dang*/ pi wang sogs bcu drug ste nyi shu rtsa bzhis mchod la/ lag pa g.yon pas ā li las zla ba dang*/ g.yas kā li las nyi ma/ de gnyis kha sbyar ba'i dbus su/ hūm̐ gi yi ge sngon por bsams te/ oṃ a n+yo3 n+ya a nu ga tāḥsarba dharmāḥhūm̐/ oṃ s+pha ra s+pha ra a nu pra biṣ+ṭa sarba dharmāḥhūm̐/ oṃ a t+yan+t+ya a nu pra biṣ+ṭaḥsarba dharmāḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas lag pa rdo rje rtse lnga par mos la/ pad skor bya zhing*/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// de brjod gsung yang mchog tu tshad ma ste// bden pa 'di dag gis ni lha mo kun// bdag cag rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces brjod de lha'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rjer bsgoms pas gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra ā ral+li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ zhes ci nus brjod cing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgyas dbul lo// slar yang zhabs bsil la sogs pas mchod la/ oṃ badz+ra taṃ bu la ye swā hā/ zhes pas so rtsi phul la/ nang bdud rtsis kyang mchod nas/

rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te wī re shā ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kalpa ag+ni san+ni bhā ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dza ṭā mu ku ṭot+ka ṭā ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ daṃṣ+ṭā ka rā lo gra bhī ṣa ṇa mu ṣā ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sa ha sra bhu dza bhā su rā ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pa ra shu pā sho d+ya ta shū la kha ṭ+wām̐ ga dhā ri ṇī ye hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ byā gh+rā dzi na am+ba ra dha rā ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā dhū mrān+dha ka rā wa pu ṣā ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas yab kyi rkang brgyad dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti badz+ra wā rā hī hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥ.ār+ya a pa rā dzi te trai lo kya mā te ma hā bi d+ye shwa ri hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥsarba bud+dha bha ya ā wa he ma hā badz+re hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra ā sa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te ba sh+yaṃ ka ri nai tra bh+ra ma ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi sha sho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dha ni kā rā li ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥsan+t+rā sa ni mā ra ṇi su pra bhe da nī a pa rā dza ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo dza ye bi dza ye dzam+bha ni stam+bha ni mo ha ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra wā rā hī ma hā yo gi nī kā me shwa ri kha ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pas bstod nas/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab cing*/ bkra shis dang*/ yi ge brgya pa brjod par bya'o// de nas gtor ma rnying pa'am/ med na sngar gyi lhag ma dur khrod pa rnams la dbul bar bya ste/ oṃ kha kha/ khā hi khī hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rāk+ṣa sa/ bhu ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsa/ un+mā da/ a pasma ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya dā ya i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+nān+tu sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya thai baṃ/ ya theṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ dzi tha/ pi ba tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kārta sat+su khaṃ bi shud+dha ye ma ma sa ha yi ka bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas thams cad kyis gsol bar bsgoms la/

sngar bzhin mchod nas/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam pas zhen pa bcom zhing kun tu rtogs pa bcom// dngos dang dngos po ma yin thams cad mkha' bzhin rnam par gzigs pa rnams// bla ma mchog gi thugs rje'i chu spro thugs ni chu yi mgon po rnams// mdzod cig mdzod cig lha mos bdag la rjes su thugs ni brtse bar mdzod// zhes brjod la mig gi phyag rgya bstan te/ pad+ma'i bskor ba dang*/ lte bar 'khyud pas se gol gtogs te/ oṃbadz+ra maṇ+ḍal muḥ zhes brjod pas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rang gi mdzod spur bcug la/ gtor ma sa gtsang sar dor ro// kha zas za ba'i tshe/ zas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ snying gar ye shes kyi me'i dbus su dkyil 'khor bsams la sreg rdzas kyi tshul du 'bul lo// khrus kyi dus su ni/ dbang bskur ba'i rim pas so// nyal ba'i dus su ni/ gong bur bsdu ba'i rim pas snying gar thim par bsams nas/ 'od gsal gyi ngang du nyal bar bya'o// nangs pa ldang ba'i tshe/ 'od gsal las zung 'jug gi skur ldang ngo*// de ltar bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor goms par byas pa las dpal he ru ka'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro// bde chen rgya mtsho'i dbang phyug he ru ka /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i gtso bo yab yum gyi// sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i snying po 'di bkod pas// dge ba rgya mtshos 'gro kun sangs rgyas shog /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i sgrub thabs 'di ni mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug rje btsun dam pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs las paṇ+ḍi ta dza ya se na'i dgongs pa ltar btus te kun dga'i lo cho 'phrul gyi zla ba la dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi dgon par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rin chen grub kyis bgyis so// //i daṃ shā sa nash+tsa sarba satwa hi to bha wan+tu//

// ༄// dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi sngags phreng gsang sngags rin po che'i mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi sngags phreng gsang sngags rin po che'i mdzod ces bya ba/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo// dngos grub rgya mtsho'i rang bzhin can// mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor gus btud nas// dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i lha rnams kyi// gsang sngags rgya mtsho dag par bri// oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru

dpal he ru ka'i he ru ka kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa ḍā ki nī mkha' 'gro ma drwa ba'i sdom pa/ dzā la saṃ ba raṃ swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das kyi snying po'o// oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po'o// oṃ na mo bha phyag 'tshal ga wa te wī re bcom ldan 'das ma dpa' bo'i dbang phyug la/ shā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kalpa bskal pa'i me chen lta bu la ag+ni san+ni bhā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dza ṭā mu ku ral pa'i cod paṇa gyen du brdzes pa/ ṭot+ka ṭā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ daṃṣ+ṭā ka rā lo gra bhī zhal mche ba gtsigs pa drag cing 'jigs su rung ba/ ṣa ṇa mu khā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sa phyag stong 'od zer 'phro ba/ ha sra bhu dza bhā su rā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pa ra shu pā sho d+ya ta shū la kha dgra s+t+wa dang zhags pa gdengs shing mdung dang kha ṭ+wām̐ ga 'dzin pa/ ṭ+wāṃ ga dhā ri ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ byā gh+rā stag lpags kyi gos 'dzin pa/ dzi na am+ba ra dha rā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma du ba chen po dang mun pa lta bu'i sku la/ hā dhū mrān+dha kā rā wa pu ṣā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rkang pa brgyad pa'o// oṃ phyag 'tshal lo/ na maḥshrī badz+ra ḍā ka ma hā bī ra bī re dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro dpa' bo chen po dpa' bo'i dbang phyug la shwa rā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tri bhu ba ṇa kam+ba ka myā ba ṇā ye sa gsum bskyod cing g.yo bar mdzad du 'jug pa po la/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ daṃṣ+ṭo ta ka ṭa bhī ṣa ṇa bhaiṃ ra wā mche ba gtsigs pa 'jigs su rung ba 'jigs par mdzad pa/ ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sha ta sa ha sra nai trā ya spyan brgya stong phrag mnga' ba/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bi dh+yu dz+dzi hwā ya glog gi ljags can huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kaṃ kā la mā lā bha ra ṇo grā ya keng rus kyi phreng bas brgyan pa'i sku can/

huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ko ṭī lak+ṣa bhu dzā ya phyag bye ba 'bum mnga' ba/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dz+wā lā wa lī ḍa lag+nā ya 'bar bas kun nas bskor bas reg pa/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pa ra shu pā sho d+ya ta shū lā ya dgra s+t+wa zhags pa dpal can 'phyar ba/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kalpān ta dhū mra u gra wa pu ṣā ya bskal pa'i mtha'i du ba drag po'i sku can/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bi ka ṭa mu kha hā hā ra bā ya rnam par gtsigs pa'i zhal hā hā sgrogs pa/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ mā trī ga ṇa pa ri pū ri ta man+t+rā ya ma mo'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba'i sngags can/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sa ha dza sun+da rī pal+la bhā ka rā ya lhan cig skyes pa'i mdzes ma dang gcugs par mdzad pa/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ huṃ hūm̐ kā rots+tsā ra ṇa mu khā ya huṃ hūm̐ zhes sgrogs pa'i zhal can la/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā sh+ma shā pri yā ya dur khrod chen po la dges pa/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bhū ta san+t+rā sa na ka rā ya 'byung po thams cad kun du skrag par mdzad pa/ hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kalpān+tā g+ni te dzā ya bskal pa'i mtha'i me'i gzi brjid can/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dza ṭā ka lā pa mu ku ṭā ya ral pa'i tshogs kyi cod paṇa can/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ka pā la shū khri rkang dang thod pa dang gsal shing gis phug pa 'dzin pa/ la bhin+na dha ri ṇe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā sa mu dra me kha lā ya rgya mtsho chen po'i ska rags can/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ byā gh+rā tsarmām+ba ra dha ri ṇe stag gi pags pa'i na bza' 'chang ba/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ be tā la saṃ gha marda na ka rā ya ro langs kyi tshogs 'joms par mdzad pa/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā bi gh+na ni bā ri ṇe huṃ hūm̐ bgegs chen po la skyob pa po/ phaṭa/ oṃ sha tru ni suṃ bha na kā rā ya

dgra la nges par gnod pa mdzad pa/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po ba spu 'khyil ba gcig gi nang du gnas pa pa/ oṃ tri sa ha sra ma hā sa hā srai ka ro mā ba l+yān taḥwarti ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sha ta sa ha sra mu khā ya zhal brgya phrag stong mnga' ba/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dzñā na sā ga ra pra bhā ya ye shes kyi rgya mtsho'i zhal can/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā bi shi ta ru dhi ra ba sā hā ri ṇe sha chen po dang khrag dang zhag gsol ba po/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba mā ra ba la ha dh+wa na si bdud thams cad kyi stobs 'joms pa po/ ne huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shrī ṣ+ṭi saṃ hā ra kā ra kā ya 'byin pa dang sdud pa mdzad pa po/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba nā gā nāṃ sho ṣa ṇa stam+bha na bi dra ba ṇā ya klu thams cad kyi skems pa dang rengs pa dang rnam par 'du bar mdzad pa/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ an+t+ra mā lā dha ri ṇe rgyu ma'i phreng ba 'dzin pa/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ su me ru kam+bi ta nā dā ya ri rab g.yo bar byed pa'i sgra can/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kro dha bi gra ha dhā ra ṇā ya khro bo'i sku 'dzin pa/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā go skabs chen po'i thig le'i bdag nyid can/ sha ti la kāt+ma ne huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bud+dha ko ṭī sa ha srak+ṣa ṇā niṣ+pā da nā ya sangs rgyas bye ba stong skad cig gis rdzogs par mdzad pa/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dzñā nā mṛ ta bar+ṣa pa ṇā ya ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs pa/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba karma pra bar+t+ta nā ya las thams cad rab tu 'jug par mdzad pa/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ 'ching bar byed pa/ ban+dha ka rā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bi kalpa bañdza na ka rā ya rnam par rtog pa thams cad 'joms par mdzad pa/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ muṇ+ḍā ba lī lag+na sha rī rā ya huṃ hūm̐

mgo bo 'khrigs pas rig pa'i sku can/ phaṭa/ oṃ pa ra kri ta yan+t+ra man+t+ra nā sha ya nā ya huṃ hūm̐ gzhan gyis byas pa'i 'khrul 'khor dang sngags 'joms pa po/ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā rak+ṣa ka rā ya huṃ hūm̐ srung ba chen po byed pa/ phaṭa/ oṃ duṣ+ṭā nāṃ bi dā la sdang ba rnams rnam par 'joms pa po/ ne huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dharmo da ya ka rā ya chos 'byung bar mdzad pa/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kro dha s+pha ra s+pha ra ṇā ya khro bo spro zhing spro bar byed du 'jug pa/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ in+d+ra dzā la sarba dbang po'i drwa ba sems can thams cad kyi bdag nyid can/ sa twāt+ma ne huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ grasta bā dāṃ pra bā da ma hā ma 'thab pa dang rtsod pa dang rab tu rtsod pa'i blo gros chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ te huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rkang pa zhe brgyad pa'o/ ༈ /oṃ a ka ā kha i ga ī gha ung*/ ū tsa ṛ tsha rī dza l̥ dzha l̥̄ nya/ e ṭa ai ṭha o ḍa au ḍha aṃ ṇa/ aḥta aḥtha aṃ da auṃ dha oṃ na/ aiṃ pa em̐ pha l̥̄ṃ pa l̥ṃ bha ṝṃ ma/ ṛṃ ya ūṃ ra uṃ la īṃ wa/ -iṃ sha āṃ ṣa aṃ sa/ aṃ ha aṃ k+ṣaḥhaḥkaṃ kā kha khā ga gā gha ghā nga ngā*/ tsa tsā tsha tshā dza dzā dzha dzhā nya nyā/ ṭa ṭā ṭha ṭhā ḍa ḍā ḍha ḍhā ṇa ṇā/ ta tā tha thā da dā dha dhā na nā/ pa pā pha phā ba bā bha bhā ma mā/ ya yā ra rā la lā wa wā sha shā ṣa ṣā sa sā ha hā k+ṣa k+ṣā/ k+ṣaṃ k+ṣāṃ haṃ hāṃ saṃ sāṃ ṣaṃ ṣāṃ shaṃ shā/ waṃ wāṃ laṃ lāṃ raṃ rāṃ yaṃ yāṃ/ maṃ māṃ bhaṃ bhāṃ baṃ bāṃ phaṃ phāṃ paṃ pāṃ/ naṃ nāṃ dhaṃ dhāṃ daṃ dāṃ thaṃ thāṃ taṃ tāṃ/ ṇaṃ ṇāṃ ḍhaṃ ḍhāṃ ḍaṃ ḍāṃ ṭhaṃ ṭhāṃ ṭaṃ ṭāṃ/ nyaṃ nyāṃ dzhaṃ dzhāṃ dzaṃ dzāṃ tshaṃ tshāṃ tsaṃ tsāṃ/ ngaṃ ngāṃ ghaṃ ghāṃ gaṃ gāṃ khaṃ khāṃ kaṃ kāṃ/ ka tsa kha tsha ga dza gha dzha nga nya/ ka ṭa kha ṭha ga ḍa gha ḍha nga ṇa/ ka ta kha tha ga da gha dha nga na/ ka pa kha pha ga ba gha bha nga ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ aḥ.aṃ/ ka ha ka ha/

ka sa ka sa/ ka ṣa ka ṣa/ ka sha ka sha ka wa ka wa/ ka la ka la/ ka ra ka ra/ ka ya ka ya/ ka ma ka ma/ ka bha ka bha/ ka ba ka ba/ ka pha ka pha/ ka pa ka pa/ ka na ka na/ ka dha ka dha/ ka da ka da/ ka tha ka tha/ ka ta ka ta/ ka ṇa ka ṇa/ ka ḍha ka ḍha/ ka ḍa ka ḍa/ ka ṭha ka ṭha/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ka nya ka nya/ ka dzha ka dzha/ ka dza ka dza/ ka tsha ka tsha/ ka tsa ka tsa/ ka nga ka nga*/ ka gha ka gha/ ka ga ka ga ka kha ka kha/ ku hu ku hu/ ku su ku su/ ku ṣu ku ṣu/ ku shu ku shu/ ku wu ku wu/ ku lu ku lu/ ku ru ku ru/ ku yu ku yu/ ku mu ku mu/ ku bhu ku bhu/ ku bu ku bu/ ku phu ku phu/ ku pu ku pu/ ku nu ku nu/ ku dhu ku dhu/ ku du ku du/ ku thu ku thu/ ku tu ku tu/ ku ṇu ku ṇu/ ku ḍhu ku ḍhu/ ku ḍu ku ḍu/ ku ṭhu ku ṭhu/ ku ṭu ku ṭu/ ku nyu ku nyu/ ku dzhu ku dzhu/ ku dzu ku dzu/ ku tshu ku tshu/ ku tsu ku tsu/ ku ngu ku ngu*/ ku ghu ku ghu/ ku gu ku gu/ ku khu ku khu/ chings shig chings shig ban+dhā ya ban+dha ya/ sgrogs shig sgrogs shig gardzadza ya gardzadza ya/ sho ṣa ya skoms shig skoms shig sho ṣa ya/ tardzadza ya bsdigs bsdigs/ tardzadza ya/ s+pho ṭa ya khos khos/ s+pho ṭa ya/ rnam par ltung bar gyis rnam par ltung bar gyis/ bi dh+wan+sa ya bi dh+wan+sa ya/ mo ha ya rmongs par gyis rmongs par gyis/ mo ha ya/ trā sa ya skrag par gyis skrag par gyis/ trā sa ya/ mā ra ya mā ra ya sod sod/ kaṃ bā wa ya bskyod bskyod/ kaṃ bā wa ya/ du ra du ra/ khu ra chod chod/ khu ra/ bha ra bzung bzung*/ bha ra/ lang tsho nyams lang tsho nyams/ dza ra dza ra/ bi sha zhugs zhugs/ bi sha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ sregs sregs/ da ha da ha/ tshos tshos/ pa tsa pa tsa/ 'ded par gyis 'ded par gyis/ bhañdza bhañdza/ marda ya choms choms/ marda ya/ hreṃ hreṃ/ tsa la g.yos g.yos/ tsa la/ mā tsa la ma g.yo ma g.yo/ mā tsa la/ krū ra tse ta ya phaṭa/

sha tru ni bā ra ya dgra bo bzlog hūm̐/ me gha ni bā ra bdag la 'tshe ba bzlog ya hriṃ/ mo tsa ya grol bar gyis grol bar gyis/ mo tsa ya/ stam+bha ya rengs par mdzod rengs par mdzod/ stam+bha ya/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa zo zo/ dur p+pa ya dur p+pa ya/ gu ḍha rgyu ma'i phreng ba 'phyang ba/ an+t+ra mā lā ba laṃ bi ni/ khe mkha' spyod la/ tsa rā ya hūm̐/ bhū tsa sa spyod la/ rā ya āḥ pā tā la tsa rā rkang 'og spyod la/ ya oṃ/ dza la tsa rā chu la spyod pa/ ya baṃ/ s+thā thang la spyod pa/ la tsa rā ya laṃ/ sarba thams cad du nges par gnas pa/ ta ni bā sa ne hūm̐/ nā gā nāṃ sa 'og bdun na gnas pa'i klu/ sap+ta pā tā la ga ta/ gṛh+ṇa zung zung*/ gṛh+ṇa/ dzñāṃ dzñāṃ/ dzñauṃ dzñauṃ/ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ kha ra kha ra/ khu ru khu ru/ ga ra ga ra/ gu ru gu ru/ gha ra gha ra/ ghu ru ghu ru/ nga ra nga ra/ ngu ru ngu ru/ tsa ra tsa ra/ tsu ru tsu ru/ tsha ra tsha ra/ tshu ru tshu ru/ dza ra dza ra/ dzu ru dzu ru/ dzha ra dzha ra/ dzhu ru dzhu ru/ nya ra nyar/ nyu ru nyu ru/ ṭa ra ṭa ra/ ṭu ru ṭu ru/ ṭha ra ṭha ra/ ṭhu ru ṭhu ru/ ḍa ra ḍa ra/ ḍu ru ḍu ru/ ḍha ra ḍha ra/ ḍhu ru ḍhu ru/ ṇa ra ṇa ra/ ṇu ru ṇu ru/ ta ra ta ra/ tu ru tu ru/ tha ra tha ra/ thu ru thu ru/ da ra da ra/ du ru du ru/ dha ra dha ra/ dhu ru dhu ru/ na ra na ra/ nu ru nu ru/ pa ra pa ra/ pu ru pu ru/ pha ra pha ra/ phu ru phu ru/ ba ra ba ra/ bu ru bu ru/ bha ra bha ra/ bhu ru bhu ru/ ma ra ma ra/ mu ru mu ra/ ya ra ya ra/ yu ru yu ru/ ra ra ra ra/ ru ru ru ru/ la ra la ra/ lu ru la ru/ wa ra wa ra/ wu ru wu ru/ sha ra sha ra/ shu ru shu ru/ ṣa ra ṣa ra/ ṣu ru ṣu ru/ sa ra sa ra/ su ru su ru/ ha ra ha ra/ hu ru hu ru/ k+ṣa ra k+ṣa ra/ k+ṣu ru k+ṣu ru/ haṃ haṃ/ hiṃ hiṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ heṃ haiṃ/ hoṃ hauṃ/ haṃ haḥ gar+bha gar+bha/ snying po snying po/ skye ba skye ba/

dzā ti dzā ti/ lha rnams/ de wā nāṃ/ dā ma ya dā ma zhi bar gyis zhi bar gyis/ ya/ sarba lus can thams cad/ sha rī rā ya hūm̐/ dza ya dza ya rgyal ba rgyal ba/ hūm̐/ bi dza ya rnam par rgyal ba rnam par rgyal ba/ bi dza ya hūm̐/ sa ra sa ra hūm̐/ bi sa ra bi sa ra hūm̐/ ag+na ye me lha/ hūm̐/ chu lha/ wa ru ṇe hūm̐/ me lha/ a nā lā ya hūm̐/ bā ya rlung lha/ we hūm̐/ nam mkha'/ ā kā shā ya hūm̐/ sarba ro go pa nad thams cad nye bar 'phrog pa/ ha rā ya hūm̐/ bi ṣa dug 'thung ba/ bhak+ṣa ṇā ya hūm̐/ 'khrul 'khor bza' ba/ yan+t+ra bā ha nā ya hūm̐/ kā lā dus kyi me/ g+na ye hūm̐/ de wā ya lha la/ hūm̐/ gshin rje la/ ya mā ya hūm̐/ ku be lus ngan la/ rā ya hūm̐/ nyi ma/ de t+yā ya hūm̐/ dbang po/ in+d+rā ya hūm̐/ 'byung po/ bhū tā ya hūm̐/ sarba satwā ya sems can thams cad/ hūm̐/ war+t+ta tsakrā ya 'khor los sgyur ba/ hūm̐/ dharma dhā ta chos kyi dbyings/ we hūm̐/ mu khā ya zhal can/ hūm̐/ nai trā ya spyan can/ hūm̐/ ka pā la thod pa'i phreng ba can/ mā li ne hūm̐/ bhu dzā ya phyag can/ a ṣ+ṭā ya hūm̐/ brgyad pa can/ tsa ra ṇā ya hūm̐/ rkang pa can/ dza ṭā mu ku ṭā ral pa'i cod paṇa can/ ya/ ma sa ma sa 'jal ba 'jal ba/ ga sa ga sa/ ra sa ra sa myang ba myang ba/ bha ra 'gengs pa 'gengs pa/ bha ra/ ma ṭa brlag pa brlag pa/ ma ṭa/ tra ṭa dral bar gyis dral bar gyis/ tra ṭa/ gha ṭa gha ṭa phye zhig phye zhig muñtsa grol ba grol ba/ muñtsa/ gho rān+dha kā ra pri 'jigs su rung ba mun pa la dga' ba/ yā ya/ phiṃ phiṃ/ phu da phu da/ ma ra ma ra/ ba ra mār+tha rū pi ṇe don dam pa'i gzugs can/ shān+ti ka rā zhi bar byed pa/ ye/

puṣ+ṭi brta rgyas pa 'phel ba/ nā ya/ lo ka pā la 'jig rten skyong ba'i gzugs can/ rū pi ṇe/ sarba sha rī ra rū pā lus thams cad kyi gzugs can/ ya/ bṛk+ṣa gul+mo la tā shing lcug ma/ ya/ sa spa rū pi gzugs can/ ṇe/ sarba thams cad kyi dngos la/ ba stu ne/ mā ra ṇā ya gsod byed/ ma ra pa ṇa/ gzugs/ rū pā ya/ za ba/ bhak+ṣā ya/ za byed/ bhak+ṣa ṇa/ gzugs/ rū pā ya/ dpe med/ ni ro pa mā ya/ dpe med pa'i zhal can/ ni ro pa ma mu kha we/ dgod pa dgod pa/ ha sa ha sa/ bi rnam sgeg rnam sgeg lā sa bi lā sa/ gar byed gar byed/ nri t+yā nri t+yā/ nri t+yā pa gar gyis gar gyis/ pa nri t+yā pa ya/ dwī n+d+ri ya dbang po gnyis sbyor/

yo gā ya/ niḥswa bhā wa nges par rang bzhin med pa'i bdag nyid can/ ma hāt+ma ne/ shas+t+ra dha ra ṇi mtshon cha 'dzin pa bzlog pa/ wa ra ṇā ya/ nā nā bi tsa ra mngon spyod sna tshogs gcod par mdzad/ ts+tshan+da ne/ tsum+ba tsum+ba/ hu lu hu lu/ tsu lu tsu lu/ hūm̐ ha hūm̐ hā/ hūm̐ hi hūm̐ hī/ hum̐ hu hūm̐ hū/ hūm̐ he hūm̐ hai/ hūm̐ ho hūm̐ hau/ hūm̐ haṃ hūm̐ haḥ huṃ hūm̐/ hriṃ hrīṃ/ dzuṃ dzūṃ/ kroṃ krauṃ/ phiṃ phīṃ/ phuṃ phūṃ/ pheṃ phaiṃ/ phauṃ phauṃ/ phaṃ phaḥ pha phā/ ku tsa ku tsa/ tra ṭa tra ṭa/ ma tra ma tra/ ra ṭha ra ṭha/ da ṭha da ṭha/ dza ṭha dza ṭha/ ma da na ma da na/ huṃ hūm̐ huṃ hūm̐/ huṃ hūm̐ huṃ hūm̐/ huṃ hūm̐ huṃ hūm̐/ huṃ hūm̐ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥswā hā/ dpa' bo'i rtsa ba'i sngags so/ ༈ /oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad ma/ phag mo'i snying po'o// oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā thams cad sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma/ ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye kha dog ma rdo rje'i rigs can ma/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po'o// oṃ na mo bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo/ bha ga wa tī badz+ra wā rā hī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥ.ār+ya a pa rā dzi te trai lo kya mā te ma hā bi d+ye shwa ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'phags ma gzhan gyis mi thub ma 'jig rten gsum gyi yum rig pa'i dbang phyug chen mo/ oṃ na maḥsarba bhu ta bha ya ā wa he 'byung po kun 'jigs pa kun du thob ma rdo rje chen mo/ ma hā badz+ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra rdo rje gdan ma ma pham ma gzhan gyis mi thub ma dbang du byed pa'i spyan 'phrul ma/ ā sa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te wa sh+yaṃ ka ri ṇai tra bh+ra ma ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi dug skems ma gtsub cing khro mo gtsigs ma/ sho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dha ni kā rā li ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ na maḥ skrag mdzad ma gsod pa mo shin tu rab tu dbye ma gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ san+t+rā sa ni mā ra ṇi su pra bhe da nī a pa rā dza ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo dza ye rgyal ma rnam par rgyal ma rmugs byed ma rengs byed ma rmongs byed ma/ bi dza ye dzam+bha ni stam+bha ni mo ha ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra wā rā hī rdo rje phag mo rnal 'byor ma chen mo 'dod pa'i dbang phyug mkha' 'gro ma/ ma hā yo gi nī kā me shwa ri kha ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ tad+ya thā 'di lta ste/ pro taṃ ge pro taṃ ge bsnun bsnun srog rnams/ ha na ha na prā ṇāṃ/ kiṃ ki ni/ khiṃ khi ni/ bskyod bskyod/ dhu na dhu na/ badz+ra ha rdo rje lag ma/ ste/ sho ṣa ya skom skom/ sho ṣa ya/ badz+ra rdo rje thod pa dang kha ṭ+wām̐ ga 'dzin ma/ ka pā la kha ṭ+wām̐ ga dha rī ṇi/ ma hā bi shi ta/ māṃ sa a sha chen za ba mo/ sha ni/ mā nu ṣān+ta prā mi'i rgyu mas rab tu dkris pa la gnas pa'i/ pri te sān+ni dh+ya/ na ra shi ro mā lā gra mi mgo'i phreng rgyud 'dzin ma/ thi ta dha ri ṇi/ sum+bha ni gnod mdzes nges par gnod mdzes/ sum+bhe/ ha na rgyob rgyob/ ha na/ prā ṇā na sarba pā pa srog rnams sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa/ sa twā nāṃ/ sarba pa shū/ nāṃ ma hā māṃ sa ts+tshe da ni kro dha mūrte/ phyugs kun gyi sha chen gcod ma khro bo'i lus can/ daṃ ṣ+ṭ+rā ka rā li ni ma hā mu mche ba gtsigs ma phyag rgya chen mo/ dre/ shrī he ru ka de ba s+yā gra ma lha'i mchog dpal he ru ka'ibatsun mo/ hi ṣi/ sa ha swa shi re dbu stong mnga' ba phyag stong mnga' ba/ sa ha sra ba hā be/ sha ta sa zhal brgya phrag stong mnga' ba/ ha sra ā na ne/ dz+wa li 'bar ba ma/ ta/ te dza gzi brjid 'bar ba 'bar ba'i zhal ma dmar ser spyan ma/

se dz+wa la mu khi piṃ ga la lo tsa ne/ badz+ra rdo rje'i lus can ma/ sha rī re/ badz+ra rdo rje gdan ma/ ā sa ne/ mi li mi li/ ti mi li ti mi li/ he kye kye ngo mtshar ba/ he ha ha huṃ hūm̐/ kha kha dhu dhu/ dhu ru dhu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ muñtsa muñtsa/ a dwe te/ ma hā yo gnyis su med pa'i rnal 'byor ma chen mo/ gi nī/ pa ṭhi ta sid+dhi bklags pa grub ma/ dreṃ dhaṃ dreṃ dhaṃ/ graṃ graṃ/ he he/ ha ha/ bhī me/ 'jigs ma/ ha sa sa ha sa ha'ang bshad/ ha sa/ wī dpa' mo/ re/ hā hā hoḥhoḥ hā hā hā hā hoḥhūm̐ hūm̐'ang byung*/ huṃ hūm̐/ trai lo kya bi nā sha 'jig rten gsum rnam par 'joms ma/ ni/ sha ta sa ha sra brgya stong bye ba'i/ ko ṭī/ ta thā ga ta pa ri de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor dang ldan ma/ wā ri te huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ siṃ ha rū pe khaḥ seng ge'i gzugs can ma/ ga dza rū pa glang po'i gzugs can ma/ gaḥ trai lo kyo da re 'jig rten gsum gyi lto can ma/ ma hā sa mu dra me rgya mtsho chen po'i ske rags can ma/ kha le/ gra sa gra sa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bī rā dwai te dpa' bo gnyis su med ma/ huṃ hūm̐ hā hā ma hā pa phyug chen mo rmongs par byed ma/ shu mo ha ni/ mkha' 'gro ma rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen mo khyod/ ma hā yo gī shwa ri twaṃ ḍā ki nī/ sarba lo 'jig rten thams cad kyi/ kā nāṃ/ ban+dha 'ching ba mo/ ni/ sad+yaḥpra t+ya ya kā ri ṇi 'bral du yid ches par byed pa mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bhu ta trā sa ni/ 'byung po skrag par mdzad ma/ ma hā wī dpa' bo chen mo/ re pa ra ma sid+dhe/ mchog tu grub ma/ yo gī rnal 'byor dbang phyug ma/ shā ri phaṭa/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ huṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i rtsa ba'i sngags so/

༈ /mkha' 'gro ma nyer bzhi'i sngags rnams ni/ oṃ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rdo rje gzugs can ma/ badz+ra rū pi kā yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsum+bi rdo rje 'o byed ma/ kā yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rdo rje gzhan bsgyur ma/ pa rā dṛ tā yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rdo rje byis bcas ma/ sa wā li kā yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra a nu rdo rje rjes 'jug ma/ brtī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lā ma oṃ badz+ra lā me huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rdo rje rnal 'byor dbang phyug ma/ yo gī shwa rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rdo rje bzang mo/ bha drī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kā pā li rdo rje thod pa can ma/ nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kaṃ kā li rdo rje phag mo/ kā yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje rgyal po skor ma/ oṃ badz+ra rā dza bārtī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra khaṇ+ḍa ro rdo rje dum skyes ma/ hā yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rdo rje dur khrod ma sh+ma shā nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bi dra pī rdo rje rnam par zhum ma/ ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rdo rje rigs byed ma/ ku ru kul+li kā yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ru dān tī ye rdo rje dum huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rdo rje gar mar grags ma/ nā ṭī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rdo rje gzugs can ma/ rū pi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje 'jigs byed ma/ oṃ badz+ra bhai ra wī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra shi khī ye rdo rje gtsug phud ma/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rdo rje thor tshugs ma/ shi khaṇ+ḍī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dza ṭī ye huṃ hūm̐ rdo rje ral pa can ma phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ru drā yai huṃ hūm̐ rdo rje drag mo/

phaṭa/ ༈ /rdo rje'i 'khor lo'i sngags rnams ni/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūm̐ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lā ma oṃ badz+ra lā me huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bi shwa ḍā sna tshogs mkha' 'gro/ ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dum skyes ma/ khaṇ+ḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ oṃ badz+ra pad+ma ḍā ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gzugs can ma/ rū pi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rin chen mkha' 'gro/ rat+na ḍā ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pra tsaṇ+ḍī ye rab tu gtum mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra thod pa'i dum bu/ khaṇ+ḍā ka pā li huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gtum pa'i mig can ma/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍā k+ṣī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kaṃ keng rus chen mo/ ka la huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pra 'od ldan ma/ bhā wa tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kaṃ ka la keng rus/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma sna chen ma/ hā nā se huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mche ba rnam par gtsigs ma/ bi ka ṭa daṃṣ+ṭ+ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dpa' bo'i blo gros ma/ wī ra ma tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra lha'i dpa' bo su rwa wī ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mi'u thung ma/ kharba rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra a mi tā 'od dpag tu med/ bhā huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra laṃ ke shwa ri lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/ ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rdo rje'i 'od/ badz+ra pra bha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra shing grib ma/ drū mats+tshā ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rdo rje'i sku/ badz+ra de hā huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra e ra wa sa srung ma/ tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku ri myu gu can/ ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra 'jigs byed chen mo/ ma hā bhai ra wī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ badz+ra badz+ra dza ṭī la huṃ hūm̐ rdo rje ral pa can/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bā yu be ge huṃ hūm̐ rlung gi shugs can ma/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā wī ra huṃ hūm̐ dpa' bo chen mo/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra su ra bhak+ṣī ye huṃ hūm̐ chang za ma'o// phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra hūm̐ mdzad ma/ hūm̐ kā ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sh+yā ma de wī ye sngo bsangs lha mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra su shin tu bzang po/ bha dra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rab tu bzang mo oṃ badz+ra su bha drī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra badz+ra bha dra huṃ hūm̐ rdo rje bzang mo phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rta rna ma/ ha ya kar+ṇe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā bhai ra we 'jigs byed chen mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kha bya rog gdong ma/ ga na ne huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mig mi bzang*/ bi rū pāk+shi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ be ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra stobs po che/ ma hā ba la huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra khaṇ+ḍa dum skyes ma/ ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na badz+ra rin chen rdo rje/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra chang tshong ma/ shoṇ+ḍī nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ha ya rta mgrin/ grī wa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra warmi ṇī ye 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nam mkha'i snying po/ oṃ badz+ra ā ka sha gar+bha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra shin tu dpa' mo/ su bī re huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra he ru ka huṃ hūm̐ he ru ka phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra stobs chen ma/ ma hā ba le huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pad+ma na pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug rte shwa ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra warti nī ye 'khor los sgyur ma/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa na ya rnam par snang mdzad/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra brtson 'grus chen mo/

ma hā bīr+ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra badz+ra rdo rje sems dpa'/ sa twa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ya mi nī ye huṃ hūm̐ gshin rje'i bu mo/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā stobs po che/ ba la huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ya mi nī ye huṃ hūm̐ gshin rje ma/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dzñā na ḍā ga huṃ hūm̐ ye shes mkha' 'gro/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sañtsa li nī ye huṃ hūm̐ kun du g.yo byed ma/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dhair+ya huṃ hūm̐ blo brtan/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tra si nī ye huṃ hūm̐ skrag byed ma/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra brtan pa/ s+thair+ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍi ke gtum mo// huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mok+ṣa huṃ hūm̐ thar pa/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra swa ra swa tī ye dbyangs can ma/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ye shes ma/ dzñā na huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra its+tsha sid+dha 'dod grub ma/ ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra u thabs/ pā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma 'bar ba chen mo/ hā dz+wa lī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta thugs kyi rdo rje/ badz+ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ༈ /snying po'i 'khor lo'i sngags rnams ni/ oṃ badz+ra rdo rje 'chang ma/ badz+ra dha rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃbadz+ra rdo rje 'chang ba/ badz+ra dha rā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mi bskyod ma/ oṃ badz+ra ak+ṣo bh+ya yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mi bskyod pa/ ak+ṣo bh+ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bai rnam snang ma/ ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro rnam snang*/ tsa na huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rin chen gtsug mo/ rat+ni shi khi nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rin chen gtsug rat+na shi khi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pad+ma pad+ma gar dbang ma/ nar+t+te shwa rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pad+ma nar+t+te shwa pad+ma gar dbang*/ ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra a mo ghī

don yod/ ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra a mo gha don yod/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra lo tsa nī spyan ma/ ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra lo tsa na huṃ spyan/ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mā ma mā ma kī ma/ ki ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mā ma huṃ hūm̐ mā ma kī pha/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pāṇ+ḍa ra ba si nī ye huṃ hūm̐ gos dkar mo/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gos dkar/ pāṇ+ḍa rwa ba sa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tā ra yai huṃ hūm̐ sgrol ma/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tā ra huṃ hūm̐ sgrol ba/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rū pa badz+re huṃ hūm̐ gzugs rdo rje ma/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rū pa badz+ra huṃ hūm̐ gzugs rdo rje/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da badz+re huṃ hūm̐ sgra rdo rje ma/

phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sgra rdo rje/ shab+da badz+ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dri rdo rje ma/ gan+dha badz+re huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dri rdo rje/ gan+dha badz+ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rā sa ro rdo rje ma/ badz+re huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rā sa badz+ra huṃ hūm̐ ro rdo rje/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra spar+ṣa badz+re reg rdo rje ma/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra spar+ṣe badz+ra reg rdo rje/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dharma dhā tu badz+re chos dbyings rdo rje ma/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra chos dbyings rdo rje/ dharma dhā tu badz+ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra k+ṣi sa snying mo/ ti gar+bhī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sa'i snying po/ k+ṣi ti gar+bhā huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kha nam mkha'i snying po ma/ gar+bhī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kha gar+bhā huṃ hūm̐ nam mkha'i snying po/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra phyag na rdo rje mo/ badz+ra pā ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra badz+ra pā phyag na rdo rje/ ṇa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra lo ka nā thi nī ye 'jig rten mgon mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra 'jig rten mgon po/ lo ka nā tha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sarba a sgrib pa kun sel ma/ wa ra ṇa niṣ+kaṃ bhi nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sgrib pa kun sel/ sarba a wa ra ṇa niṣ+kaṃ bha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kun tu bzang mo/ sa man+ta bha drī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sa mān+ta bha dra kun tu bzang po/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rat+no lkī ye rin chen sgrol ma/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rin chen sgron pa/ rat+no lki huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra nairāt+mi ye huṃ hūm̐ bdag med ma/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bdag med pa/ nairāt+ma huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bhṛ ku ṭi kī ye huṃ hūm̐ khro gnyer ma/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bhṛ khro gnyer/

oṃ badz+ra bai she huṃ hūm̐ rje'u rigs/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra shū dri dmangs mo/ ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra shū dra dmangs pho/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gtum mo/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa li nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa la huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gtum pho/ oṃ badz+ra shwa tsi nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ khyi 'tshed ma/ oṃ badz+ra shwa tsi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ khyi 'tshed pho/ oṃ badz+ra ḍom+bi nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ g.yung mo/ oṃ badz+ra ḍo g.yung pho/ m+bi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra na ṭī ye huṃ hūm̐ gar mo/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gar pho/ na ṭa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ka pā li nī ye thod pa can mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ thod pa can pho/ oṃ badz+ra ka pā la huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kai nya ba mo/ brti ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kai ba nya pa pho/ rta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra be ṇu na ṭī ye smyig ma'i gar mkhan mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra be ṇu smyig ma'i gar mkhan pho/ na ṭa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dung mkhan mo/ shaṃ kha kī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra shaṃ kha ka huṃ hūm̐ dung mkhan pho/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tan+tu bā ya kī ye thags mkhan mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tan+tu bā ya thags mkhan pho/ ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra khur ba mkhan mo/ kaṇ+ḍu kī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kāṇ+ḍu ka khur ba mkhan pho/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kaṣ+ṭha ka ri kī ye huṃ hūm̐ shing bzo mo/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kaṣ+ṭha ka ri ka huṃ hūm̐ shing bzo pho/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mā la kī ye huṃ hūm̐ phreng mkhan mo/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mā lā phreng mkhan pho/ ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tai tshos mkhan mo/ lī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tai la tshos mkhan pho/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ts+tshi yī ye huṃ hūm̐ srin bal byed ma/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ts+tshi ya huṃ hūm̐

srin bal byed pho/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dū tī ya huṃ hūm̐ pho nya mo/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dū ta pho nya ba/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ko sha kā ri ye huṃ hūm̐ rus pa bzo ma/ phaṭa/ rus pa bzo ba/ oṃ badz+ra ko sha kā ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ha ta bshang 'phyag ma gā ṭī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ha ta gā ṭa huṃ hūm̐ bshang 'phyag pho/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ga ṇi kī ye rtsis mkhan ma/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ga ṇi ka huṃ hūm̐ rtsis mkhan pha/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kaṇ+ṇa bā li ye huṃ hūm̐ chang 'tshong ma/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kaṇ+ṇa bā la huṃ hūm̐ chang 'tshong pha/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ku ya ldum ra'i gnyer pa mo/ rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ldum ra'i gnyer pa/ oṃ badz+ra ku ya rā huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rā rgyal pos bkrabs ma/ dzā bha ṭī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rā rgyal pos bkrabs pa/ dzā bha ṭa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra khaṭ+ṭī kī ye shan pa mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ shan pa/ oṃ badz+ra khaṭ+ṭī ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tām+bo la wa so rtsi 'tshong bar byed mo/ kri yī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tam+bo la wa so rtsi 'tshong bar byed pho/ kri ya ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sau bar+ṇaṇa kā gser mgar mo/ rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sau bar+ṇaṇa gser mgar pho/ kā ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra lo hā rī lcags mgar mo/ ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra lcags mgar pho/ lo hā ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma ṇi hā rī ye nor bu rgyud ma/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra nor bu rgyud pho/ ma ṇi hā ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ba kī ye nags pa mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ba nags pha/ ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra m+le kla glo ma/ ts+tshau ḍī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra m+le ts+tshau ḍa huṃ hūm̐

kla glo pha/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pa ṇi tshong pa mo/ dzī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pa ṇi dza tshong pa/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pa tha ra ga rdo bzo mo/ dhī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pa tha ra ga dhā ka huṃ hūm̐ rdo bzo pa/ phaṭa/ zhing las ma/ oṃ badz+ra kṛ ṣi kā rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kṛ ṣi zhing las pa/ kā ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsar+m+ma ka rī ye huṃ hūm̐ ko lpags mkhan mo/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsar+m+ma ko lpags mkhan pho/ ka ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bha dra kalpa bud+dhe bh+yo huṃ hūm̐ bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas/ phaṭa/ (shar sgo) oṃ badz+ra kā kā s+ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ khwa gdong ma/ (byang ) oṃ badz+ra u lū kā s+ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'ug gdong ma/ (nub) oṃ badz+ra sha nā s+ye khyi gdong ma/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ (lho) oṃ badz+ra sū ka rā s+ye huṃ hūm̐ phag gdong ma/ phaṭa/ (mer/) oṃ badz+ra ya gshin rje brtan ma/ mā dā dhī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ (bden bral/) oṃ badz+ra ya gshin rje pho nya mo/ ma dū tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ (rlung*/) oṃ badz+ra ya gshin rje mche ba ma/ ma daṃṣ+ṭ+wi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ (dbang ldan/) oṃ badz+ra ya gshin rje 'joms ma/ ma ma tha nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ༈ /nam mkha'i 'khor lo'i sngags rnams ni/ oṃ badz+ra mi'am ci mo/ kin+na rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kin+na ra huṃ hūm̐ mi'am ci/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dha dri za mo/ hā rī ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dri za pho/ gan+dha hā rā ṇa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mo/ hu ṭu kī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sor bzhag oṃ badz+ra pho/ hu ṭu ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sor bzhag oṃ badz+ra rnga pa ṭa ba can mo/ pā ṭa pī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho/

pā ṭa ba huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bī pi wang ma/ ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bī ṇa ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra gling bu ma/ baṃ sīṃ ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ baṃ sa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mu kun+dha ye rnga zlum ma/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mu kun+da huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra murdzī ye huṃ hūm̐ rdza rnga ma/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra murdza huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gag+ga ri mo/ ka ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ gag+ga ri ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kāṃ pī ye cha lang ma/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kāṃ pa huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ mo/ oṃ badz+ra shai len+d+ri kī ye huṃ hūm̐ sor bzhag phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra shai len+d+ri ka huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gī tī ye huṃ hūm̐ glu ma/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gī ta huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ka ra ṭī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mo/ oṃ badz+ra ka ra ṭa huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ta ma ḍā yai huṃ hūm̐ ḍa ma ḍa mchog ma/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ta ma ḍa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+yā yai huṃ hūm̐ gar ma/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+ye huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ sgeg mo oṃ badz+ra lā s+yā yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ lā s+ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ṭa mo/ k+kī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sor bzhag oṃ badz+ra pho/ ṭāk+ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tā li sha ra ṇā ye mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ta li sha ra pho/ ṇa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dun+du bhi rnga chen mo/ kī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dun+du bhi ka huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mau mo/ drī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mau dri huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tā nī ye huṃ hūm̐ rgyud can ma/ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra tā na huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ badz+ra mā tu nī ye huṃ hūm̐ mo/ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra mā tu huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mo/ oṃ badz+ra nā la bī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ nā la bā huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mo/ ḍham+ba kī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ ḍham+ba ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ḍa cang te'u mo/ ma rū ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ḍa ma rū huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ṭuṇ+ṭu kī ye huṃ hūm̐ mo/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ṭuṇ+ṭu ka huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ zangs dung ma/ oṃ badz+ra kaṃ ha lī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra kaṃ ha la huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ra dung ma/ o ra kī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra o ra ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bhu kī ye huṃ hūm̐ mo/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bhu ki huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍī ye huṃ hūm̐ dril bu ma/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ dril chung ma/ oṃ badz+ra kiṃ ki nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kiṃ ki ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra g.yer kha ma ghur+ghu rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ghur+ghu rī pho/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ḍa ko li kī ye huṃ hūm̐ mo/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ḍa ko li ka huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra shaṃ khī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dung ma/ oṃ badz+ra shaṃ kha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra gho ṣa ba tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dbyangs ldan ma/ oṃ badz+ra gho ṣa ba ti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra pa 'khor ma mchog gi dbang phyug ma/ r+ṣa drā ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ par+ṣa dra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ༈ /rlung gi 'khor lo'i sngags rnams ni/ oṃ badz+ra ga ru ḍī ye mkha' lding ma/ ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ga ru ḍa huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra haṃ sī ye huṃ hūm̐ ngang mo/ phaṭa/

pho/ oṃ badz+ra haṃ su huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsi bkra ba mo/ trī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bya rog ma/ kā kī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ kā ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bya gar mo/ ba kī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ba ka pho/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tit+tī ri kā ye sreg pa mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tit+tī ri ka huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rma bya mo/ ma yū rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma yū ra pho/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tā mra tsū ḍī ye zangs kyi gtsug phud ma/

huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kak+kā bi pho/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sor bzhag oṃ badz+ra so bya mo/ dza la kā kī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra dza la kā ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra byi la mo/ bi lā ḍī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bi lā ḍi pho/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra nā la gri bā ya huṃ hūm̐ lcug ma'i mgrin pa mo/ phaṭa/ oṃ pho/ badz+ra nā la gri ba huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mo/ oṃ badz+ra sā ri kā ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sā ri ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra khra mo/ se nā ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra se na pho/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gur kum lce can ma/ oṃ badz+ra kuṃ ku mā lo mā ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra kuṃ ku ma lo ma huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mo/ wā ḍi rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra wā ḍi pho/ ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kā ka mo/ dzaṃ gha kī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kā ka dzaṃ gha ka huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sa mī ye hor mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra kaṃ ka mo/ le ha sriṣ+ṭhā ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra le ha pho/ sriṣ+ṭha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mo/ dad+da rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dad+da ri huṃ pho/ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mṛ gā ri ṇī ye ri dwags dgra ma huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mṛ gā ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ri dwags dgra/ ༈ /sa'i 'khor lo'i sngags rnams ni/ oṃ badz+ra siṃ ghī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ seng ge mo/ oṃ badz+ra siṃ ghi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra byā gh+rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ stag mo/ oṃ badz+ra byā gh+ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra bhim+bhī ye mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bhim+bha huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sha shī ye huṃ hūm̐ ri bong ma/

phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra sha shi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra glang chen mo/ ga dzī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ga glang chen/ dza huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mṛ gī ye huṃ hūm̐ ri dwags mo phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ri dwags mṛ ga huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mārdza rī kā byi la'i gdong ma/ ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ mārdza ri ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gā bī ba gdong ma/ ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ gā ba huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma hi ṣī ye huṃ hūm̐ ma he mo/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma hi ṣa huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tu rā gī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tu ra pho/ ga huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dzaṃ bu kī ye lce spyang mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dzaṃ pho/ bu ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍī ye bse mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ 'bri gdong ma/ oṃ badz+ra tsa ma ra ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsa ma ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra mu ṣī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ byi ba'i gdong ma/ oṃ pho/ badz+ra mu ṣa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bong mo/ garda bhī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pho/ badz+ra garda bha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mo/ oṃ badz+ra bhi ṭī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bhi ṭi pho/ hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sor bzhag oṃ badz+ra ri mo/ a dza kī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra a dza ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lug mo/ oṃ badz+ra e ḍā kī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra e ḍa ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra shwa khyi mo nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra shwa pho/ na huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sū ka rī yai huṃ hūm̐ phag mo/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ sū ka ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bhal+lī ye dom mo/ hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bhal+li huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/

pho/ mo/ oṃ badz+ra daṇ+ḍa rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sor bzhag oṃ badz+ra daṇ+ḍa ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra mau dzñā kī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mo/ oṃ badz+ra mau dzñā ka huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sa sa rā ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dred mo/ oṃ badz+ra sa sa ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra sgeg mo/ bi lā sī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ bi lā sa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra nags mo/ a ra ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra a pho/ ra ṇa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bri ha shwa khyi chen mo/ ni kā ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bri ha shwa pho/ ni ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dro ṇa kā kī ye huṃ hūm̐ bya rog chen mo/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dro ṇa pho/ kā ki huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sardū lī kha sgo ma/ ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ sardū li huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra byā ḍā sbrul mo/ ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra byā ḍa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bkra mo/ badz+ra tsi tri nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tri na huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rnga mo/ uṣ+ṭi kī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra uṣ+ṭi ka huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra na ku lī ye sre mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra na ku li huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kri kī ye huṃ hūm̐ rtsangs mo/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kri ka huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ oṃ phug pa mo/ badz+ra gu hā ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ gu ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gra ma grong na gnas pa'i mchog ma/ bā si nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gra ma bā pho/ sa na huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bha dra bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas/ kalpa bud+dhe bh+yo huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tshangs ma/ brāh+ma ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā shwa rī ye huṃ hūm̐

dbang phyug chen mo/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kau gzhon nu ma/ ma rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra khyab 'jug ma/ biṣ+ṇa bī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra wā rā hī ye huṃ hūm̐ phag mo/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra in+d+rā ye huṃ hūm̐ dbang po/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gtum mo// oṃ badz+ra ma hā lak+ṣ+mī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dpal chen mo/ ༈ /dkyil 'khor gsum pa'i dang po me'i 'khor lo'i sngags rnams ni/ oṃ badz+ra de wī ye huṃ hūm̐ lha mo/ phaṭa/ lha/ oṃ badz+ra di wa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra klu mo nā gī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra klu/ nā ga huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣi ṇī ye gnod sbyin mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ 'byung mo/ oṃ badz+ra bhū ti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra bhū ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma mo/ mā tā ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra mā ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bhār+yā chung ma/ ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bhār+ya huṃ hūm̐ khyo/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bha gi nī ye sring mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bha gi ming pho/ na hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra du hi tā ye huṃ hūm̐ bu mo/ phaṭa/ bu pho/ oṃ badz+ra du hi ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bha gi ni yi kā sring mo'i bu mo/ ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bha gi ni yi ka pho/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pi tur+bha gi nī ye pha'i sring mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pi tur+bha gi na pho/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sa tsa ma tu zhang po'i chung ma/ la s+ya bhār+ya kā ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sa tsa ma pho/ tu la s+ya bhār+ya ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ chung ma'i spun zla mo/ badz+ra bhār+yā bha gi nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bhar+yā bha gi na

pho/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mā tā ye chung ma'i phyi mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra mā ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra de nyid kyi pha'i ma/ ta s+yai ba pi turmā tri kā ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pho/ badz+ra te s+yai ba pi turmā tri ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bhar+yā bi ta ma hī chung ma'i phyi mo/ ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bhār+yā bi ta ma hā huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ chung ma'i phyi mo'i thabs/ oṃ ma'i ma la/ badz+ra mā tu mā ta ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mā turmā ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ thabs/ oṃ badz+ra ban+dha wī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gnyen mo/ oṃ badz+ra ban+dha wa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ thabs/ oṃ badz+ra mā tur+bha gi nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ma'i spun zla mo/ oṃ badz+ra mā tur+bha gi na huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ thabs/ oṃ badz+ra bha gi ni yi kā ye spun zla'i bu mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bha gi ni yi kā huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de'i thabs/ oṃ badz+ra swaḥmā turmā tā bha gi nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rang gi phyi mo'i spun zla mo/ oṃ badz+ra swaḥmā turmā thabs/ tā bha gi ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bha gi ni yī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ spun zla'i bu mo/ oṃ badz+ra bha gi ni ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ thabs/ oṃ badz+ra de'i bu mo/ a s+ya pu tri kā ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra a s+ya pu tra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ thabs/ oṃ badz+ra pi turmā tā ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pha'i ma/ oṃ badz+ra pi turmā ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de'i thabs/ oṃ phyi mo/ badz+ra pi tā ma hī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pi tā ma hā huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ thabs/ oṃ badz+ra khu bo'i chung ma/ pi tu lā s+ya bhār+ya kā ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ thabs/ oṃ badz+ra pi tu lā s+ya bhār+ya ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bu mo'i bu'i chung ma/ du hi tā pu tra bhār+yā ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/

thabs/ oṃ badz+ra du hi tā pu tra bhār+ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bhār+ya ya bha gi nī ye huṃ hūm̐ chung ma'i spun zla mo/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bhār+yā ya bhā gi na huṃ hūm̐ thabs/ phaṭa/ rang gi pha'i sring mo/ oṃ badz+ra swaḥpi tur+bhā gi nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra swaḥpi tur+bha gi na huṃ hūm̐ thabs/ phaṭa/ de'i bu mo/ oṃ badz+ra pu trī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra thabs/ pu tra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ta s+yai wa tu swāḥgo tra de nyid kyi ni rang rigs skyes ma/ dzī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ thabs/ badz+ra ta s+yai wa tu swaḥgo tra dzā huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bha tā ya bhār+yā spun zla'i chung ma/ ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bhā tā ya bhār+yā huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ thabs/ oṃ badz+ra pu trī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de'i bu mo/ oṃ badz+ra pu tra huṃ hūm̐ thabs/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pu tra s+yai ba tu bhār+ya kā ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bu'i chung ma/ oṃ badz+ra pu tra s+yai ba tu bhār+ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ thabs/ oṃ badz+ra du hi hā ya bhā tri mā tuḥpu tra s+yai ba tu swa bu mo'i khyo'i ma/ bu de nyid kyi sgyug mo/ srik+kā ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra thabs/ du hi tā ya bhā tri mā tuḥpu tra s+yai ba tu swa srik+ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra du hi tā ye bu mo/ huṃ hūm̐ thabs/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra du hi tā huṃ hūm̐ thabs/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pu trī ye huṃ hūm̐ bu'i bu mo/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra thabs/ pu tra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ༈ /chu'i 'khor lo'i sngags rnams ni/ oṃ badz+ra ma ka rī ye huṃ hūm̐ sre mo/ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra ma ka ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rus sbal mo/ kūrmā ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra kurmā huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mats+tsha ye huṃ hūm̐ nya mo/ phaṭa/

oṃ badz+ra mañtsa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra sbal mo/ biṃ gī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ biṃ gi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rus sbal mo/ kats+tshā pī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kats+tsha pa huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra o dri kā ye chu sram mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra o dri ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra su tsī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sdig nag mo/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra su tsi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mo/ gag+ga rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sor bzhag oṃ badz+ra gag+ga pho/ ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sor gzhag oṃ badz+ra shi lī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/

sor bzhag pho/ oṃ badz+ra shi sor bzhag li huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dzā la gu hā ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ chu'i phug mo/ oṃ badz+ra dzā la gu ha pho/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ki ṭi mu khā ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ srin bu'i gdong ma/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ ki ṭi mu khā huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra chag mo/ pha ṭiṃ gī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pha ṭiṃ gi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra karka ṭī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ka ka ru ma/ oṃ badz+ra karka ṭa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra su yī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ su sa mo/ oṃ badz+ra su yi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra mu ṣi kā ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ chu bya'i gdong ma/ oṃ badz+ra mu ṣi ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra pip+pā ṭi mu khī grog ma'i gdong ma/ ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pip+pā ṭi mu kha huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ chu'i mi mo/ oṃ badz+ra dza la ni rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra dza la na ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rgod ma/ ba ḍa bī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pho/ badz+ra ba ḍa ba huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dan+ti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ glang chen ma/ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra dan+ti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra byā gh+rī ye huṃ hūm̐ stag mo/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ byā gh+ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dzaṃ bu kī ye lce spyang ma/ hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dzaṃ bu ka pho/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dza la a hī ye chu sbrul mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ dza la a hi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra shaṃ khī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dung mo/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra shaṃ kha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kar+pa dī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'gron bu mo/ oṃ badz+ra kar+pa da huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra muk+ti kī ye huṃ hūm̐ nya phyis mo/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra muk+ti ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/
