pho/ oṃ badz+ra ma ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐/ nor bu ma/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra ma ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dzi gu rī ye huṃ hūm̐ sor bzhag phaṭa/ mo/ oṃ badz+ra dzi gu ri pho huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra lī sī ye khengs mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra lī pho/ si huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dud+du mo/ rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sor bzhag sor bzhag oṃ badz+ra dud+du ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra mo/ kar+ṇo ṭī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sor bzhag sor bzhag oṃ badz+ra kar+ṇo ṭa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra pha ṭa kī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mo/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra pha ṭa ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sor bzhag oṃ badz+ra dā ba kī ye huṃ hūm̐ mo/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ da ba ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sor bzhag sor bzhag oṃ badz+ra kri mī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mo/ oṃ badz+ra kri mi pho/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sor bzhag sor bzhag oṃ badz+ra dzu ṣi dzu ṣī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sor bzhag sor bzhag oṃ badz+ra dzu ṣi dzu ṣi hruṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra daṃ sha kī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sha sbrang mo/ oṃ badz+ra daṃ sha ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ nag mo/ badz+ra ka lī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kā la huṃ pho/ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ༈ /ye shes 'khor lo'i sngags rnams ni/ oṃ badz+ra ti til mchog ma/ lot+ta mī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ti lot+ta mā pho/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra a ti su khā ye huṃ hūm̐ phul du bde ma/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra a ti su kha huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra a pa sa ra sī ye lha'i bu mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra a pa sa ra pho/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā ra tī ye dga' chen mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā ra ta pho/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ra tī ye huṃ hūm̐

dga' ba mo/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ra ti huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ra tā khyī ye huṃ hūm̐ dga' grags mo/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ra tā khya pho/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pad+mi nī ye bde chen mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pad+mi pho/ ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra shaṃ khī nī ye dung can ma/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra shaṃ khi pho/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tri nī ye huṃ hūm̐ sna tshogs ma/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra ka pho/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ga dzi nī ye glang chen ma/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ga dza huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā rū pī ye gzugs chen ma/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma pho/ hā rū pa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra su rū pā ye huṃ hūm̐ gzugs mdzes ma/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra su rū pa pho/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kān+tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'dod chags mo/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ kān+ti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bi la si nī ye rnam sgeg mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bi lā si huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ bde ba mo/ oṃ badz+ra su khī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra su kha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pa kā mī ye huṃ hūm̐ me tog 'dod ma/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pa kā ma huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra ku mu dī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ut+pal dkar mo/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra ku mu da huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra nī ut+pal sngon mo/ lot+pa lī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra nī lot+pa la pho/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sun+da rī mdzes ma/ ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra sun+da ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rā gī 'dod chags mo/ ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rā ga huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā rā gī ye 'dod chags chen mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā rā ga huṃ hūm̐

pho/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ra mā khyi ye rol grags ma/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ra mā khya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā ra ma kī ye rol chen mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā ra pho/ ma ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma da nī ye huṃ hūm̐ myos ma/ phaṭa/ oṃ pho/ badz+ra ma da na huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma da na prī yī ye huṃ hūm̐ myos dga' ma/ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra ma da na prī ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kā mi nī ye huṃ hūm̐ 'dod ma/ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra kā mi ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā mi nī ye huṃ hūm̐ 'dod chen mo/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ ma hā kā mi ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra su khod+bha bde las byung ma/ wā ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho su khod+bha wa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra su kha bde ldan ma/ ma tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pho/ badz+ra su kha ma ti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra prī ya ta mī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mthun mchog ma/ oṃ badz+ra prī ya pho/ ta ma huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra byams mo/ pri ma kī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pre ma ka pho/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra swau bha gya skal bzang ldan ma/ ma tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sau ma bha gya ma ti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra sau bha gī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ skal bzang ma/ oṃ badz+ra sau bha ga huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra me ṇu kī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dma' ba mo/ oṃ badz+ra me ṇu ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra pra t+yuṃ na kī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhum pa mo/ oṃ pho/ badz+ra pra t+yuṃ na ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dzā ti rū pī ye huṃ hūm̐ skyes gzugs ma/ phaṭa/ oṃ pho/ badz+ra dzā ti rū pa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bha dra bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas rnams/

kalpa bud+dhe bh+yo huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dkar mo/ gau rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsau rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ chom rkun ma/ ro langs ma/ oṃ badz+ra be tā lī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra za phod ma/ ghasma rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sbos mo/ oṃ badz+ra puk+ka sī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sha wa rā ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ri khrod ma/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa lī ye gtum mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ g.yung mo/ oṃ badz+ra ḍoṃ bi nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ༈ /dkyil 'khor bzhi pa'i thugs kyi 'khor lo'i sngags rnams ni/ oṃ badz+ra klu mo/ nā gī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra nā ga pho/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gnod sbyin mo/ yak+ṣi nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gnod sbyin/ yak+ṣa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bhū ti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ 'byung mo/ phaṭa/ oṃ pho/ badz+ra bhū ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pre ta nī ye yi dwags mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra pre ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dmyal mo/ badz+ra na ra kī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra na ra ka dmyal ba pho/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mnar med mo/ a wī tsī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ a wā tsi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pā ta ltung ba mo/ kī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pā ta pho/ ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra an+ta rī ye bar med ma/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra an+ta ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra kum+bhi kī ye bum pa mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kum+bha ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra ya ma s+t+ri yā ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gshin rje mo/ oṃ badz+ra ya ma pu ru ṣa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra kā la sū trī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ thig nag mo/ oṃ badz+ra kā la sū tra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra ku ku lī ye

me 'dag mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ku ku li huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra tsha ba mo/ ta pa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ta pa pho/ na huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pra ta pa nī ye rab tu tsha ba mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pra ta pa na huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra ngu 'bod ma/ rau ra bī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ rau ra ba huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ngu 'bod chen mo/ ma hā rau ra bī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā pho/ rau ra ba huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tai la pa tsī ye mar nag tu 'tshed ma/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tai la pho/ pa tsa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dwī parba ri gnyis su 'tshir ma/ tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ dī parba ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sdang ba mo/ dwe ṣ+ṣi ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dwe ṣa pho/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mo hī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rmongs pa mo/ oṃ badz+ra mo hā huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra phrag dog ma/ ir+ṣ+yi ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ir+ṣ+ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ chags pa mo/ oṃ badz+ra rā gī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra rā ga huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra myos pa mo/ ma da na mā na sā rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra ma da na mā na sā ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sū tri kī ye huṃ hūm̐ ser sna'i skud pa mo/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ sū tri ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ grang ba mo/ oṃ badz+ra shī ta kī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra shī pho/ ta ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra a si ral gri'i nags ma/ bā nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra a si bā na ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra ngu ba mo/ krān+da nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra krān+da ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra dur+bha k+ṣi kā ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/

mu ge ma/ oṃ badz+ra dur+bha k+ṣi ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra ro ga kān+ta rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nad kyi dgon pa ma/ oṃ badz+ra ro ga kān+ta ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra shas+t+ra kān+ta rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mtshon gyi dgon pa mo/ oṃ badz+ra shas+t+ra kān+ta pho/ ka ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pa ṇi kān+ta rī ye chu'i dgon pa mo/ ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra pa ṇi kan+ta ri ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ral gri'i sen mo/ a si na khī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ a si na kha ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rab med ma/ bai twā ra ṇi ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bi pho/ tā ra ṇa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra k+ṣu ra dhā rī ye huṃ hūm̐ spu gri'i se mo/ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra k+ṣu ra dhā ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra kī ye huṃ hūm̐ 'khor lo ma/ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kum+bhaṇ+ḍī ye huṃ hūm̐ grul bum mo/ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra kum+bāṇ+ḍa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ༈ gsung gi 'khor lo'i sngags rnams ni/ oṃ badz+ra pū dza tsin+tī mchod ma/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pū dza tsin+ta huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bhak+ṣa tsin+tī ye za ba mo/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra bhak+ṣa tsin+ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ni dra tsin+tī ye huṃ hūm̐ gnyid ma/ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra ni dra tsin+ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra le lo ma/ ā lā s+ya tsin+tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ā lā s+ya tsin+ta huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dharma tsin+tī ye chos sems ma/ hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dharma tsin+ta pho/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bsgom sems ma/ oṃ badz+ra bhā wa tsin+tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ bhā wa tsin+ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra khyim sems ma/

gṛ ha tsin+tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gṛ ha tsin+ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra bud med sems ma/ s+t+ri tsin+tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra stī tsin+tā huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ar+tha tsin+tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ don sems ma/ oṃ badz+ra ar+tha tsin+ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra bi yo ga tsin+tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sbyor bral ma/ oṃ badz+ra bi yo ga tsin+ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra pu tra tsin+tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bu sems ma/ oṃ badz+ra pu tra tsin+ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/

oṃ badz+ra mya ngan sems ma/ sho ka tsin+tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ sho ka tsin+ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dh+yā na tsin+tī ye bsam gtan ma/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dh+yā na tsin+ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra man+t+ra dza pa tsin+ta kā ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sngags zlos ma/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra man+t+ra dza pa tsin+ta ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra hri tsin+tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ngo tsha ma/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra hri tsin+ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mā na tsin+tī ye nga rgyal ma/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mā na pho/ tsin+ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra san+ta pa tsin+tī ye gdung ba ma/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra san+ta pho/ pa tsin+ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sa twār+tha ka ra sems can don byed brtson ma/ ṇo d+ya ma tsin+tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sa twār+tha ka ra ṇo d+ya ma pho/ tsin+ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rā dza rgyal po sems ma/ tsin+tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rā dza tsin+ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra pa ra tro ha tsin+tī ye gzhan gnod ma/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pa ra tro ha tsin+ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra ye shes thob ma/ dzñā na la bha tsin+tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dzñā na la pho/ bha tsin+ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dka' thub ma/ ta pa si tsin+tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ ta pa si tsin+ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dza ra tsin+tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rgas ma/ oṃ badz+ra dza ra tsin+ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra ma ra ṇa tsin+tī ye huṃ hūm̐ 'chi sems ma/ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra ma ra ṇa tsin+tā huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bde ba ma/ oṃ badz+ra su kha tsin+tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra su pho/ kha tsin+ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra duḥkha sdug bsngal ma/ tsin+ti ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra duḥkha tsin+ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/

pho/ oṃ badz+ra a shu bha tsin+tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mi dge ma/ oṃ badz+ra a shu bha tsin+ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra a sti tsin+tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yod ma/ oṃ badz+ra a sti tsin+tā huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra nāsti tsin+tī ye huṃ hūm̐ med ma/ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra nasti tsin+ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bla ma sems ma/ gu ru tsin+tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gu ru tsin+ta huṃ hūm̐ pho/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ga ma ṇa tsin+tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'gro sems ma/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra ga ma ṇa tsin+ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bzod ma/ k+ṣe ma tsin+tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra k+ṣe ma pho/ tsin+ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ak+ṣe ma mi bzod sems ma/ tsin+tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ ak+ṣe ma tsin+ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ngal ma/ shrān+ta tsin+tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra shrān+ta pho/ tsin+ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bi shwān+ta tsin+tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ngal bso ma/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ bi shwān+ta tsin+ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bhūk+ṣi ta tsin+tī ye bkres par sems ma/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bhuk+ṣi ta tsin+ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ ༈ /sku'i 'khor lo'i sngags rnams ni/ oṃ badz+ra tsa turma hā rā dza kā yi ka tsakra brti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ rgyal chen bzhi'i 'khor lo sgyur ma/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsa turma hā rā dza kā yi ka tsakra pho/ brti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tra ya s+t+riṃ sha sum cu rtsa gsum ma/ tsakra warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tra ya s+t+riṃ pho/ sha tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ya mi tsakra warti nī 'thab bral ma/ ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra ya mi tsakra wa ti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tu ṣi ta tsakra warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dga' ldan ma/

oṃ badz+ra tu ṣi ta tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra nirma ṇa ra ta tsakra warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'phrul dga' ma/ oṃ badz+ra nirma pho/ ṇa ra ta tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pa ra nirmi ta wa sha pa ti tsakra warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed ma/ oṃ badz+ra pa ra nirmi ta wa sha pa ti tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra brah+ma kā yi ka tsakra warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ tshangs ris ma/ oṃ badz+ra brah+ma kā yi ka tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra tshangs pa mdun na 'don ma/ brah+ma pu ro ha ta tsakra warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra brah+ma pu ro hi pho/ ta tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā brah+ma ṇa tsakra tshangs chen pa'i 'khor lo bsgyur ma/ warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ ma hā brah+ma ṇa tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra 'od chung ma/ pa rī ta bhā tsakra warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pa rī ta bhā tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra tshad med 'od ma/ a pra mā ṇā bhā tsakra warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra a pra mā ṇā bhā pho/ tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ā bha su ra tsakra warti nī 'od gsal ma/ ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ā bha su ra tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra pa rī ta shu bha tsakra warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dge chung ma/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ pa ri ta shu bha tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra a pra mā ṇa shu bha tsakra warti nī ye tshad med dge ma/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra a pra mā ṇa shu bha tsakra pho/ warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra shu bha kṛsnā tsakra warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ dge rgyas ma/ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra shu bha kṛsnā tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra a na bh+ra ka tsakra

sprin med ma/ warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra a na bh+ra ka tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ om̐ badz+ra puṇ+ya pra bsod nams skyes ma/ sa ba tsakra warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ puṇ+ya pra sa ba tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bṛ hat+pha la tsakra warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'bras bu che ma/ oṃ badz+ra bṛ hat+pha la tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra a bṛ ha tsakra warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mi che ma/ oṃ badz+ra a bṛ ha tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra a ta pa tsakra warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mi gdung ma/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra a ta pa tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra su shin tu mthong ma/ dṛ sha tsakra warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra su dṛ pho/ sha tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra su dar+sha na tsakra warti nī gya nom snang ma/ ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra su dar+sha na tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra a ka niṣ+ṭha tsakra warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra a ka niṣ+ṭha tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra ā kā shā nan+t+yāya nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched ma/ ta na tsakra warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ ā kā sha nan+t+ya ya ta na tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bi dzñā nā nan+t+yā ya ta na tsakra rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched ma/ warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bi dzñā nā nan+t+yā ya ta na tsakra pho/ warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra a kiñtsa n+yā ya ci yang med pa'i skye mched ma/ ta na tsakra warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra a pho/ kiñtsa n+yā ya ta na tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra nai ba saṃ dzñā na tsakra 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi skye mched ma/ warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra nai ba saṃ dzñā nā saṃ dzñā na tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ badz+ra nā ra dmyal ba'i 'khor lo sgyur ba/ ka tsakra warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra nā ra ka tsakra pho/ warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pre ta ka tsakra warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yi dwags ma/ oṃ badz+ra pho/ pre ta ka tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tir+ya ka tsakra warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dud 'gro'i 'khor lo bsgyur ma/ oṃ badz+ra tir+ya ka tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra na ra tsakra warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mi'i 'khor lo bsgyur ma/ oṃ badz+ra na ra tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra a su ra tsakra warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lha ma yin gyi 'khor lo bsgyur ma/ oṃ badz+ra a su ra tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra bi mā ṇa zla ba'i 'khor lo bsgyur ma/ tsakra warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bi mā ṇa tsakra warti huṃ pho/ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sha ri ra bi tsakra warti nī ye nyi ma'i 'khor lo bsgyur ma/ hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra sha ri ra bi tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ya ma tsakra gshin rje'i 'khor lo bsgyur ma/ warti nī ye hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ya ma pho/ tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra in+d+ra tsakra warti nī ye dbang mo'i 'khor lo bsgyur ma/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra in+d+ra tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bha dra kalpa bud+dha bh+yo huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas rnams/ oṃ badz+ra shwe tāṃ bu dza chu skyes ma/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sor bzhag gan+dhā rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra badz+ra na ṭī ye rdo rje gar ma/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra badz+ra ba ḍa ba rdo rje rta rgod ma'i gdong ma/ mu khī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra badz+ra dz+wa la mu khī huṃ hūm̐ rdo rje 'bar zhal ma/

phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra badz+ra bhṛ ku ṭi mu khī rdo rje khro gnyer zhal ma/ ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra badz+ra khaṇ+ḍī ye rdo rje 'thub ma/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍī ye huṃ hūm̐ rdo rje gtum mo/ phaṭa/ de ltar dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi// gsang sngags dag par bris pa las// byung ba'i dge bas 'gro kun gyi// mtshan rtog mtha' dag zhi gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni slob dpon chen po dzā ya se nas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs ltar bris pa ste/ 'on kyang gzhung der yi ge pas rim gyis ma dag par gyur pa rnams/ bod dpe mang po dang*/ rgyud kyi sngags btu ba'i skabs rnams la brten nas dag par bgyis shing*/ skad dod kyi mchan bus kyang gsal bar byas pa 'di ni/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por bris pa'i yi ge pa ni dge slong bsod nams rin chen no// slan chad 'dri ba rnams kyis yi ge dbu can du 'dri ba dang*/ gcod mtshams dang ring thung mchan sogs 'di kho na ltar du bya'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ bha wan+tu// // ༄༅// dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor chen po mchod pa'i cho ga bsod nams rin po che'i mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor chen po mchod pa'i cho ga bsod nams rin po che'i mdzod ces bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// bsod nams chu gter dge legs gting mtha' yas// thun mong mchog gi dngos grub nor bus gang*// phrin las rnam bzhi'i chu rgyun rtag 'bab pa// rje btsun ma dros mtsho can la phyag 'tshal// mchod sprin rgya mtsho bsam yas kyis// dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho ma lus pa// cho ga rgya mtshos mchod pa'i tshul// bsod nams rgya mtsho spel phyir bri// 'di la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi dang po ni/ lha sta gon gyi thig btab pa'i mda' yab kyi steng dbang ldan du bsang gtor/

de nas g.yas skor gyis shar gyi tshangs thig gi steng du/ zhabs bsil/ de bzhin du mer mchod yon/ lhor me tog srin por bdug spos/ nub tu mar me/ rlung du dri chab/ byang du zhal zas te spyi'i mchod pa bsham/ 'byor na phyogs bzhi nas de 'dra ba'i mchod pa tshar re bkod/ bsang gtor dang dri chab kyi steng du ku sha'i 'thor yab re gzhag go /de'i nang 'dod snam gyi thig gi steng du sgos kyi mchod pa rnams bshams te/ de'ang lha grangs dang mnyam pa'am/ ma 'byor na/ gtso bo la lnga 'gyur du bshad pa/ gzhan rnams la lha'i sde tshan dang mthun par mdzad/ shar gyi tshangs thig gi steng du gtso bo'i mar me gcig de'i g.yon du zhal zas/ g.yas su ga pur dang a ka ru sbyar ba'i spos rengs bkod/ lho'i dbus su thig le'i 'khor lo'i lha mo rnams kyi dang*/ nub kyi dbus su yum gyi/ byang gi dbus su rigs bdag thams cad la gcig bsham/ de rnams dbus drang por byas pa'i dbang ldan nas shar phyogs su/ gtso bo'i gcig 'khor lo gsum la re re bskal bzang la gcig sgo mtshams ma rnams la gcig ste/ dkyil 'khor dang po'i lha rnams kyi mchod pa bsham/ de bzhin du lhor dkyil 'khor gnyis pa dang*/ nub tu dkyil 'khor gsum pa dang*/ byang du dkyil 'khor bzhi pa'i lha rnams kyi mchod pa bzang zhing mdzes par bsham/ bsang gtor gyi lho dang mchod yon gyi byang du/ bzed zhal gyi snod gnyis kyang bzhag gzhan yang gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ gos zung dang*/ dar gyi lda ldi sogs ci 'byor pa bsham mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ phyi'i mchod pa dang*/ yid las byung ba dang*/ nang gi mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa'i mchod pa'o// dang po ni/ mdun gyi mchod pa rnams dum skyes mas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i bsang gtor/ zhabs bsil/

mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las grub pa/ ngo bo bzang zhing gtsang ba/ yul nam mkha'i mtha' khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ci srid gnas kyi bar du rgyun mi chad par gyur par bsams la/ so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas thal mo sbyar la/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i// sngags kyi bsang gtor mchog 'di dag /mchog tu gus pas khyed la 'bul// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// zhes dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī ḍā ka sā ga ra maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa thams cad kyi sngon du sbyar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes dang*/ phyag rgyas bsang gtor 'bul/ de bzhin du/ gong 'og 'dra ba la/ zhabs bsil mchog 'di dag ces dang*/ sngar gyi sngags kyi rjes su/ oṃ pra wa ra sat+kā ra pa d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas zhabs bsil/ yon chab mchog 'di dag ces dang*/ oṃ pra wa ra sat+kā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon dang*/ oṃ lha yi me tog shin tu dmar// dri zhim shin tu mdzes pa ni// me tog de ring bzhes nas su// 'di la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ zhes pas me tog dang*/ oṃ tsan+dan ga pur dang bcas pa'i// dri zhim spos me dge ba 'di// mthu dang bcas par bya ba'i phyir// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ zhes pas bdug spos dang*/ oṃ mar me 'od zer 'bar ba ni// ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa 'joms byed pa// lha yi mig 'byed bkra shis pa// mar me khyed kyis bzhes su gsol// oṃ āḥbadz+ra dī pe hūm̐/ zhes pas mar me dang*/ oṃ sna tshogs lha yi dri zhim pa// sna tshogs ga pur rnam brgyan pas// sna tshogs yi ge hūm̐ las byung*// dri 'di 'bul te bzhes su gsol// oṃ āḥbadz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐/

zhes pas dri dang*/ kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa'i// bza' ba mchog dang yang dag ldan// thams cad sbyar ba'i bshos 'di dag /'bul gyis yang dag bzhes su gsol// oṃ āḥbadz+ra nai wi d+ye hūm̐/ zhes pas zhal zas dang*/ pa ṭa ha dang cang te'u dang*// rnga dang dung sogs sgra dbyangs dang*// yid 'phrog sil snyan sna tshogs kyis// he ru ka dpal sogs la 'bul// oṃ āḥbadz+ra shap+ta hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing rol mo ci 'byor pa dkrol la/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra/ pra tsa li ni/ pra dzñā pā ra mi tā nā da/ swa bhā we ta/ badz+ra satwa hṛ da yaṃ san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod do// de'ang slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du phyag 'tshal te 'dug la/ tshigs bcad 'don pa'i tshe thal mo sbyar/ oṃ sarba sogs la pad skor bya/ so so'i sngags brjod pa'i tshe mchod pa rnams dbul te/ bsang gtor gyi tshe/ ku shas bsang gtor blangs te/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor du gtor/ zhabs bsil dang*/ mchod yon rang rang gi bzed zhal du 'bul/ spyi'i me tog gi snod nas blangs la dkyil 'khor du gtor/ bdug spos dang*/ mar me so so la reg ste/ dbul pa'i tshul bya/ ku shas dri bzangs blangs la dkyil 'khor du gtor te nyer spyod kyis mchod pa'o// de nas bdud rtsi lnga'i btung ba dang*/ ldag dang gzhibs pa'i kha zas mchog /oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis rab bsngags pa// he ru ka la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā warta ya ā warta ya ho/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye bas/ bza' btung sna tshogs 'bul/ reg na bde ba lha yi gos// stod smad mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan// rnam par bkra ba'i gos zung gis// he ru ka dpal 'khor bcas mchod// oṃ āḥbadz+ra was se hūm̐/ zhes pas gos zung lnga las mi nyung ba 'bul/

bza' btung dang gos zung gnyis nyer spyod gyi gong du/ dkyil chog gnyis char las 'byung yang lag len bde bas 'dir byas so// gnyis pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nas a ā sogs bcu drug las skyes pa'i rig ma bcu drug dpag tu med pa spros nas/ dkyil 'khor ba rnams la mchod par bsams la/ so so'i phyag rgya rnams bcas la/ dbang sngon mdog mtshungs rdo rje pi wang ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs pi wang sgra yis mchod// oṃ badz+ra wī ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang*/ de bzhin du rkang pa bar ma gnyis thams cad la 'dra bar sbyar la/ gser bzang mdog mtshungs rdo rje gling bu ma/ sna tshogs= /nam mkha'= /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gling bu'i sgra yis mchod// oṃ badz+ra waṃ se hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pad+ma rā ga'i mdog mtshungs rnga zlum ma// sna tshogs= /nam mkha'= /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnga zlum sgra yis mchod// oṃ badz+ra mṛ taṃ gi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mar gad mdog mtshungs rdo rje rdza rnga ma// sna tshogs= /nam mkha'=// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rdza rnga'i sgra yis mchod// oṃ badz+ra murdzi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ li khri'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje bzhad pa ma// sna tshogs= /nam mkha'= /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bzhad pa'i bde bas mchod// oṃ badz+ra ha s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nam mkha'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje sgeg pa mo// sna tshogs= /nam mkha'= /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs sgeg mdzes bde bas mchod// oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gur gum mdog mtshungs rdo rje glu len ma// sna tshogs= /nam mkha'= /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs snyan pa'i glu yis mchod// oṃ badz+ra gī tī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pri yang ku mtshungs rdo rje gar mkhan ma// sna tshogs= /nam mkha'= /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mdzes pa'i gar gyis mchod// oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zla ba'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje me tog ma// sna tshogs=

/nam mkha'= /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs me tog sil mas mchod// oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ in+d+ra nī la'i mdog mtshungs bdug spos ma// sna tshogs= /nam mkha'= /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bdug spos sprin gyis mchod// oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nyi ma'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje mar me ma// sna tshogs= /nam mkha'= /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mar me'i phreng bas mchod// oṃ badz+ra dī pe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sin+dhū'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje dri chab ma// sna tshogs= /nam mkha'= /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dri bzang byug pas mchod// oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ chu shel mdog mtshungs gzugs kyi rdo rje ma// sna tshogs= /nam mkha'= /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gzugs kyis bde bas mchod// oṃ rū pa badz+ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ban+dhu'i mdog mtshungs ro yi rdo rje ma// sna tshogs= /nam mkha'= /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ro yi bde bas mchod// oṃ ra sa badz+ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sna tshogs mdog mtshungs reg bya rdo rje ma// sna tshogs= /nam mkha'= /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs reg bya'i bde bas mchod// oṃ spar+ṣe badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ston zla'i mdog mtshungs chos dbyings rdo rje ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs chos khams bde bas mchod// oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod la pi wang ma la sogs pa'i lha mo de rnams kyis dkyil 'khor pa la mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab par byed bzhin par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ha s+ya lā s+ya ra ti krī ḍā sau khya a nut+ta ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod de/ rig ma bcu drug gi mchod pa'o// de nas lag g.yon sdigs mdzub byas pa'i steng du/ g.yas pa'i thal mo'i mthil bzhag pa dang*/ rab mdzes gos kyis steng g.yogs zlum por bres// sna tshogs dar gyi 'khor yug mdzes pa'i gdugs// 'khor lo'i dbang phyug he ru ka la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag dang 'gro la mchog stsol mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī ḍā ka sā ga rats+tsha traṃ ka pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/

de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la sbyar te/ lag pa g.yon khu tshur byas pa'i steng du g.yas pa'i khu tshur bzhag pa dang*/ nor bu'i tog can dar gyi lhab lhub g.yo// mi mthun phyogs las rnam rgyal rgyal mtshan che// dh+wa dza/ lag g.yas mthil g.yon du bstan pa'i steng du/ lag g.yon mthil g.yas su bstan nas sor mo rnams g.yob pa'i tshul dang*/ rin chen dbyug pa nyi zla'i thor cog mdzes// sna tshogs mdangs bkra'i gos kyi ba dan can// pa taṃ ka lag pa g.yon mnyam gzhag la/ g.yas nam mkha' la bskor zhing*/ ting 'dzin snying rje'i rgyan phreng mdzes pa can// chos nyid don rtogs rin chen bla re rnams// bi tā naṃ/ gti mug rmongs pa'i rdul rnams sel byed pa'i// rnga yab dkar po gser gyi yu ba can// tsā ma ra/ 'dod chags tshad gdung skyob pa'i bsil grib can// bkod legs kha dog cher bkra bsil yab rnams// bi dha ma naṃ byañdza naṃ/ 'di gnyis ka la lag pa g.yas pas rnga yab sogs g.yob pa'i tshul du bya'o// rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis kha nas tshig 'byin pa'i tshul dang*/ drug gis rjes su skyes sogs snyan pa'i dbyangs// thos na dbang po tshim byed glu yi sgra// gī ti/ lag gnyis ting shags brdungs pa'i tshul dang*// rten 'brel las byung skye med rang bzhin can// chos rnams skyed med ston pa'i sil snyan sgra// tur+yaṃ/ g.yon khu tshur las mthe bong dang mdzub mo sbyar ba dung gi phyag rgya dang*/ dge legs rin chen las grub g.yas su 'khyil// rgya chen chos kyi sgra sgrogs dung dkar mchog /shaṃ kha/ lag gnyis gar skor g.yon dang*/ g.yas su bskor nas spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba dang*/ gcig nyid du ma'i tshul du rab bstan nas// 'gro ba dga' bskyed gar gyi mchod pa'i tshogs// nṛ t+ye/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur gyis phreng ba 'dzin pa'i tshul bya zhing*/ in+d+ra nī la la sogs 'jig rten na// shin tu dkon pa'i rin chen phreng mdzes rnams// mā le/

khu tshur gnyis kha 'gram g.yas g.yon du gzhag la/ mdzes shing yid 'ong zhal gyi pad+ma las// ngo mtshar chos kyi dbyangs sgrogs bzhad pa'i sgra// ha s+ye/ lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur dkur kha gyen du bstan pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ gzugs mdzes mthong bas mi ngoms reg na bde// yid 'phrog snyems pa'i tshul 'dzin sgeg tshogs rnams// lā s+ya/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ bde chen dgyes pa'i dga' sgro rnam mang dang*// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa sna tshogs rnams// war+ṇa pū dza/ dri'i phyag rgya dang*/ reg na tshim byed zhim pa'i dri ngad ldang*// ga pur la sogs legs par sbyar ba'i dri// 'khor lo'i dbang phyug he ru ka la dbul// bzhes nas bdag dang 'gro la mchog stsol mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī ḍā ka sā ga ra gan+dhe pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod la mchod pa de rnams kyis dkyil 'khor pa la yang dag par mchod par bsams te/ nam mkha' mdzod bcas la/ oṃ a nut+ta ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra bha we s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod de/ khyad par gyi mchod pa bco lnga pa'o// gsum pa nang gi mchod pa ni/ sngar byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang mchod kyi dbus nas g.yon pa'i mtheb srin sbyar bas blangs la/ spyi bor gtor zhing*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du mchod pa 'bul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ dpa' bo spyan ras gzigs/ byang sems blo gros rin chen/ grub chen sha ba ri dbang phyug slob dpon mai tri gup+ta/ rgya gar phyag na rdo rje/ 'grel byed ka ma la badz+ra/ paṇ+ḍi ta dza ya se na/ lots+tsha ba dar ma yon tan/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ rin po che skyob pa dpal/

rgyal tsha chos kyi dbang phyug lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ bla ma gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ bla ma ngag dbang grags pa/ bla ma byang chub seng ge rje btsun dam pa sa bzang 'phags pa rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa 'bul/ zhes dbang bka' dang*/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ blo chen sangs rgyas sras/ bla ma ye shes mgon/ dar ma bzang po/ grags chen pa/ chos rje spang sgang ba/ chos rje sa bzang paṇa chen/ chos rje sa bzang 'phags pa ste/ rgyud dang*/ rdo rje 'chang*/ sha ba ri dbang phyug bi bhū ta tsan+d+ra/ dpyal a mo gha/ mar ston g.yung 'bar/ rnal 'byor seng ge 'bum/ kun spangs kun tu bzang po/ bla ma grags pa seng ge bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ zhes pa rdzogs rim sha ba ri'i sbyor drug gi brgyud pa rnams la 'bul/ de nas sngags phreng ltar lha thams cad kyi sngags brjod cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la 'bul nas/ srin lag gis lce rtse smin mtshams spyi gtsug tu thig le byas pas lus kyi lha thams cad tshim par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod/ de nas/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas gur gyi mgon po dang*/ gzhan yang gdong bzhi pa la sogs pa sgos kyi chos skyong gang byed la 'bul/ de nas 'jig rten pa'i mkha' 'gro rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas/ zhing dang nye ba'i zhing*/ tshan+dho dang nye ba'i tshan+dho/ 'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba/ 'thung gcod dang nye ba'i 'thung gcod/ dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod/ yul sum cu rtsa gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod brgyad na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprul pa'i sku 'gro ba sems can gyi don mdzad pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhing skyong bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad/ pho nya gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang*/

gnas gsum gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas 'bul/ gzhan yang gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong*/ pho nya/ 'phrog ma grub pa rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bod khams skyong bar byed pa'i brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag yul bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi= 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad tshim zhing zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsis rgyud gang nas/ myur du bla na med pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig ces pa'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la 'bul lo// bzhi pa bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ rgyas par na/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar te/ lha thams cad kyi sngags rdzogs par brjod la bstod par bsgom/ de tsam mi nus na/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ rkang pa bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa brjod/ gshin tu bsdu na/ he ru ka dpal ye shes che/ zhes sogs dkyil chog tu bshad pa ltar brjod de/ bstod pa dang bdud rtsi myang ba gnyis kyi sngon du bstod pa byed par lha sta gon gyi skabs su bshad kyang*/ 'dir sgrub thabs kyi tshogs rten gyi skabs ltar bya'o// gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu nyer spyod rgyas par 'bul bar 'dod na bsang gtor dang zhabs bsil/ spyir 'bul/ mchod yon la/ sngar gyi tshigs bcad kyi mjug tu/ oṃ shrī pats+tsha sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra pra wa ra sat+kā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes lha thams cad kyi rigs bdag dang*/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ḍā ka sā ga ra sa pa ri wā ra/ zhes pas gtso bo dang*/ oṃ shrī badz+ra wā rā hi/ yum dang*/ oṃ tsakra ti la ka ba si nā sarba wī ra yo gi nī zhes thig le'i 'khor lo dang*/ oṃ tsakra badz+ra sarba bī ra ba si nā yo gi nī zhes rdo rje'i 'khor lo dang*/

oṃ tsakra gar+bha sarba bī ra ba si nā yo gi nī zhes snying po'i 'khor lo dang*/ oṃ tsakra gu ṇa ba si nā sarba bī ra yo gi nī zhes yon tan gyi 'khor lo dang*/ oṃ bo dhi satwa zhes bskal bzang dang*/ oṃ mu kha ba si nā aṣ+ṭa yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra zhes sogs sbyar la dkyil 'khor dang po'i lha la mchod yon 'bul/ de bzhin du/ oṃ tsakra ā kā sha ba si nā sarba bī ra yo gi nī zhes nam mkha'i 'khor lo dang*/ oṃ tsakra pā yu ba si nā sogs kyis rlung 'khor dang*/ oṃ tsakra bhū mi ba si nā sogs kyis sa'i 'khor lo dang*/ bskal bzang dang sgo mtshams ma rnams la sngar bzhin te/ dkyil 'khor gnyis pa dang*/ oṃ tsakra ag+ni ba si nā zhes me'i 'khor lo dang*/ oṃ tsakra u da ka ba si nā zhes chu'i 'khor lo dang*/ oṃ tsakra dzñā na ba si nā zhes ye shes kyi 'khor lo dang*/ bskal bzang dang sgo mtshams ma rnams sngar bzhin te dkyil 'khor gsum pa dang*/ oṃ tsakra tsit+ta ba si nā zhes thugs 'khor dang*/ oṃ tsakra wāk+ka ba si nā zhes gsung 'khor dang*/ oṃ tsakra kā ya ba si nā zhes pas sku 'khor dang*/ oṃ bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra zhes bskal bzang dang*/ oṃ mu kha ba si nā aṣ+ṭa yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra pra wa ra sat+kā ra a r+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes brjod/ las kyi rdo rjes bzed zhal du re re zhing mchod yon 'bul/ de bzhin du zhal zas kyi bar tshigs bcad dang bcas pas sngar bzhin phul la/ rol mo spyir 'bul lo// gsum pa rjes ni/ de ltar mchod pa'i cho ga mtha' dag tshar ba dang*/ mchod rdzas dman pa rnams chu bo la dor ba sogs bya'o// shes rab nam mkhar dad pa'i sprin bsdus nas// sna tshogs mchod pa'i char chen legs phab ste// rnam dag cho ga'i 'bru sgra 'di bsgrags pas// mchod yul rma bya'i tshogs kun dgyes gyur cig /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i cho ga 'di ni/

rje btsun mkhas pa'i dbang po ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang po la don gnyer gyi slob ma rin chen grub kyis bskul zhing yi ge'i rkyen sbyar ba la brten nas 'di'i dkyil chog dang cho ga dgu brgya pa las 'byung ba'i mchod pa rnams tshang bar bkod/ gzhan spros pa mang po btang snyoms su byas nas kun dga'i lo cho 'phrul gyi zla ba'i yar tshes brgyad la dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi dgon par sbyar ba'o// //i daṃ shā sa na sh+tsa sarba satwa hi to bha wan+tu// // ༄// dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'khor lo bcu gnyis su mngon par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga yon tan rin po che'i mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'khor lo bcu gnyis su mngon par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga yon tan rin po che'i mdzod ces bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dren pa gang gis dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun gyis// 'gro ba'i sems kyi dri ma kun sbyangs nas// rim gnyis mchog gi rtogs pa bskyed mdzad pa// rdo rje 'chang bdag dpal ldan bla mar 'dud// zab yangs bde mchog nyung ngu'i bshad pa'i rgyud// dpal ldan mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor du// skal ldan mchog gi cho gas smin pa'i tshul// gzhung dang brgyud pa'i srol bzhin bshad kyis nyon// 'dir dpal he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor chen por zhugs nas dbang bskur ba rnam par dag pa nod pa ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam mtha' dag gi rtsa ba yin pas/ de bshad par bya ba la gsum ste/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes so// dang po la gsum gyi/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ don du gnyer ba'i slob mas/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob dpon la/ maṇ+ḍal la sogs pa phul nas mnyes par bya'o// de la bla mas bu khyod ci 'dod ces dri/ des kyang dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zhu'o zhes brjod do// de nas slob mas ci 'byor ba'i mchod pas bla ma mchod de/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāk+tsi t+ta pra ṇa mya na badz+ra ban+dha naṃ ka ro mi zhes sam/ yab kyi snying pos phyag bya/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba sogs 'og sa bzung gi skabs su 'byung ba ltar tshigs bcad bzhis lan gsum du gsol ba gdab par bya'o// de nas slob dpon gyis/ bdag gis 'khor lo sdom pa'i cho ga la brten nas 'gro ba mtha' dag bla na med pa'i byang chub la dgod par bya'o snyam du sems bskyed la/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor bying ba ni// de rnams nyon mongs 'dam gyis gos// brgal bar mi nus pa yi sems// shin tu sdug bsngal tshogs rnams la// nyan thos la sogs bsgral ba dang*// byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba'i sras// dpa' rnams bde chen thob pa yi// 'khor lo bcu gnyis dri ma spangs// bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor du// rab tu 'jug par khyod spro'am// zhes lan gsum dri/ slob mas kyang*/ tshigs bcad gong ma'i rjes su bdag spro'o// zhes lan gsum brjod do// yang bla mas khyod kyis nye bar mkho ba thams cad tshogs sam zhes dri/ slob mas/ cung zad tshogs shing cung zad ma 'tshogs so// zhes zhu bar bya'o// gnyis pa slob ma yongs su bzung ba ni/ bla mas sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus gang rung bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun du 'dug pa'i slob ma'i spyi bor he yig mgrin par ru/ snying gar ka bsams te/ he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid// ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste// ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o// zhes pa'i don dran pas/ slob ma rang bzhin med par byas pa'i ngang las/ pad+ma dang nyi mar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte bar hūm̐ ljang sngon gyis mtshan pa de las mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho yab yum du bskyed la/ rang gi snying ga nas byung ba'i mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi phyag na bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pa thogs pas dbang bskur zhing khrus byas par bsam/

de nas sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ go cha bgo ba rnams sgrub thabs ltar bya'o// 'di gnyis kyi tshab tu/ dkyil chog dgu brgya par/ spyi bo sogs gnas nyer bzhir/ pū dza sogs bkod pas slob ma'i sems las byung ba'i bgegs bsrung bar bshad de don gcig go /gsum pa sngon du bsnyen pa'i cho ga ni/ bla mas gnas dben par sgrub thabs ltar rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgoms nas/ gtso bo'i sngags 'bum phrag gcig yum la khri phrag lnga/ 'khor rnams la khri phrag re re bzla'o// 'di lha shin tu mang bas 'khor rnams kyi bzlas pa ma grub na/ gtso bo yab yum gyi bsnyen pas chog par gzhung gzhan las 'byung ngo*// dgu brgya par/ dkyil 'khor bri ba'i sngon du zhag bdun bsnyen pa dang*/ kha skong gi sbyin sreg bya bar bshad do// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ sa chog lha gnas dkyil 'khor bri// sgrub mchod bdag 'jug dbang bskur ba'o// zhes pa ltar don drug las/ dang po sa yi cho ga la/ khang pa gsar du bya ba dang*/ gnas khang rnying par bya ba'i cho ga gnyis kyi dang po ni/ lha khang dang grong khyer gyi shar la sogs pa'i phyogs mdun du dkyil 'khor bris na nyes pa sna tshogs bskyed cing*/ mchod rten gyi gnas su bris na/ slob dpon 'chi bar bshad pas/ de dag spangs la byang shar gyi phyogs su sa gzhi dkar zhing snum pa shar dang byang gzhol ba nyams dga' ba'i gnas btsal te sa brtag pa'o// de nas yul gyi rgyal po la/ tshig gam rin gyi sa bslang zhing*/ gzhi bdag la gtor ma sbyin pas bslang ba ni/ gzhung 'dir ma bshad kyang*/ gzhan nas kha bskangs te sa bslang ba'o// de nas sa sel shin tu che ba'i sa phyogs yin na khru do tsam du brkos la phub ma dang*/ rdo ba la sogs pa'i skyon rnams bsal nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi rgya ji tsam byed pa'i nyis 'gyur gyi tshad du sa'i skyon rnams sbyang ngo*// tshad kyang slob ma'i 'byor pa dang bstun pa'i/

rgyal po la khru brgya/ blon po la lnga bcu/ yul dpon la nyi shu rtsa lnga/ tshong dpon la bcu gnyis/ sgrub pa po rnams la khru drug dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbang du byas na khru brgyad do// sa sel cung zad nyung ba'i sa phyogs yin na gnas der slob dpon gtso bo'i rnal 'byor sngon du song nas rtsa ba'i sngags lan gsum bzlas pas sa phyogs de nyid kyi bgegs rnams bskrad par bsam/ de nas khang pa ji tsam byed pa'i rgya pus mo nub tsam du brkos te/ rus pa la sogs pa'i skyon rnams bsal te sa de nyid kyis 'thas par bcag go /de'i dbus su rgya dang dpangs mtho gang ba'i khung bu byas la chus bkang ste/ rang rtsa sngags zlos pas shar du gom pa brgyar phyin nas log pa na chu de ma zad na shis pa yin no// gal te chu skam pa sogs mtshan ma mi shis pa byung na sa de'i dbus su drag po'i thab khung du rus pa'i phye ma dang*/ dug dang phrag dang ske tshe la sogs pas drag po'i sbyin sreg bya'o// mtshan ma dge na slob ma dang*/ sa'i bdag po'i don du zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byas nas/ dkyil 'khor ji tsam byed pa'i sa de sa bzang po gzhan dang bsres la sa stegs bya/ de nas phyi rol du dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa sgo bzhi pa rta babs bzhis brgyan pa sogs mtshan nyid dang ldan pa brtsigs la rgyan dgram pa sogs 'og nas 'byung ba'i cho ga rnams bya ste sa sbyang ba'o// gal te khang pa ma 'byor na nags tshal dang dur khrod la sogs pa gnas dben par sngar bshad pa'i cho gas sa stegs byas la/ der dkyil 'khor bris nas slob ma la dbang bskur ba yin no// gnas 'di la bla gab med kyang 'phags pa'i yul rlung chung bas skyon mi bskyed la/ brgya la rlung gi gnod pa sogs byung na/ de bsrung ba'i don du mi g.yo ba'i rlung bcing ba dang*/ thog bzlog pa sogs mang du gsungs so// gnyis pa ni/ gtsug lag khang la sogs pa sngar khang pa grub zin gyi gnas su byed na gsum ste/

sa lha la gsol ba gdab pa/ sa sbyang ba/ sa gzung ba'i cho ga'o// dang po ni/ gnas khang de nyid du ras bris la sogs pa'i rten dang mchod pa rgya cher bsham/ bla re bre/ rgyal mtshan dang ba dan sogs bkod nas/ snga dro'i dus su/ rang lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas dkyil 'khor ji tsam bri ba'i tshad du khaṇ+ḍa ro hā'i sngags bzlas pa'i dri bzangs kyis chus bsang gtor bya/ tsan+dan gyi chus khye ma med par byugs la dbus su lag pa g.yas pa sa la reg ste/ hūm̐ lan brgyar 'don zhing yi ge brgya pa lan bdun gyis byin gyis brlab bo// de nas sa'i dbus su dri'i thig le dang me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ mtha' skor du chu gsum dang nyer spyod lnga dang gtor ma rnams bshams nas slob dpon 'khor bcas bstan la 'dug ste/ sgrub thabs ltar rnal 'byor bsgoms te/ de'ang tshogs zhing gi skabs su nam mkha' la 'khor lo bcu gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa mngon sum bzhin du yun ring du bsgoms la/ de'i gzugs brnyan dang 'dra ba'i bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bsgom zhing bzlas pa ci nus pa byas nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar du bya'o// de nas mdun gyi mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mchod rdzas so sor bskyed la/ rang rang gi sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor gsal ba'i lag pa g.yas pa'i sor mo dbus ma gsum gyi rtse mor zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'phro ba la hūm̐ re re mtshan par bsgoms la/ sor mo'i rtse mo sa la lan gsum brdabs pas de'i sgra dang snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis sa 'og nas byon pa'i sa'i lha mo zhi ba sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas pas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa dang*/ g.yon pas thugs kar rin po che'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ na bza' dkar po dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhal gyi pad+ma rab tu bzhad cing lte ba yan chad sa'i steng du 'thon pa la klu dang sa bdag gi tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun du bzhugs par bsam/

de la oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro ba'i oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bsang gtor dbul/ de bzhin du zhabs bsil dang*/ mchod yon nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ gtor ma sbyangs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum dang mtshan sngags kyi rjes su a kā ro btags la gsum mam bdun gyis dbul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi gtor zhing sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sa phyogs 'di bdag la gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes phrin las gzhol/ de nas spos dang bcas pas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul gyi khyad par dang*// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// shākya seng ge skyob pa yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las// rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri// zhes lan gsum dang*/ bdag gis sa'i phyogs 'dir dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dri bar 'tshal na/ sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing dngos grub kyang bdag la stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod la/ slar yang mchod pas dgyes nas/ de ltar bgyi'o zhes gsungs par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes pas sa de la thim par bsam/ 'dir sa 'og nas spyan drangs pa'i lha mo la mkhyen gsol byas pas chog gi gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa sogs mi dgos pa dkyil chog gnyis kyi dgongs pa yin no// de nas oṃ badz+rī bha wa hūm̐ zhes dang*/ lag gnyis rdo rje bsdams pa byas pa brkyangs te lag mthil sa la bzhag yang oṃ badz+ra dri ḍha tiṣ+ṭha/ zhes brjod pas sa byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ mchod pa sogs bsdus la gnas gsum bsrung ngo*// gnyis pa sa sbyang ba'i cho ga la gsum gyi dang po bgegs bskrad pa ni/ nyi ma'i gung la bab pa na sngar gyi sa gzhi'i dbus su slob dpon 'khor bcas rnams 'khod/

thams cad kyang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs bcing*/ lus mtha' dag la thal chen gyis byug skra'i thor cog dang*/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga bgo dar dpyangs sogs kyis mdzes par byas shing*/ rdo rje dril bu bzung*/ slob dpon gyi mdun du chu gsum nyer spyod lnga/ yungs kar gu gul sogs dang*/ seng ldeng gi phur bu bzhi tho ba sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad bsham mo// de nas tshogs gnyis bsags pa sngon du 'gro bas/ cho ga gsum gyis rang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho yab yum rkyang par bskyed yan lag bzhi rdzogs su byas la rtsa sngags ci nus su bzla'o// de nas rang mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor gsal ba'i thugs ka nas khaṇ+ḍa ro hā spros pas grogs rnams dang dbyer med du 'dres pas slob ma rnams khaṇ+ḍa ro hā zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma sku g.yon dmar g.yas ser ba gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin cing shin tu khros pa'i skur gyur par bsam mo// de nas dang por bsgoms te bzhag pa'i nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs shing dbul/ rig ma bcu drug dang*/ lha mo brgyad kyis kyang mchod la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la byin gyis brlabs te/ bdud dang bar du gcod pa thams cad 'joms pa'i nus pa can du byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod la dkyil 'khor dbus su ldang*/ hūm̐ zhes pas rang bde mchog rdo rje khro bor gsal ba'i mig g.yas pa ma las nyi ma dang*/ g.yon pa ṭa las zla ba/ mig 'bras g.yas dang lag pa g.yas par nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig mig 'bras g.yon dang lag pa g.yon par zla ba la gnas pa'i oṃ yig bsams la hūm̐ zhes g.yon skor du bltas pas nyi ma dang hūm̐ yig rnams las rdo rje'i me dpag tu med pa 'phros pas gdug pa can rnams tshig nas bros par bsgom/ yang g.yas skor du bltas pas zla ba dang*/ oṃ yig rnams las 'od zer dkar po bdud rtsi'i tshogs dang ldan pa dpag tu med pa 'phros pas rang gi slob ma dang 'khor rnams kyis 'thungs pas tshim nas tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par bsam mo// de nas rkang pa gnyis āḥlas byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rjer bsams la/

slob dpon dbang ldan du 'ong*/ de nas g.yas skor du rdo rje'i 'gros kyis bskor bas gser gyi sa gzhi la thug gi bar gyi sa thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam/ de nas slob dpon dbus nas dbang ldan du bltas la khro bo'i nga rgyal dang*/ hūm̐ dengs shig yod par gyur pa gang su dag lha dang lha ma yin dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ sha za dang*/ brjed byed dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ gnon po dang*/ rgan po dang*/ rgan mo dang rjes su spyod pa'i 'khor dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang*/ mi'am ci dang*/ skyes bu sngags grub pa rnams sa'i phyogs 'dir slob ma che ge mo zhes bya ba yang dag pa'i byang chub yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i don dang*/ sems can gyi bla na med pa'i ye shes thob par byed pa'i rgyur dpal he ru ka mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'khor lo bcu gnyis su mngon par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor bdag gis bya'o// dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i bka' 'di thos nas myur du 'gro bar gyis shig gang zhig mi 'gro na de la bdag dpal he ru ka rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba'i hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rab tu khros pa'i zhal can kun nas 'bar bas ye shes chen po'i rdo rjes spyi bo brgyar 'gas par bya'o// zhes drag tu brjod la lus kyi tsham rngams dang rol mo drag tu bya/ phyogs thams cad du yungs kar gtor zhing gu gul gyis bdug ngag tu sum+bha sogs khro bo'i sngags 'don/ sems kyis bgegs thams cad bros par bsam mo// de nas shar du g.yas brkyang*/ lhor g.yon brkyang*/ nub tu sa ga byang du zlum po/ dbus su mnyam pa ste/ de tsam gyis kyang don 'grub la/ rgyas par spro na stangs stabs drug cu rtsa bzhi byed par bshad de/ kho bos logs su bkod pa las shes so// gnyis pa phur bu gdab pa ni/ rang bde mchog rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas hūm̐ gis sgras bskul nas/

dpal he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pa drag po'i lus can bskal pa'i me lta bur mi bzad pa dpag tu med pa spros/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs gnas gsum du bkod pas bgegs 'gugs pa'i nus pa can du bsams la oṃ sum+bha sogs drag tu bka' bsgos pas/ de rnams nam mkha'i khams gang bar 'phros phyogs bcu'i bgegs kyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa bkug ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol gyi me la sogs pa'i grwa bzhir hūm̐ las khron pa me rab tu 'bar ba bzhir gyur pa'i nang du bzhag par bsam/ de nas mdun gyi phur bu bzhi bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bzhi'i steng du skad cig gis shar lho'i phur bu nam mkha'i snying po lho nub kyi pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug nub byang gi rnam par snang mdzad/ byang shar gyi phur bu rdo rje sems dpa' rnams lte ba yan chad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu/ g.yas 'og mas ḍā ma ru/ g.yon 'og mas thod pa 'dzin pa rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ lte ba man chad rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rnam pa can du bsam/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi khro bo dpag tu med pa spyan drangs la phur bu rnams la thim par bsams te/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas phur bu rnams bgegs kyi lus 'bigs pa'i nus pa dang ldan par blta'o// de nas slob dpon mer song la bgegs kyi spyi bor phur bu btsugs par bsgoms nas/ oṃ gha gha/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭān phaṭa phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya/ sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ badz+ra kī la ya/ badz+ra dha rod ā dzñā pa ya ti/ sarba bigh+nān kā ya wāk+tsit+ta kī la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces brjod la phur khung du btsugs te/ g.yon gyis bzung la g.yas pa'i rdo rje tho bas brdugs pas/

spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar du phug par bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra muk+tar a ko ṭa ya a ko ṭa ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod do// de bzhin du mtshams gzhan gsum du'ang byas pas 'gro ba bgegs dang bral bar bsam mo// dgu brgya par/ yang na ye shes kyis nus na/ ting nge 'dzin gyi phur bu gdab/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag sems tsam mo// zhes bya ba'i tshig gi 'thad pas so// zhes 'byung ngo*// lung 'dis ni las dang po pas bsam gtan gyi sgrub mchod byed pa bkag pa yin no// de nas phur bu rnams kyi steng du āḥlas byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de rnams kyi 'od zer gyis bgegs thams cad bsregs te thal bar gyur par blta'o// gsum pa bden pa gnyis kyis sbyang ba ni/ sngar spros pa'i he ru ka rnams rang gi snying gar thim pas bdag dang bgegs la sogs pa'i snang ba thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i stong pa nyid du bsams te don dam pa'i sbyang ba'o// de nas gnas khang de nyid gzhal yas khang pa mtshan nyid dang ldan par gyur pa'i phyi rol du rta mgrin dkar po g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ phyag mtshan phur bu bzhi dang 'dra ba dpag tu med pa spros pas bgegs thams cad bsrung ba'i las mdzad par bsam/ de'i thugs ka nas mtshon cha sna tshogs byung nas rwa ba'i tshul gyis bskor bas bdud dang bar du gcod pas mi tshugs par byas so// zhes bsam/ 'og tu hrīḥlas chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gnas khang tshud pa/ 'og gi sa gzhi āḥlas byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rjer bsams la hūm̐ lan brgyar 'don zhing rdo rje'i lta bas phyogs thams cad du blta'o// dgu brgya par/ rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang sngags bzla bar yang bshad de kun rdzob kyi sbyang ba'o// de nas gnas de nyid du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha la gtor ma phul nas gnas gsum bsrung zhing dge ba bsngo ba rnams bya'o// gsum pa sa gzung ba ni/

nangs par snga bar 'dri bar 'gyur ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i dbus su/ slob dpon shar du phyogs pa dang*/ phyogs bzhir slob ma rnams slob dpon la phyogs par 'dug nas sgrub thabs ltar thig le dang phra mo'i rnal 'byor gyi bar mngon rtogs thams cad rdzogs par bsgom/ dkyil 'khor mi bsdu bar bzlas pa ci nus bya'o// de nas phyogs bzhi'i slob ma dum skyes ma'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa rnams kyis slob dpon bde mchog gi ngo bor bsgoms pa la/ chu gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod dang*/ rol mos mchod la/ shar nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// lho nas/ mtshan nyid thams cad yang dag rdzogs// mtshan nyid min pa thams cad spangs// kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// nub nas/ zhi ba'i chos mchog las byung ba'i// ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong ba// kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// byang nas/ sems can kun gyi sems can po// de bzhin dag pa dri ma med// kun tu bzang po thugs kyi mchog /dkyil 'khor snying po bshad du gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab/ slob ma med na gzhan gyis byas par bsgoms la/ rang gis cho ga tshang bar bya'o gsung*/ de nas slob dpon lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos/ deng 'dir bdag skyes 'bras bu yod// bdag gi 'tsho ba 'bras bur bcas// dam tshig lha rnams thams cad dang*// bdag ni mnyam 'gyur the tshom med// bdag ni nyi ma deng mchog yin// deng bdag mchog sbyin bla na med// sangs rgyas kyis rjes brtse ba yi// bka' lung thob par bdag gis shes// zhes dga' ba'i sems kyis brjod la// sngar gyi nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la dmigs nas/ chu dang*/ nyer spyod dang*/ rol mo dbul/ rig ma bcu drug dang lha mo brgyad kyis mchod nas/

rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ he ru ka dpal ye shes che// rnal 'byor chen po thub chen po// mgon po chen po byed pa che// theg pa chen po shing rta che// gsung ba chen po shes rab che// dpa' bo chen po don chen mdzad// 'dzin pa chen po nga rgyal che// rgyal po chen po mchod pa che// srid pa chen po sim pa che// rol pa chen po gnas chen po// mtshon cha chen po drag po che// bzhad pa chen po dka' thub che// zhe sdang chen po 'dod chags che// gti mug chen po stobs chen po// snum pa chen po sgra chen po// snyems pa chen po stobs chen po// sku gsum lam gsum cha byad can// 'khor lo gsum dang srid gsum mchog /dri ma gsum spangs dge ba gsum// spyan gsum sum cu gsum dbang phyug /srid pa gnon pa srid rtse'i mchog /srid pa ldan pa srid las 'das// srid pa dngos med srid snang ba'i// srid pa'i steng ma srid gtso bo// rnal 'byor spyod pas rnal 'byor che// rnal 'byor ma yi rnal 'byor brtson// sbyor shes rnal 'byor pa yang 'byung*// rnal 'byor rnal 'byor mngon 'joms pa'o// rdo rje dpal dbang phyug dgyes pa// rdo rje'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan// rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ phrad pa'i lus// rdo rje rdo rje'i phyag chen po// rdo rje'i gar ni brtan pa che// rdo rje'i glu ni sgra chen po// rdo rje pad+ma'i ting 'dzin bzhugs// rdo rje'i gdan ni dga' bar dgyes// bde ba'i bzhes pa thob pa ste// 'od kyis skye bo skyong ba po// lus ngag yid kyis thams cad du// khyod la gus pas bdag 'dud do// mkha' 'gro drwa ba la phyag 'tshal// phyag 'tshal mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor la// stong pa'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bya ba dang*/ e ma'o chos e ma'o chos// e ma'o chos kyi don byung ba// chos bdag pa yi don bdag med// rdo rje rgyal po phyag 'tshal 'dud// sku gsung thugs ni shin tu dag

/nam mkha' mnyam pa nyid kyi gnas// rnam par 'gyur med snang ba med// rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal 'dud// de bzhin gshegs pa thugs kyi gtso// dus gsum lam la gnas pa ste// go skabs chen po'i dbyings 'byung ba// nam mkha' la ni phyag 'tshal 'dud// nam mkha'i sku ni yang dag 'byung*// nam mkha'i gsung ni rab 'jug pa// nam mkha'i thugs ni chos kyi mchog /spyod pa'i go 'phang phyag 'tshal 'dud// rdo rje sems dpa' theg pa che// nam mkha'i spyod pa rnam sbyang ba// kun tu bzang po mchod pa'i mchog /rgyal ba mchog gi mchod pa gsungs// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug che// rdo rje theg pa nyer ston pa// nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam pa'i mchog /rgyal ba mchog gi mchod pa gsungs// thar pa'i lam gyis rab grol ba// theg gsum mchog lam gnas pa po// sangs rgyas bskal bzang pa yi bdag /don yod mchod pa mi yi mchog /byang chub sems ni yangs pa'i spyan// chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor ba// sku gsung thugs ni yongs su dag /rdo rje theg par phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa'am/ bsdu na/ rkang pa brgyad pa gnyis kyis bstod pas kyang rung ngo*// de nas mchod pa'i lha mo rnams rang nyid la bsdu/ yab kyi nye snying bzlas pas rang gis bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la bteg la/ sngar gyi dkyil 'khor dang ro gcig tu gyur par bsam/ rang nyid gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis langs la mig sngar bzhin byin gyis brlabs la blta/ rkang pa'am byin gyis brlabs nas sngar bzhin bskor/ de nas dbus su 'dug la rang gi mig g.yas pa āḥlas byung ba'i nyi ma/ mig 'bras hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las rdo rje'i me dpag tu med pa byung bas phyi rol mtha' dag me'i rwa bas bskor bar bsam/ yang hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po 'phros/ de rnams rdo rje sngon po dpag tu med par gyur te/ me'i nang du rdo rje'i rwa bas bskor bar bsam/

yang āḥlas 'od dmar po 'phros pa las/ pad+ma dmar po'i rwa bas bskor ba dang*/ mig 'bras la oṃ dkar po/ de las 'od dkar po 'phros pa las/ 'khor lo dkar po'i rwa bas bskor bar bsam/ yang rang gi mig g.yas par nyi ma/ g.yon par zla ba sna'i rtse mor aṃ dkar po de rnams las 'od 'phros pas/ yang phyi rol du rwa ba gsum dang*/ steng rdo rje'i gur du gyur par bsam mo// de'i steng du khro bo rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ g.yas pad+mas mtshan pa'i dbyug to// g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pas bgegs lhag ma rnams bcom par bsam/ de nas nam mkha'i lha la mchod bstod rgyas par bya zhing*/ gtor ma dbul ba nas dge ba bsngo ba'i bar sngar bzhin byas la/ 'og nas bshad pa ltar las kyi thig tshul bzhin du btab la/ sa'i dbus de nyid du nyal bar bya'o// gnyis pa lha gnas kyi cho ga la gsum/ sngon 'gro las thig gdab pa/ dngos gzhi sta gon bzhi bya ba/ rjes lha la snyan gsan dbab pa'o// dang po las thig gdab pa ni gzhan du shes par bya'o// gnyis pa la bzhi'i dang po sa'i lha mo sta gon ni/ 'dir byed pa gzhung gnyis ka na mi snang yang*/ bla ma rnams mdzad kyin snang bas sngar bzhin byas kyang rung ngo*// gnyis pa lha sta gon ni/ phyi ma red kyi dus su/ dkyil 'khor gyi thig la mi gnod pa'i byi dor bya/ lha'i gnas rnams su dri'i thig le dang*/ me tog gi tshom bu tshang bar bkod pa'i mthar chu gsum sngon 'gro'i mchod pa lha'i grangs dang mnyam pa'am/ ma 'byor na gtso bo la lnga/ yum la gcig rigs bdag la gcig gzhan 'dab ma'i lha dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ bskal bzang dang*/ sgo mtshams ma rnams la re re ste/ nyi shu rtsa bdun cis kyang bsham/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma dang sngon 'gro sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad 'tshog par bya/

slob dpon gyi mdun du nang mchod dang*/ rdo rje dril bu sogs bshams nas thams cad gral la 'khod pa la/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma chang dang chus sbyangs/ oṃ badz+ra khaṇ+ḍa ro hā yai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa dum skyes mas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor snod thod par gyur pa'i nang du gtor rdzas sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin gyi steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum brtsegs pa de'i 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs yi ge gsum la thim/ de dag kyang gtor ma la thim pas thams cad bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥzhes lan gsum brjod do// de nas phaiṃ gyi sgra dang 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas dur khrod kyi bdag po rnams spyan drangs te/ de rnams kyis gtor ma gsol bar bsams la/ oṃ kha kha sogs gsum mam bdun gyis phul/ phyi mchod dang nang mchod kyis mchod/ dril bu gsil zhing phrin las gzhol/ slar yang phyogs skyong ba la sogs pa dur khrod kyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ bdag gi dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du/ bar du gcod pa thams cad las bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sba ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod/ srid pa zhi ba zhes sogs kyis smon lam nas gshegs su gsol ba'i bar sgrub thabs ltar byas la gtor ma rol mo dang bcas pas sa gtsang sar dor te/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma'o// de nas slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul te/ gsol ba btab la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas brtsams te dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bsgom mo// de nas mdun du bshams pa'i mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs la/ mdun gyi tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor bsang sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/

hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las byung ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba gru bzhi pa dang*/ rdo rje dang hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis steng du rdo rje'i gur dang rwa ba dang gur gyi mtshams su rdo rje'i bla re dang*/ de dag gi steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa ljang gu mda'i drwa ba rnams su gyur par bsam/ de'i nang du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa nas bskal bzang gi zla ba'i gdan gyi bar gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa sgrub thabs ltar bskyed do// de nas bdud rtsi dang dri bzangs kyi chus dkyil 'khor la gtor zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas byug ris byas par bsgom/ lha gnas rnams su bdud rtsi lnga dang dri'i thig le bya zhing sngags dang me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ sngar bkod tshar na so so'i sngags bzla zhing bkod par bsams pas me tog gi steng du sngags rnams yig 'bru'i gzugs su byung bar bsam mo// de nas dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte bar nyi ma la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de nas 'khor lo bcu gnyis kyi lha rnams spros/ sems can thams cad he ru ka'i lha tshogs su byas nas/ de rnams dang gdod ma nas grub pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs nas/ de nyid la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ lha thams cad dus gcig la yongs su rdzogs par bsams la/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho yab yum bskyed/ de'i phyi rol thig le'i 'khor lo pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi bcu zhe brgyad la rnal 'byor ma nyer bzhi bskyed pa nas brtsams te/ dur khrod rnams su rgyu skar sna tshogs pa dang bcas pas yongs su gang bar bsgom pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bya'o// de nas sngar gyi nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la phyi dang rig ma bcu drug gis mchod nas/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can zhes sogs kyis bstod nas phyag byas par bsams la/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥnam mkha'i gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ sa gzhi'i dkyil 'khor gnyis ro gcig tu gyur par bsam mo// 'di dgu brgya par 'byung la/ dkyil chog 'dir chad pa 'dra'o// de nas gtso bo'i thugs kar hūm̐ gnyis kyi bar du raṃ dmar po las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa nas yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bor dgod pa'i bar gyis go cha bgo de nyid kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ oṃ badz+ra maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes dang se gol gtogs/ phyi dang rig ma bcu drug gis mchod la/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya gu h+ya maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ phaṭa dang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la thim pas dbyer med du gyur par bsam mo// de nas byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes lan bdun gyis gtso bo brtan par bya/ yang lha thams cad kyi sngags ma lus pa tshar gsum gsum mam tshar gcig brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab pa sgrub thabs ltar ro// de nas sngar byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod de/ phyi dang yid las byung ba dang*/ nang dang bstod pa rnams mchod phreng ltar bya'o// gsum pa bum pa sta gon ni/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bum pa lha grangs dang mnyam pa'am/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi'am drug gam/ bsdu na gnyis kyang rung ste/ rnam par rgyal ba la pad nyi'i steng du rdo rje dang gri gug bri/ gzhan rnams la pad+ma dang ro'i steng du gri gug so so'i mdog can/ bskal bzang gi bum pa la pad zla la gnas pa'i chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya bri/ bum pa rnams gu gul gyis bdug dum skyes ma bzlas shing bgegs bsal/ ras dkar po zung gis mgul pa dkri/ nang du sman lnga/ 'bru lnga/ rin po che lnga/ sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga rnams bcug

dri lnga'i chus bkang la/ byang chub kyi shing lo sogs kyis kha brgyan te/ ku sha'i gdan la rnam rgyal bum pa shar gyi nang dang*/ gzhan rnams dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' skor du mdzes par bsham/ las bum byang shar du bzhag gnyis las med na slob dpon gyi mdun du bsham zhing rnam rgyal bum pa'i steng du dung chos dri'i chus bkang ba dang*/ de'i steng du rdo rje la me tog gi phreng ba btags pa gzhag go /de nas rnam rgyal bum pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba la baṃ dkar po las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i nang du hrīḥlas sna tshogs pad+ma shin tu rgya che ba'i dbus su nyi ma la hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa de las bcom ldan 'das mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho yab yum/ de'i phyi rol du nyi ma'i gdan nyi shu rtsa bzhir taṃ nyi shu rtsa bzhi las gri gug nyer bzhi/ de rnams las rnal 'byor ma nyer bzhir gyur pa ni/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma sogs bskyed/ de'i phyi rol du gdan so drug la shar nas g.yon skor du baṃ sngo nag so drug las gri gug so drug de rnams las mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ lā ma sogs bskyed/ de'i phyi rol du gaṃ dmar ser so drug las gri gug so drug de rnams las rdo rje 'chang ma sogs dang*/ de'i phyi rol du shaṃ dkar po so drug las gri gug so drug de rnams las rdo rje bram ze mo sogs dang*/ de'i phyi rol du zla gdan rnams la baṃ nyis brgya bzhi bcu zhe dgu las chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya nyis brgya bzhi bcu zhe dgu de rnams las byams pa sogs bskal bzang dang*/ de'i phyi rol phyogs bzhir g.yon skor gyis/ kaṃ aṃ shaṃ saṃ/ mtshams bzhir g.yas skor du yaṃ re re las gri gug de rnams las shar du khwa gdong ma sogs bskyed/ de'i phyi rol du gdan so drug gi steng du aṃ sngon po so drug las gri gug so drug de rnams las mi'am ci mo sogs dang*/

de'i phyi rol du baṃ sngo ljang so drug las gri gug so drug de rnams las rdo rje mkha' lding ma sogs dang*/ de'i phyi rol du bham̐ ser po so drug las gri gug so drug de rnams las seng ge ma sogs dang*/ de'i phyi rol du zla gdan rnams la baṃ nyis brgya bzhi bcu zhe dgu las chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya nyis brgya bzhi bcu zhe dgu/ de rnams las mchod pa sogs dang*/ de'i phyi rol phyogs bzhir g.yon skor gyis waṃ maṃ kaṃ baṃ dang*/ mtshams bzhir g.yas skor du baṃ aṃ tsaṃ maṃ rnams las gri gug de rnams las shar du tshangs ma sogs bskyed/ de'i phyi rol gdan so drug la aṃ dmar po so drug las gri gug so drug de rnams las lha mo sogs dang*/ de'i phyi rol du baṃ dkar po so drug las gri gug so drug de rnams las ma ka ma sogs dang*/ de'i phyi rol du dzñaṃ sna tshogs mdog so drug las gri gug so drug de rnams las til mchog ma sogs dang*/ de'i phyi rol zla gdan rnams la baṃ nyis brgya bzhi bcu zhe dgu las chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya nyis brgya bzhi bcu zhe dgu/ de rnams las zla gdugs sogs dang*/ de'i phyi rol phyogs bzhir g.yon skor gyis/ gaṃ ghaṃ baṃ tsaṃ/ mtshams bzhir g.yas skor du/ baṃ shaṃ laṃ ḍaṃ rnams las gri gug de rnams las shar du gau rī sogs bskyed/ de'i phyi rol du tsaṃ nag po so drug las gri gug so drug de rnams las rdo rje klu mo sogs dang*/ de'i phyi rol du waṃ dmar po so drug las gri gug so drug de rnams las mchod ma sogs dang*/ de'i phyi rol du kaṃ dkar po so drug las gri gug so drug de rnams las rgyal chen rigs bzhi ma sogs dang*/ de'i phyi rol du zla gdan rnams la baṃ nyis brgya bzhi bcu zhe dgu de las chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya nyis brgya bzhi bcu zhe dgu de rnams las 'phags pa dgyes pa sogs dang*/ de'i phyi rol phyogs bzhir g.yon skor gyis shaṃ gaṃ naṃ ḍaṃ dang*/

mtshams bzhir g.yas skor du/ dzaṃ bhaṃ khaṃ tsaṃ rnams las gri gug de rnams las shar du chu skyes dkar mo sogs bskyed/ thams cad kyang zhal phyag sgrub thabs ltar rdzogs par bsgom/ dur khrod dang gzhal yas khang rnams bum par mi bskyed do// de nas go cha bgo ba/ ye shes pa gzhug pa/ dbang bskur zhing rgyas gdab pa rnams sgrub thabs ltar byas la/ chu gsum sogs phyi mchod dang*/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po nye snying gi mjug tu oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags pas nang mchod dbul/ dril bu dkrol zhing*/ rkang pa bzhi bcu zhe brgyad pas bstod la/ lha rnams kyi sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs par bsam zhing lag pas me tog phreng ba nas bzung la/ yab kyi snying po stong phrag gcig dang brgya rtsa brgyad/ lha gzhan rnams kyi brgya rtsa brgyad re bzlas par bshad kyang*/ bod saṃ skṛ ta'i skad la sbyangs pa chung bas de tsam mi thon na/ gtso bo la sum brgya/ 'khor rnams la gsum gsum bzlas/ dgu brgya par/ oṃ badz+ro da ka hūm̐/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad kyang bzlas par bshad pa bzhin bya/ de nas sngar bzhin du phyi nang gi mchod pa dang bstod pa rnams byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis dung chos kyi chu bum nang du phul bas lha thams cad snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems su zhu nas chu'i ngo bor gyur par bsams te/ rnam rgyal bum pa lhag gnas so// de nas thig le'i 'khor lo'i bum par cho ga gsum gyis rnal 'byor ma nyer bzhi bum thod dang bcas pa bskyed pa sogs sngar gyi rigs 'gres sbyar bas shes la/ bum pa ma 'byor na 'di rnams ma byas kyang rung ngo*// de nas las bum bsang sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las/ las kyi bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan par bskyed/ de'i nang du hrīḥlas pad+ma dang ro'i gdan gyi steng du khaṃ las gri gug de las dum skyes ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku g.yon dmar g.yas ser ba/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/

g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs par bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa bstim/ dbang bskur nas rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan pa la/ phyi nang gi mchod pa dbul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni// zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis bstod/ me tog phreng ba bzung la dum skyes ma'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ slar yang mchod bstod dang lha zhu ba sogs sngar bzhin byas la/ bum pa de dkyil 'khor gyi byang shar du bzhag ste/ ji srid dkyil 'khor byas pa yi// de srid bya ba ma rdzogs par// bcom ldan 'das ma khyod kyis ni// bdag gi gdug pa bskrad par mdzod// ces brjod de las bum lhag gnas so// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi mdun gyi gtor ma rnams/ nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs la/ gtor ma dang po sgrub thabs ltar 'das pa'i lha la dbul/ gnyis pa dpal gur gyi mgon po dang*/ gsum pa mgon po gdong bzhi pa la/ bzhi pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi cho gas dbul lo// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi byang du rgyas pa'i thab khung du me lha mchod nas/ lha so so'i sngags brjod pas dkyil 'khor nas me tog gi spyan drangs la/ tshim par byas pa la slar yang so so'i sngags dang*/ me tog gi dkyil 'khor du spyan drangs nas sbyin sreg lhag ma rnams cho ga bzhin bya'o// bzhi pa slob ma sta gon ni/ de nas dkyil 'khor khang pa'i shar sgo'i phyir 'thon la/ sngar rjes su gzung ba'i slob ma dge bsnyen yin na/ bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa bzung ba rnams khrus byas/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul te/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas pus mo g.yas pa sa la btsugs nas 'dug pa la/ bla mas/ kha cig gsang sngags grub don gnyer// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni 'jug par byed// bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan// gzhan dag 'jig rten mchog don gnyer// 'jig rten mchog don gnyer ba yi// dad pa mang du byed pa yi// blo ldan dkyil 'khor gzhug bya yi// tshe 'di'i 'bras bu 'dod mi bya// tshe 'dir 'dod par gyur pa la// 'jig rten pha rol thob mi 'gyur// 'jig rten pha rol don gnyer bskyed// 'jig rten 'di yi pha rol rgyas// zhes pa'i don 'gro ba mtha' dag dpal he ru ka'i go 'phang la 'god pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor du zhugs la/

dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung snyam pa'i myang 'das kyi bsam pa bskyed du gzhug slob mas/ khyod ni ston pa dpa' chen po// rdo rje phag mo bdag sbyor ba// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// de nyid dam tshig bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas slob ma stong par byas pa'i ngang las cho ga gsum gyis gtso bor bskyed/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pas lhar byas par bsam mo// de nas bla mas/ bu tshur shog cig theg chen gyi// cho ga sngags kyi spyod pa'i tshul// khyod la yang dag bshad par bya// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang*// da ltar byung ba'i mgon po gang*// 'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa ste// de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi// cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas// dpa' bo byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa tshegs med brnyes// gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med de// skyob pa shākya seng ge yis// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa// stobs chen dag kyang de yis bcom// 'jig rten rjes mthun rtogs nas ni// 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /rtogs pa dag ni spangs nas su// bzang po brtson pa'i yid kyis nyon// ma lus brjed med blo gros la// rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs kyi// bde gshegs rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs// zhes spro ba bskyed/ de nas slob mas/ mdun du sangs rgyas sras bcas bsams la/ ngag tu slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/

bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku gsum du rnam par bzhugs pa la skyabs su mchi'o// bla na med pa nges par 'byung ba chen po can gyi chos la skyabs su mchi'o// bla na med pa'i phyir mi ldog pa can gyi byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes lan gsum dang*/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung nas ji srid thog ma med pa'i 'khor ba nas 'khor ba na/ sdig pa can gyi las bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba de dag thams cad sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mdun du so sor bshags par bya'o// phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ nor bu dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ las kyi rigs su bzhugs pa thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming che ge mo zhes bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ nor bu dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ las kyi rigs su zhugs pa thams cad kyi/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rig pa'i lha thams cad kyi mdun du sdig pa thams cad bla na med pa'i bshags pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis mkhyen pa bzhin du so sor bshags par bya'o// chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa dang mnyam par son pa'i bsod nams thams cad la rjes su yi rang bas rjes su yi rang ngo*// gang yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams su chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba/ de rnams bla na med pa'i theg pa chen po'i chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor bar gsol ba gdab par bya'o// gang yang chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba de rnams sems can gyi khams de srid du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab par bgyi'o// bdag gis dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis// 'jig rten du ni myur du sangs rgyas 'gyur// 'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston bgyid de// sems can sdug bsngal mang pos gzir las grol// zhes lan gsum du brjod la rgyun bshags bya/

de nas yab kyi snying po bzlas shing*/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pas dri'i chu blangs la slob ma'i snying gar reg pas/ sngar bzhin lhar dran du bcug la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing dri'i chus spyi bo sogs gnas gsum du reg pas/ spyi bor zla ba dang 'khor lo la gnas pa'i oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par zla ba dang pad+ma la gnas pa'i āḥdamar po/ snying gar zla ba dang rdo rje la gnas pa'i hūm̐ sngon po rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje gsum gyi rnam par spyan drangs yi ge gsum la thim pas/ slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rjer gyur par bsam/ yang slob ma'i thugs kar hūm̐ raṃ hūm̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du oṃ haṃ baṃ sogs go cha drug bkod pas bsrung bar bsam/ de la me tog sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod do// de nas dri bzangs kyis byugs pa'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa rtse mor me tog dkar po bcings pa rnams dum skyes ma bzlas shing lag tu sbyin/ des kyang ba byung gi maṇ+ḍal khru do'am gru bzhi pa me tog gi tshom bu dgu'am gcig bkod par kha shar du bltas la/ dum skyes ma bzlas shing dor te ltas brtag go /de nas sngar gyi stan la bzhag la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum gyis bsngags pa'i ku sha sngas dang stan du sbyin/ dri bzang dang bdud rtsi lnga'i chu/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥsarba pā paṃ nish+tsa s+ya bi sha dha ya bi kalpān a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum gyis bsngags la blud do// de nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bsngags pa'i srad bu dmar po lus kyi tshad can sum khugs su byas pa/ mdud pa gsum por nas gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs la dpung pa g.yon par bcing ngo*// yang slob ma'i snying gar oṃ ha rdo rje sems dpa' sogs kyis yab kyi go cha drug bkod/ slar yang gnas gsum byin rlabs sngar bzhin byas pas bsrung bar bsam mo// de nas slob dpon gyis/
