'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum+bā ra'i me tog ltar// brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul cho ga /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gis sems can mnyam med don// mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus// bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sdig pa byas par gyur pa gang*// de kun dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra ba// mthong bas byang bar 'gyur yin na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i// tshul la gnas pa smos ci dgos// gang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la// blo gros shin tu mi g.yo ba// de dag gis ni ngan 'gro'i rgyun// sdug bsngal 'byung 'gyur rab tu bcad// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis// rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed// gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa// bdag nyid chen po kun gyis ni// bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun// yongs su bzung ste bskyed bzhin pas// de phyir khyed rnams theg chen la// sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur// theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// khyed rnams der ni dong bas na// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur// rang byung skal pa chen po dang*// 'jig rten kun gyi 'dren pa yin// yod dang med pa rnam par 'das// nam mkha' bzhin du dri ma med// zab mo rtog gi thams cad kyi// rab tu brtag med rnyog pa med// spros pa thams cad dang bral ba// spros pa rnams kyis ma spros pa// bya dang las la sogs dang bral// bden pa gnyis la ma brten pa'i// ye shes mchog dang gtso 'di yis// tshul la gnas par 'gyur ba yin// zhes chos bshad do// de nas slob dpon la dbang don du gnyer ba'i slob mas phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul la/ phyir mi ldog pa 'khor lo'i dbang*// byin nas mgon po bdag la gsung*// dkyil 'khor lha yi de nyid dang*// slob dpon gyis ni las rnams dang*// sangs rgyas rnams kyi dam tshig dang*// gsang ba'i sdom pa bla na med// sems can rnams kyi don byed phyir// rtag tu bdag ni slob dpon 'gyur// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/

slob dpon gyis/ 'khor lo bcu gnyis dkyil 'khor che// drag po'i steng du yang dag gnas// mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho kun bzhengs pa// dpal he ru ka'i drin gyis bsrungs// zhes dang*/ rmi lam ji ltar rnyed pa yang*// bdag gi mdun du smra bya'o// zhes brjod la slob ma nyal sar phyin nas bsgom bzlas dang rmi lam brtag go /gsum pa lha la snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ de nas slob dpon nang du 'ongs la tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la phyi dang rig ma bcu drug gis mchod nas/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i spos phor du/ ga bur dang a ka ru bsres pa'i bdug pa dbul/ g.yon dril bu gsil zhing*/ phyogs bcu'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni// sras bcas 'jig rten la grags dang*// rdo rje rin chen rigs dang yang*// pad+ma las kyi las de bzhin// snying po phyag rgya sngags rig pas// gang zhig lha yi tshogs thams cad// chos kyi dbyings la bzhugs pa ni// de rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang*// mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dpal mchog gi /ji ltar nus pa'i nyer spyod kyis// dkyil 'khor bri bar bya'o kye// slob ma rnams la brtse don dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// rjes su brtse bas nyer dgongs la// nye ba nyid du mdzad par rigs// zhes lan gsum gyi rjes su/ sa'i lha mo'i skabs ltar gnang ba zhu'o// de ltar lhag gnas rnams legs par grub nas/ rjes chog bya ste/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs te/ so so'i sngags kyis phyi mchod dbul/ rig ma bcu drug dang*/ nang bdud rtsis mchod/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod la/ dngos grub blang ngo*// de nas yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis cho ga'i lhag chad kha bskang*/ nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ hūm̐ badz+rod tiṣ+ṭhaḥzhes dang phyag rgyas tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa nam mkhar bteg pas/

nam mkha'i dbus su lha thams cad shel ltar shin tu dwangs pa'i sku 'od zer dkar pos brgyan pa/ gzhal yas khang gi nang na bzhugs par bsams la/ sngar bzhin du mchod bstod dngos grub blang ba sogs byas la/ rang nyid go cha gnyis kyis bsrung zhing smon lam sogs bya'o// de'i nub mo dkyil 'khor gyi sa de nyid du nyal la gnyid log pa'i tshe/ rang gtso bo yab yum gyi snying gar zla ba la hūm̐ bsam/ de'i 'od zer dang rang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/ khang brtsegs dang bcas pa rang gi lus la thim pas rang gi lus dkyil 'khor du bsgoms la gnyid do// nang par lha rnams kyis bskul bas gnyid sad par bsams la langs te/ dkyil 'khor 'degs pa'i sngags rgyas rang la bcug pa'i dkyil 'khor nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ der bzhugs par bsam/ de la mchod bstod sngar bzhin du byas nas khang pa'i phyir 'thon te/ slob ma rnams bos la rmi lam dri/ bzang na spro ba bskyed/ ngan na sbyin sreg dang gtor ma la sogs pa bya'o// gsum pa dkyil 'khor bri ba la gsum/ thig gis bri ba/ tshon gyis bri ba/ mchod pa dang rgyan dgram pa'o// dang po la gnyis kyi thig skud byin gyis brlab pa ni/ de ltar sta gon zin pa dang*/ gzhon nu mas bkal ba'i ras skud ring ba dkyil 'khor gyi nyis 'gyur/ sboms su sgo'i nyi shu'i tshad dang ldan pa sngon po la sogs pa'i kha dog lngar btsos la/ mdud pa mi 'byung ba'i phyir shing la sogs pa la dkris nas gser la sogs pa'i snod du gzhag go /de rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thig skud dkar po hūm̐ las rdo rje/ de las chu'i he ru ka zhal phyag rgyu rdo rje 'chang dang 'dra ba/ thig skud sngon po hūm̐ las rdo rje/ de las nam mkha'i he ru ka sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa zhal sngo/ g.yon ljang*/ rgyab dmar/

g.yas ser ba/ phyag mtshan dang*/ rgyan dang*/ de'i pang na rang 'dra ba'i yum bskyed pa sogs rgyu rdo rje 'chang ltar bya/ thig skud ser po hūm̐ dang rdo rje las sa'i he ru ka rtsa zhal ser/ g.yon ljang*/ rgyab dmar/ g.yas dkar ba/ thig skud dmar po hūm̐ dang rdo rje las me'i he ru ka dmar po rtsa zhal dmar/ g.yon ljang*/ rgyab dkar/ g.yas ser ba/ thig skud ljang gu hūm̐ dang rdo rje las rlung gi he ru ka ljang gu rtsa zhal ljang*/ g.yon dkar/ rgyab dmar/ g.yas ser bar bskyed/ rigs lnga'i sa bon hūm̐ 'ba' zhig tu bshad pa'i rigs pas/ cho ga gnyis pa yang rdo rje rkyang du byas so// de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la phyi mchod dbul/ bdag la rdo rje'i thig stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ rang gi mig gnyis dza las byung ba'i nyi zla ser po/ de las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu spros nam mkha'i lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin can gyi thig skud dpag tu med pa byung ste/ dam tshig gi thig skud la thim par bsams la/ oṃ dīp+ta dṛṣ+ṭa aṃ ku sha dzaḥzhes lan gsum brjod la/ 'bar ba'i lta bas mig gi rdzi ma bsgul zhing spyan drangs la bstim mo// de nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥbruṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥ.ām̐ hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥdz+rīṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥkhaṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes thig skud so so la dmigs la brgya rtsa brgyad re bzlas so// de nas sgrub g.yog dang lhan cig oṃ a n+yo3 n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharmāḥ oṃ s+pha ra s+pha ra a nu pra biṣ+ṭha sarba dharmāḥ oṃ a t+yan+ta a nu pra biṣ+ṭa sarba dharmāḥ zhes brjod cing so sor bsgril nas yi ge bdun pa bzlas shing gser la sogs pa'i snod du bzhag la/ me tog sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ sngar bzhin mig nyi zlar byin gyis brlabs shing bltas pas brtan par bsams la/

oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū traṃ mā ti kra ma hūm̐/ brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ stong phrag gcig bzlas so// gnyis pa ye shes kyi thig gdab pa ni/ mdang sta gon byas pa'i sar me tog sna tshogs bkram/ mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams nas nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la phyi mchod dang rig ma bcu drug dbul/ rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis btang la/ mchod gtor rnams bsdu'o// de nas slob dpon langs te/ nub nas kha shar du blta/ thig skud rnams dang rdo rje dang dril bu bzung*/ slob ma shar nas nub tu bltas pa la/ slob dpon rang he ru ka dang*/ slob ma dum skyes mar bsams la/ oṃ dz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥzhes brjod cing*/ thig skud lag pa g.yon pas bzung la/ g.yas pas grogs la gtad/ des kyang dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥzhes brjod cing blangs la/ las thig gi dbus drang po'i nam mkhar bzung la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū traṃ mā ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ sems can don du khyed rnams kyis// don yin de phyir 'dir byon cig /ces pa'i sgras sangs rgyas rnams sems can gyi don la bskul bar bsam zhing bar snang la lan gsum btab/ de nas sa gzhi'i tshangs thig gi steng du yang btab pas/ las thig byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ de nas g.yon skor du 'gro ba gtso che yang rtogs dka' bas g.yas skor bya bar bshad pa ltar gdab ste/ de'ang*/ shar nub gnas pas tshangs thig dang po dang*// lho byang gnas pas tshangs thig gnyis pa gdab// bden bral dbang ldan gnas pas zur thig ste// rlung dang mer gnas zur thig gnyis pa'o// me dang dbang ldan logs thig dang po ste// rlung dang bden bral nub kyi logs thig go /slob dpon der gnas slob ma dbang ldan byang*// me dang bden bral gnas pas lho thig gdab// ces so// thig btab zin pa dang*/ thig skud la mchod nas gshegs su gsol la bsdu'o// gnyis pa tshon gyis bri ba la gnyis kyi/

dang po tshon byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gser la sogs pa'i snod du rdul tshon kha dog lnga bkod/ thams cad la hūm̐ re re bris la/ ras la sogs pa'i steng du/ dbus su dkar po/ shar du sngon po/ lhor ser po/ nub tu dmar po/ byang du ljang gu rnams bkod pa bsang shing sbyangs te/ stong pa'i ngang las rdul tshon dkar po pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las chu'i he ru ka de'i phyi rol du ma ka ma dang rus sbal mo la sogs pa so drug gis bskor ba/ sngon po nam mkha'i he ru ka la mi'am ci mo sogs kyis bskor ba/ ser po sa'i he ru ka la seng ge ma sogs kyis bskor ba/ dmar po me'i he ru ka la lha mo sogs kyis bskor ba/ rdul tshon ljang gu nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rlung gi he ru ka ljang gu la/ rdo rje mkha' lding ma sogs so drug gis bskor bar bskyed/ zhal phyag sogs gsal gdab/ de tsam mi nus na 'khor rnams ma bsgoms kyang rung ngam snyam mo// de nas thig skud ltar gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ nam mkha'i lha la mchod/ bdag la rdo rje'i rdul tshon stsal du gsol/ zhes dang mig byin gyis brlab/ de'i 'od kyis nam mkha'i lha'i thugs ka nas ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin can gyi rdul tshon dpag tu med pa byung ste/ dam tshig gi rdul tshon la thim par bsams la/ oṃ dīp+ta sogs gsum brjod la bstim mo// yang tshon rnams kyi steng du oṃ dkar po 'od 'phro ba re re bsams la/ mig mi g.yo bar bltas la/ bden pa'i byin rlabs gang gis ni// ji srid rdul tshon rnam sbar ba// rdul tshon mang po gang gis ni// bden pas sems can rjes chags pa// bden pa de yi rdul tshon ni// mngon par 'bar bar 'gyur bar shog /ces brjod pas/ rdul tshon rnams mang por 'bar bar bsams la/ yi ge gsum brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la/ nyer spyod kyis mchod/

rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ lha rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i rin po che'i rdul tshon du bsam mo// gnyis pa tshon dgye ba ni/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi nub phyogs su 'dug la/ rtsa sngags brjod pas ye shes kyi thig nam mkha' la bteg bris zin pa dang phab la bstim/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su kha shar du phyogs pas/ khu tshur g.yon pas rdul tshon bzung la/ dkyil 'khor bzhi pa'i rtsig pa'i dbang ldan nas g.yas skor du bris te/ oṃ badz+ra rā ga sa ma ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing nang du dkar po/ ljang gu/ dmar po/ ser po dang*/ de'i phyi rol du sngon po rnams sgo tshad gcig gi bar du bri/ de nas gzhung 'dir bshad pa mi snang yang*/ rtsig pa ye shes lngar mos la/ mchod bstod bya/ zangs gzhong la sogs pas bkab la steng du rdo rje bzhag ste bsrung ngo*// de nas dpon slob thams cad kyis bris te/ de la 'dod yon gyi snam bu dang drwa phyed la sogs pa ni dkyil 'khor spyi dang mthun/ dkyil 'khor so so'i rtsig pa phyogs mdog sogs ni sgrub thabs su bstan pa ltar bri/ dkyil 'khor so so'i rtsig pa bris zin pa dang*/ mtshan ma dgod de/ dbus su rdo rje sngo ljang dang*/ g.yon du gri gug bri/ pad 'dab kyi thod pa'i gnas su thod pa dkar po nyer bzhi dang*/ lha mo'i gnas su gri gug nyer bzhi bri/ gzhan 'khor lo bcu gnyis sgo mtshams ma brgyad tshan bzhi rnams kyi gnas su lha so so'i mdog dang mthun pa'i gri gug re re/ bskal bzang rnams kyi gnas su chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya'am tshon gyi thig le re dgod do// dkyil 'khor bzhi pa'i rtsig pa sbrel ran pa dang*/ sngar gyi zangs gzhong sogs bsal te tshon pra brtags la rtsig pa rnams bar ma chad par sbrel/ gzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi pad+ma'i lte ba ljang gu/ 'dab ma sna tshogs/ dur khrod kyi sa nag po la mtshan ma sgrub thabs bzhin dang*/

gzhan yang ro sna tshogs dang*/ keng rus dang*/ sha za dang*/ srin po'i gzugs la sogs pa rab tu mang po bri/ rdo rje'i rwa ba gzhi ser po la/ rdo rje nag po'i phreng ba bar ma chad pa dang*/ me ri kha dog lnga ldan du bri'o// de ltar dkyil 'khor bri ba'i tshe yang yang brtag cing ma dag na dril bu dkrol zhing yig brgya bzlas pas mtshan ma ngan pa bsal la/ slar dag par bri zhing bcos/ de nas rdul tshon rnams la mchod bstod byas la ye shes pa gshegs/ rdul tshon lhag ma rnams gnas dben par gzhag go /gsum pa chod pa bsham pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi mthar dri bzang po'i chus khye ma med par byug cing yi ge brgya pa bzlas so// byug ris kyi steng du lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i mchod pa'am/ ma 'byor na mchod phreng du bshad pa ltar bkod/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su lag pas reg par bsams la/ dngos su rdo rje rwa ba'i nang du lag pas reg nas rtsa sngags lan bdun bzlas so// yang mtha' skor du bum pa rnams bkod de/ shar gyi tshangs thig gi steng du rnam rgyal bum pa/ de'i lho nas g.yas skor gyis thig le'i 'khor lo dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ mer snying po dang*/ yon tan dang*/ bskal bzang dang*/ lho'i tshangs thig gi steng du sgo mtshams ma ste dkyil 'khor dang po'i bdun dgod/ de bzhin du nam mkha' dang rlung dang*/ bden bral du sa dang*/ bskal bzang dang*/ sgo mtshams ma ste/ dkyil 'khor gnyis pa'i dang*/ nub kyi rtsa thig gi steng du me dang*/ chu dang*/ ye shes dang*/ rlung du bskal bzang sgo mtshams ma ste dkyil 'khor gsum pa'i dang*/ thugs dang byang gi rtsa thig gi steng du sku dang*/ gsung dang*/ bskal bzang dang*/ dbang ldan du sgo mtshams ma ste dkyil 'khor bzhi pa'i bum pa dang*/ dri ma khrus bum dang*/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i byang du las bum rnams ras kyi pad+ma'i steng du gzhag bum pa'i sgos mchod rnam rgyal gyi mdun du bsham/

'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma sogs ji tsam dgos pa'i gtor ma rnams gser dngul dang zangs gzhong la sogs pa'i snod bzang por bza' ba dang bca' ba gya nom pa dang*/ kha na ma tho ba med pa'i sha dang*/ bur chang dang*/ nas chang dang bcas pa dar sna tshogs kyi lhab lhub kyis brgyan pa bsham/ gzhan yang sngon 'gro'i gtor ma dang*/ phyi rol pa'i gtor ma shin tu che ba sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med par bsham mo// bzhi pa sgrub mchod la gsum gyi dang po bdag bskyed ni/ phyi ma red kyi dus su/ slob dpon dpon slob shar phyogs su 'khod la/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar sta gon ltar bya'o// gnyis pa sgrub mchod dngos la gnyis/ mdun bskyed kyi tshul du sgrub pa dang*/ bdag bskyed kyi tshul du sgrub pa'o// dang po ni mdun gyi mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa nas/ gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa bskyed pa'i bar sta gon bzhin bya/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs ye shes lnga'i ngo bo rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte bar hūm̐ ljang sngon gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams nas sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ nam mkha'i dbyings su bzhugs pa la mchod par bsams la/ nyer spyod dang*/ rig ma bcu drug dbul/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ phyogs bcu ma lus rnams na bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol// rdo rje 'chang bdag che ge mo// dkyil 'khor bdag gis brtags par bya// de phyir sangs rgyas kun gshegs la// deng bdag dngos grub rab tu stsol// zhes lan gsum du spyan drangs shing*/

kā ya wā ka sogs kyis phyag byas te sngar spros pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus spyan drangs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum gyi rnam par byas nas/ rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ la thim par bsam/ de yongs su gyur pa las rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du lha thams cad dus gcig la yongs su rdzogs par gyur cing*/ de dang dus mnyam du sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar gnas pa dus gcig la gsal btab par bsams la/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das bskyed pa nas phyi'i dur khrod kyi bar sgrub thabs ltar bya/ de nas sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod byas la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs rdul tshon dang dbyer med du 'dres par bsam/ yang hūm̐ zhes brjod pas lha thams cad ro gcig tu gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha pra ma hūm̐ dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod do// dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'o// de la mchod pa'i phyir/ sngar bzhin byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod pa rnams phul bar bsam zhing*/ lha so so la mchod pa rgyas par 'bul bar bshad pa ltar ram/ de tsam ma nus na chu gsum sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ rig ma bcu drug dang lha mo brgyad dbul/ nang mchod dang bstod pa rnams byas te/ mdun bskyed kyi tshul du bsgrub cing mchod pa'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ rang rdul tshon du 'jug pa/ zhugs nas bdag 'jug blang ba/ dbang thob nas bsgrub mchod dngos bya ba'o// dang po ni/ rang gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis// rdo rje dril bu thogs la/ khro bo hūm̐ mdzad kyi nga rgyal dang hūm̐ brjod pas me tog gi phreng ba bzung*/ yang hūm̐ zhes brjod la/ rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas rdul tshon gyi 'og nas 'dzul te/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs nas lha rnams la bskor ba byas par bsam/ dngos su rdul tshon gyi phyi nas lan gsum du bskor zhing lhag chad kyi nyes pa zhi ba'i phyir yi ge brgya pa brjod/

rdo rje dril bu dkrol/ de nas me tog gi phreng ba gtso bo la phul te de rang gi mgo la bzhag par bsams la/ dngos su me tog rang gi spyi bor bcing*/ yang hūm̐ mdzad kyi nga rgyal gyis gtso bo dang go sa tha mi dad par bsams la/ lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur kha gyen du bstan la mdzub mo gnyis brkyang pa'i logs kyi rtse mo mnyam par sbyar ba'i mdzub mo drag tu dbye ba sgo dbye ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+rod gha ṭa ya sa ma ya prā we sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces sgo ma rnams la bsgos pas de rnams kyis sgo phye bar bsams la/ dngos su dkyil 'khor gyi nub tu gnas pas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang sngar gyi sngags brjod la shar sgo dbye/ de bzhin du byang nas lho dang*/ shar nas nub dang*/ lho nas byang sgo phye la/ dngos su shar sgor 'dug sems kyis gtso bo'i drung du bsdad par bsam mo// gnyis pa ni/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma tha mi dad du mos pa la dbang bskur ba zhu bar bsams la/ 'jug pa dang bum pa'i dbang dang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang la sogs pa dbang mtha' dag bdag 'jug gi tshul du blangs la/ slar yang*/ dkyil 'khor la nyer spyod dang rig ma bcu drug gis mchod nas/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dam tshig gsum gyi glu blangs te// oṃ nam mkha' las ni skyes pa'i phyir// thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /dam tshig sems dpa' rdo rje che// rdo rje sems dpa' deng bdag grub// dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha// rdo rje 'chang ba kun gyi rgyal// mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag 'grub 'gyur// nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa ni// 'dod chags kun gyi rjes chags pa// 'dod chags chen po dga' ba che// bcom ldan de nyid grub par mdzod// shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs// kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid// byang chub sems la bdag 'grub shog

/dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug che mchog phyag rgyar ldan// grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa// rdo rje snyems bdag phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod/ slob ma la dbang bskur mi byed na de tsam gyis chog la/ byed na/ bdag ming che ge zhes bya yis// he ru ka dpal slob dpon che// sangs rgyas byang chub sems kun gyis// gsung ba'i cho ga dag gis ni// phun sum tshogs pa'i cho ga yis// sems can don ni bdag gis bgyi// de la rjes gnang stsal mdzod la// sangs rgyas byang chub sems rnams kyis// bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol// zhes dang*/ sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa// sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// sems can kun gyi yab kyang nyid// dam tshig mchog rnams kyi sku mchog /byung dang 'byung bar 'gyur ba yi// de bzhin gshegs rnams khyed kyis bsgrubs// bden pa de yis bdag mgon po// 'dod pa khyod kyis rdzogs par mdzod// ces pas bden pa'i stobs brjod nas/ yang chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang*// dam tshig kyang ni dran pa yis// brtse bas sems can kun gyi don// dngos grub kun phyir mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod do// gsum pa ni/ de ltar dbang thob pas bdag dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i gnang ba byin par bsams te/ rang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang tha mi dad du mos la/ oṃ shrī he ru ka a haṃ/ zhes rang gi lha'i ming nas brjod pas nga rgyal bzung*/ de bzhin du rdul tshon gyi lha so so dang*/ rang tha mi dad du mos la so so'i sngags kyi mjug gi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa bzhag la a haṃ btags la tshar re brjod/ bskal bzang lha grangs dang mnyam pa mi nus pas phyogs kyi grangs bzhin lan bzhi brjod do// de nas rang gtso bor bsgoms pa'i spyi bor zla ba dang 'khor lo la oṃ dkar po bsgom pa sogs gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa/ thugs kar sa bon dgod pa/

go cha gong 'og gnyis dgod pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin bya/ de nas oṃ sum+bha sogs hūm̐ bzhi pa'i sngags brjod pas/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs par bsams la/ ma lus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin mngon du mdzad pa rnams// rang nyid byung ba mtha' yas srid pa'i rang bzhin rnams// ma lus pas btus snod kyi snying po rnams// sa kun ma lus snying po gcig rnams 'dir byon cig /ces brjod/ kā ya wā ka sogs kyis phyag bya/ chu dang phyi mchod dang*/ rig ma bcu drug gis mchod la/ spyan drangs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams gzhal yas khang gi steng gi nam mkhar la thugs dges pas zhal rab tu 'dzum zhing bzhad pa'i rnam pa can/ sgrub pa po la ji ltar 'dod pa'i dngos grub ster zhing sems can thams cad la phan bde stsol bar mdzad bzhin du bzhugs par bsams la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ he ru ka dpal ye shes che// zhes sogs kyis bstod pas lha rnams dges te/ lha so so la thim pas dbyer med du gyur par bsams la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lha'i sde tshan gyi grangs dang mnyam par brjod do// de ltar dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan zhing*/ rang rang gi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan dang rgyan la sogs pa yongs su rdzogs par gsal ba'i sprul pa'i sku mchog gi gzugs su gyur pa ni phyag rgya chen po dang*/ lha yab yum thams cad snyoms par 'jug bzhin pa dang*/ bskal pa bzang po rnams kyi thugs rgyud la zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen po 'khrungs pa ni dam tshig gi phyag rgya/ de nas dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyi thugs kar hūm̐ rang mdog dang mtshungs pa re rer gyur pa chos kyi phyag rgya/ yab yum rnams rdo rje pad+ma sbyor ba las dkyil 'khor pa'i tshogs spro zhing*/ bskal pa bzang po rnams kyi thugs ka nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dpag tu med pa spros te/

sems can gyi don mdzad pa ni las kyi phyag rgya ste/ phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab/ de nas thugs ka'i sa bon las dbang gi lha spyan drangs pa nas dbu rgyan bkod pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bya'o// de nas rang dang dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas rang 'dra ba'i sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa spros te/ sems can so so'i skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du chos ston pa la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa rnams mdzad nas so so'i sku la thim pas rang rang gi gzugs dang*/ phyag mtshan kyang gsal bar gyur pa yang bsgoms shing*/ gtso bo'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ 'khor rnams kyi nyer gcig re bzlas te/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'o// de la mchod pa'i phyir/ rang rdul tshon gyi gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis/ dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' skor du bkod pa'i mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs la/ chu gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga/ rol mo bza' btung*/ na bza' rnams kyi mchod pa nas bstod pa'i bar rgyas par bya ste mchod phreng ltar ro// de nas yi ge brgya pa lan bdun brjod la lhag chad kyi skyon bsal bar bsam/ chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang*// dam tshig kyang ni dran pa yis// snying rje yis ni sems can don// dngos grub thams cad mdzad du gsol// zhes dang*/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad brtan par bsam/ rang gtso bo las mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi rnam pas he ru ka phyag gnyis par byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas 'thon te shar phyogs kyi stan la 'khod par bsam mo// sgrub mchod kyi tshul 'di rnal 'byor bla med kyi cho ga gzhan la grags chung yang gzhung 'di dang*/

cho ga dgu brgya pa gnyis kyi dgongs pa dpyis phyin par bkod pa la/ cho ga rang gzhung ltar mdzad pa'i rdo rje slob dpon rnams dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ gsum pa gtor ma dbul zhing sbyin sreg bya ba ni/ sgrub pa'i grogs dkyil 'khor gyi drung du rtsa sngags 'don bzhin pas dkyil 'khor bsrung du bcug rang 'khor dang bcas pas khang pa'i phyi rol du rdo rje dril bu dang rol mo sna tshogs thogs pas song ste/ sa gtsang sar 'byung po'i tshogs la gtor ma dbul lo// de'ang shing stegs kyi steng du ci 'byor ba'i rdzas kyis gang ba'i gtor ma chen po ba dan dang bcas pa dang*/ chu gsum dang nyer spyod bsham/ chang dang chus gtor ma sbyang ngo*// de nas sgrub thabs ltar gtor ma byin gyis brlab/ phaiṃ gyi sngags rgya sogs byas la/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi nam mkhar dbang po la sogs pa'i phyogs skyong ba chen po bcu 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ gzhan yang yul sum cu so gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na rgyu ba'i mkha' 'gro dang 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad spyan drangs te/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ oṃ gang du bcom ldan 'das lhan cig /'ongs pa'i phyogs kyi bdag po rnams// gang yang rjes su 'brang bcas 'dir// gnas pa de dag thams cad rnams// bdag ni rjes su bzung ba'i phyir// ji ltar rigs par gyur pa 'di// dri dang me tog sogs gtor ma// so sor bzhes te sems can la// byams pa'i sems dang slob ma la// gegs med par ni mdzad du gsol// zhes dang*/ oṃ da sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye his spyan drangs/ de nas chu gsum dang nyer spyod lngas mchod la/ sngar byin gyis brlabs pa'i gtor ma zos par bsams la/ oṃ kha kha sogs spyi gtor gyi sngags lan lnga'am bdun brjod pas dbul la/ sngar bzhin mchod nas dril bu dkrol zhing*/

lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// zhes sogs gzhung gzhan du 'byung ba'i tshig gis phrin las gzhol/ yi ge brgya pas cho ga kha bskang*/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ mchod pa rnams gtor ma dang lhan cig tu sbrags/ lag pa gnyis kyi mtheb mdzub sbyar ba'i rtse gnyis sprad pa mig gi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod/ pad skor dang lte bar 'khyud pas se gol gtogs te/ oṃ badz+ra muḥs gtor mgron gshegs su gsol/ rol mo dang bcas pas gtor ma sa gtsang sar dor/ hūm̐ bzhi pa shub bur bzlas te/ phyi rol du gtor ma sbyin pa'i cho ga'o// de nas nang du 'ongs la rnal 'byor pho mo'i 'tshogs pa yod na tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya/ med na dpa' bo'i ston mo'am/ rab tu byung ba yin na tshogs 'khor rjes mthun pa bya ste tshogs kyi mchod pa'o// gal te rnal 'byor pho mo ma 'tshogs pa'am tshogs rdzas ma 'byor na/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su zhi ba'i thab khung bris la cho ga bzhin du lha spyan drangs te bsreg rdzas kyis tshim par bya ste/ sbyin sreg gis mchod pa'o// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la phyi dang*/ rig ma bcu drug dang*/ nang bdud rtsi dang*/ bstod pa rnams mdor bsdus pa bya ste sgrub mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'o// lnga pa slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i cho ga ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyi rol lam yol ba'i phyi rol du/ sta gon gyis smin par byas pa'i slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dkyil 'khor chen por zhugs la dbang blangs te/ dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du bsrung snyam pa gyis shig ces brjod/ 'di la dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang dbang bskur ba'i cho ga gnyis las/ dang po la gsum gyi/ thog mar yol ba'i phyi rol du bya ba'i cho ga ni/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/

khyod ni ston pa dbal chen po// zhes sogs lan gsum du gsol ba gdab/ slob ma stong pa nyid las cho ga gsum gyis gtso bor bskyed/ gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab/ dum skyes ma bzlas pa'i smad g.yogs kha dog sna tshogs pa dang*/ stod g.yogs dmar po dang*/ oṃ badz+rau ṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas gtsug tor bcing*/ sgo ma bzhi'i snying pos gdong g.yogs/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis me tog gi phreng ba gtad/ slob mas yon phul la phyogs bzhi nas phyag bya ste/ shar sgo nas rdo rje thal mo sbyar lus thams cad brkyang bas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dzo pas+tha nā ya āt+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta ak+ṣo bh+ya a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ zhes phyag byas pas gtso bo las gtso bo gnyis pa sprul nas slob ma'i snying gar thim pas byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ yang lho sgo nas thal mo snying gar sbyar te/ dpral ba sa la reg la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza a bhi ṣe kā ya āt+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na saṃ bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ zhes phyag byas pas/ lho phyogs kyi rnal 'byor ma rnams las de 'dra ba mang po sprul te slob ma'i dpral bar thim par bsgom/ yang nub sgor thal mo spyi bor sbyar te/ kha sa la reg pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra brta nā ya āt+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta a mi tā bha wa pra warta ya māṃ/ zhes phyag byas pas/ nub kyi rnal 'byor ma rnams las de 'dra ba gnyis pa sprul nas slob ma'i lkog mar thim par bsam/ yang byang sgor rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar nas/ mgo bo sa la reg pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza karma ka ra ṇa āt+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta a mo gha sid+dhiṃ ku ru māṃ/ zhes phyag byas pas/ byang gi rnal 'byor ma rnams las de 'dra ba gnyis pa sprul nas slob ma'i spyi bor thim par bsam mo// de nas shar sgo nas slob dpon la phyag byas la de nyid du 'dug ste/

skyabs 'gro dang*/ sdig bshags nas bsngo ba'i bar sta gon ltar lan gsum bya/ thal mo sbyar nas/ dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// sdom pa yang ni bdag la stsol// rdo rje'i rigs kun bsdus pa la// slob dpon chen po bdag gzhug mdzod// phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur ba'i// skal ba chen po bdag la stsol// dus gsum bzhugs rnams sangs rgyas kyi// sangs rgyas byang chub go 'phang mchog /slob dpon chen po bdag la stsol// mtshan nyid dang ni dpe byad dang*// nam mkha'i 'od sogs yang dag ldan// sangs rgyas sku ni yid 'ong ba// mgon po chen po bdag la stsol// dbang bskur ba ni rmad byung che// sems can kun gyi don brtson pas// rtag tu bdag ni slob dpon 'gyur// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon shar sgor langs la/ dkyil 'khor la thal mo sbyar te/ slob ma ming 'di zhes bya ba yis// byang chub sems ni yongs bzung dang*// gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir 'jug cing*// dam tshig sdom pa nod par 'tshal// zhes lan gsum du brjod pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos/ gsang ba chen po rigs dge ba// gsang chen yongs su bzung ba ru// bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod dam// zhes gsungs bar bsam/ slob ma rnams kyis lan du/ rkang pa gong ma gnyis kyi mjug tu/ bdag nyid chen po bdag 'dod do// ces pas lan gdab/ de nas khyod kyi gzung rgyu'i dam tshig dang sdom pa 'di rnams yin no zhes bsgos la/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// rin chen gsum gyi dam tshig bsten// de ltar sangs rgyas rigs dag la// sdom pa brtan por gyur pa'o// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya dag /blo gros chen po khyod kyis zung*// byang chub sems gang de rdo rje// shes rab dril bu zhes bshad do// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar gyis// bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsung*// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag sbyin bya// phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum// khyod kyis dam pa'i chos gzung bya// 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig sdom pa mchog yin no// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// rang gi de nyid so sor zung*// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus gyis// gzhan yang bcu bzhir bshad 'di rnams// phas pham pa zhes bya bar grags// rtsa ba'i ltung ba shes bya ste// nyin lan gsum dang mtshan lan gsum// nyi ma re rer 'don par gyis// rdo rje'i spun rnams bshes nyid pas// rnal 'byor rnams la bsnyen bkur bya// spang zhing dor bar mi bya ste// ji ltar nus pas yang dag spyad// theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya// 'khor ba yongs su mi spang zhing*// rtag tu mya ngan 'dar mi dga'// gsang ba gsum gyi lha rnams la// brnyas pa nyid du mi bya'o// phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang*// mtshan ma 'gom par mi bya'o// srog chags gsad par mi bya zhing*// ma byin mi blang nyid du bya// 'dod log spyad par mi bya zhing*// rdzun gyi tshig kyang smra mi bya// bya ba ma yin thams cad spang*// sems can don la rgyab mi phyogs// legs pa yi ni nye bar gnas// rnal 'byor gsum la bsnyen bkur bya// lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang*// ngag gi las ni rnam bzhi dang*// yid kyi rnam pa gsum dag ni// ji ltar nus pas rjes su bskyed// 'di dag dam tshig yin par gsung*// khyod kyis da lta nyid nas srungs// zhes sdom pa bsgrags la/

slob dpon 'di ni bdag la gson// gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de ltar du ni bdag gis bgyi// zhes lan cig gis sdom pa mdor bsdus te gzung*/ yang rgyas par gzung ba'i phyir/ gang yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// mgon po sangs rgyas rnams dang ni// de sras bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba 'di// dus 'di nas ni rab bzung ste// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// 'di nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi// nam du yang ni mi spang ngo*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po yi// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya dag /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med pa// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyi zhing*// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod// ces lan gsum brjod du gzhug

de nas sems can thams cad la phan bde bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgrub par bya'o snyam pa kun rdzob pa'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom du bcug la/ blo de snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du gyur par bsam/ de nas chos thams cad kyi yin lugs stong pa nyid kyi ngang du sems bzhag blo de zla ba'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od 'phro ba gcig tu bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta yo ga kā ya wāk+tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi she ṣ+ya na ba she ṣa sa tā dhā tu hi ta su khot+ta ma sid+dhi a d+ya na ta bha wa sid+dhi ma he shwar+ya dhi pa t+ye tsa ya/ zhes brjod du bcug nas/ me tog dang bcas pas rdo rje de snying gar bzhag la/ su ra te sa ma ya staṃ ho/ sid+dh+ya badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod pas sems bskyed brtan par bya/ de nas sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes me tog gi phreng ba bzung la/ slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor la/ bdag ming che ge zhes bya ba'i// rdo rje slob dpon dka' thub che// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// slob ma rnams ni gzhug par bya// dkyil 'khor snying po 'di nyid du// ye shes rdo rje thob bya'i phyir// de bzhin gshegs kun grong khyer du// bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bya// zhes brjod do// de nas 'dir ma bshad kyang gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar gsang bar gdams pa byas kyang 'gal ba med par sems so// gnyis pa yol ba'i nang du gzhugs pa ni/ slob dpon gyi lag gis rdo rjes slob ma rnams nang du drangs shing*/ ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ ngam/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ḍā ki ni dzā la saṃ ba ra/ zhes brjod la yol ba'am/ khang pa'i nang du shar phyogs su gzhag go /gsum pa nang du bya ba'i cho ga ni/ slob ma'i mgo bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi ngas khyod la rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya'o// ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/

dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams la brjod par ma byed cig dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes phan yon gyi sgo nas dang*/ yang spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste// gal te la lar khyod 'di smra// khyod kyi spyi bo 'gas par byed// ces nyes dmigs kyi dang*/ snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid ni// khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// zhes gnyis ka'i dang*/ thod par gnas pa'i bdud rtsi lnga'i chu la snying po lan gcig gis bsngags la/ oṃ badz+rod kaṃ zhes sam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes dang*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ste// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thungs shig /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya ni// dkyil 'khor med la gal te smra// skye bo'i tshogs nang gnas na ni// ma dad bzhad gad kyis ma yin// zhes mna' chu'i sgo nas dang*/ yang spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng tshun chod khyod kyi mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho nga yin gyis/ ngas 'di gyis shig ces bsgo ba khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig ya nga ba ma spangs par tshe'i dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes slob dpon gyi bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas te/ sngon 'gro dam la bzhag pa bzhi'o// de nas slob mas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho bdag la dbab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod la/ slob ma me'i he ru ka phyag bcu gnyis pa g.yas brkyang gis gnas pa'i spyi bo'i nang du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa'i dbus su zla ba la ha dkar po/ snying gar laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa'i dbus su nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po/

sum mdor raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum raṃ gyis mtshan pa'i dbus su nyi ma la āḥs mtshan pa/ rkang pa'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gnyis kyis mtshan pa/ rkang mthil gnyis kyi 'og tu dzhaiṃ dmar po drag cing bzod par dka' ba bsam/ de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros rlung gi ba dan la phog cing g.yos pas dzhaiṃ me 'bar rkang mthil nas zhugs sum mdo'i me dang 'dres pas cher 'bar/ de'i nus pas snying ga'i sa bsregs pas drod dang de'i rkyen gyis/ spyi bo'i chu'i dkyil 'khor las bdud rtsi'i tshogs 'dzag pas bde bas tshim par bsgom zhing*/ 'og gi rlung gis kyang bar snang la 'degs bzhin par bsams te/ slob mas/ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste// mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho zhes byar grags// ye shes rdo rje bla med pa// de ring bdag la dbab tu gsol// zhes yang yang brjod pas/ slob dpon gyis thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad 'khor lo bcu gnyis kyi lha'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ slob ma'i lus kyi bu ga thams cad nas zhugs pas byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ lus kyis rdo rje dril bu drag tu dkrol/ ngag tu yab yum gyi snying po dang*/ nye snying gi rjes la/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī badz+ra ā be sha ya staṃ bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsa la ya tsa la ya/ hūm̐ haḥ.aḥdzhaiṃ zhes bcu nas brgya'i bar du brjod/ las kyi rdo rjes rol mo drag tu bya zhing*/ ro ras dang zla mtshan bsgos pa'i 'doms dkris kyi ras dang*/ bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ ro'i kha nas byung ba'i gu gul rnams zhib tu btags pa thod par ro sol gyi me la bsregs pas bdug la dbab bo// gal te ma phebs na slob ma'i snying zla ba kha sbyor gyi dbus su mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho yab yum yungs kar gyi tshad tsam bsam/

de'i snying gar āḥdamar po bsams la yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas snying ga'i āḥyig bskul/ de las bde ba'i rang bzhin 'od zer dmar po 'phros lus kyi nang thams cad 'od kyis khyab pas sems la bde ba skyes par bsams la/ āḥ.āḥzhes bcu nas brgya'i bar rol mo dang bcas pas brjod na 'bab par 'gyur ro// babs na/ sku babs na nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang rdo rje'i gar byed pa/ gsung babs na tshigs bcad smra ba/ thugs babs na dus gsum gyi shes bya shes pa sogs 'byung la/ ci ste dgod na smra 'dod pa yin pas/ slob ma dum skyes mar dmigs pa'i lce hrīḥlas skyes pa'i pad+ma dmar po/ de'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i āḥdamar po 'od 'bar bar bsgoms la/ snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis lce steng gi āḥbaskul bar bsams te/ bru hi badz+ra zhes brjod na/ dge ba dang mi dge ba thams cad lung ston par 'gyur ro// de nas spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dṛḍho me bha wa/ shā shwa to me bha wa/ hṛ da ya mi a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shre yaḥku ru hūm̐ ha ha ha ha hoḥ zhes yig brgya phyed pa bzlas la brtan par bya'o// de nas slob dpon rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas shar sgor 'dug la/ dkyil 'khor 'di ru yang dag par// bdag gis slob ma bcug pa la// ji lta'i bsod nams de bzhin shog /lha rnams kyi ni rigs kyi rim// gang gi rigs kyi snod yin pa// gang 'drar 'di yi dngos grub 'gyur// gang 'dra'i bsod nams rjes mthun pa'i// de 'dra'i dkyil 'khor 'dir gyur cig /ces slob ma 'jug par gsol ba btab nas/ slob ma gdong ras dang bcas pas/ dkyil 'khor la phyogs pa la/ kye khyod kyi mig lam na ji ltar snang*/ zhes dris pas/ dkar ser dmar ljang nag por snang na rim pa bzhin/ zhi rgyas dbang las sna tshogs drag po rnams 'grub par go bar byas nas/

slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor 'dug pa la/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun du 'byung*// bden pa 'di yis dkyil 'khor du// gzugs brnyan lta bur slob ma ni// gsal zhing sdig med mthong bar shog /ces bden pa'i stobs brjod nas/ sngar bzung ba'i me tog gi phreng ba las yang zhing ma rnyings pa'i me tog gcig bton nas slob ma'i lag pa thal mo sbyar bar byin la gus pa dang bcas pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang du rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas zhugs nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i dbu la me tog phul bar bsams la/ yig brgya phyed pa dang*/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥzhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor la me tog ltos pa med par dor ro// de'i tshe lha'i mdzod spu'am/ dbu'am/ gtsug tor la babs na mchog gi dngos grub/ spyan nam zhal la sngags kyi dngos grub/ sku stod la dngos grub chen po/ bar gyi cha la 'bring po/ smad kyi cha la tha ma/ sku la nye na dngos grub myur/ ring na ring*/ lha gnyis kyi bar du lhung na gang la nye ba de'i rigs/ mnyam na gang la mos pa de'i rigs yin/ rtsig pa phyi ma'i steng man chad rdo rje rwa ba'i nang yan chad du lhung na dngos grub phra mo/ gal te rdo rje rwa ba'i phyir lhung na lan gsum du bskyar te dor/ des kyang phyir lhung na/ re zhig dngos grub kyi skal ba med pas/ bsag sbyang gi lam bstan la sdig pa dag pa'i tshe dkyil 'khor du 'jug par bshad do// de nas slob dpon gyis oṃ pra bi sh+ya ku laṃ ma hā ba laṃ/ zhes pas phreng ba blangs te/ slob ma'i mgo bor bcing ba ni me tog phreng ba'i dbang ngo*// slob ma'i mig gnyis su zla ba la oṃ/ snying gar zla ba la hūm̐ bsgoms nas/ de rnams kyi 'od zer gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa bkug ste/

slob ma'i mig gnyis la bstims pas lha'i spyan dang dbyer med par bsams/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā kār+ṇa bā swa yan+te d+ya/ tsak+ṣu rud+gha ṭa na ta ta pa ra/ ut+gaha ṭa ya ti sarba k+ṣo/ badz+ra tsak+ṣu ra nut+ta ra zhes sam/ de nyid bod skad du byas na/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho deng khyod kyis// mig 'byed par ni sogs brjod do// de nas kye rdo rje ltos shig ces pas dkyil 'khor bltar bcug la/ da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed// dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab// sangs rgyas rnams kyi rigs su skyes// mthong bas dngos grub thams cad 'ong*// phun sum tshogs pa mngon du 'gyur// dam tshig bsrungs la dngos grub ste// khyod kyis sngags rnams la brtson bya// ci ltar bsod nams dag stobs las// dkyil 'khor mthong ba de nas ni// sna tshogs 'od zer 'phro ba yis// dkyil 'khor mthong ba the tshom med// ces brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag gi mngon rtogs rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa bshad la/ lha ngo bstan/ bye brag tu me tog phog pa'i lha 'di yin no zhes bsgo bar bya'o// de nas/ gang zhig shrī gang bla med de'i// ru nyid kyang ni med pa yin// brjod dngos med las de rnams kun// dpal he ru ka zhes byar dran// rdo rje ye shes dbyer med phyir// rtag tu sdig pa las sgrib dang*// 'dod chags dman pa'i sbyor ba gang*// rdo rje sngo bsangs can phag mo// mchog tu 'gro ba'i ngang tshul phyir// mkha' 'gro ma zhes rab tu grags// de'i rigs lnga po'ang de 'dra'o// gang zhig rtag tu bdug za bas// lā mā zhes byar de bzhin dran// de'i rigs lnga po'ang de dang 'dra// de bzhin shes bya gzhan gnyis kyi'ang*// dum bur byed cing bskyed pas kyang*// dum skyes ma zhes bya bar brjod// sna tshogs pa yi gzugs 'dzin phyir// gzugs can ma zhes rab tu bshad// gzhan yang gtso bo'i rnam dag pa// bdun cu rtsa gnyis phyag rnams ni// bdud dag par ni rnam par brjod// phyag bzhi dgod pa la sogs pa// bzhi po rnams ni dag par 'dod// zhal rnams dag pa'i dngos po ni// lhan skyes rdzogs byang chub bcu drug

/bcu bdun pa'i zhal yid du bshad// srid dang mya ngan 'das zhabs gnyis// thams cad rgyan gyi dag pa ni// chos dang chos pa'i skye gnas so// lhag ma lha rnams thams cad kyi// so sor brjod par mi nus pas// 'khor lo bcu gnyis dag par yang*// gnas bcu gnyis dang sa bcu gnyis// rdo rje 'chang ba sgor gnas rnams// de rnams dag pa'i ngo bo yin// ye shes chos dang longs spyod rdzogs// sprul pa dag pas dkyil 'khor bzhi// yid kyi dkyil 'khor mchog yin pa// gang phyir dkyil 'khor yang dag bshad// ye shes chos dang longs spyod rdzogs// kun nas kun tu mnyam pa'i phyir// zlum pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum yin no// sprul pa kun du 'phrul rgyas pas// dkyil 'khor bzhi pa gru bzhi pa// yang na mtha' bzhi gcod phyir ro// rlung gnyis dbu mar 'dus pa la// sku gsum dang ni dga' ba bzhi// ye shes lnga rnams dag pa ni// dkyil 'khor bzhi rtsig la rim sbyar// bzhi po kun gyi thun mong gi /rnam dag rgyas par gsungs bshad bya// byin gyis brlabs pa'i thig yin phyir// mnyam pa'i tshad med pa las so// tshul khrims sdom pa bla med pa// rgyan gang yin par yang dag bshad// dad pa'i dbang po sogs can sems// rtsig pa lnga ru byung ba yin// rnam par thar pa rnam pa bzhi// gang gi sgor ni yang dag bshad// yang dag rab tu spang ba bzhi// rta babs kyang ni ka bar byung*// dran pa'i ye shes bzhi rnams ni// kha khyer bzhi ru dran par bya// rdzu 'phrul gyi ni rkang pa bzhi// sgo khyud rnam pa bzhi yin no// byang chub yan lag bdun phreng ba// ba dan me tog phreng bar brjod// rnam kun mkhyen nyid ye shes ni// ting 'dzin gnyis su btags pa yin// lam gyi ye shes khyad par ni// rnga yab du ni brjod pa'o// nyon mongs thams cad zad byed pas// de bzhin drwa ba zhes brjod do// yang dag gcod pa'i rab 'phrog pa// tshogs gnyis kyi ni sbyor ba ste// nyon mongs rnams kyi phyed 'phrog phyir// drwa ba phyed pa zhes brjod do// sangs rgyas kun gyi nyams chen rnams// dus thams cad du ka bar byung*// 'phags pa'i lam gyi yan lag brgyad// ka ba brgyad ces bya bar dran// de yi dbus kyi pad+ma gang*// skyon gyis ma gos par ston to// 'khor lo bcu gnyis bshad pa rnams// sa yi mi mthun phyogs spangs pa'o// yang dag bshad pa'i rtsibs 'di rnams// nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs sel// rdo rje la sogs phreng ba gang*// glo bur ba yi dri ma sel// cha shas bcu drug rnams kyi bar// dur khrod dag pa shes par bya// dkyil 'khor dag pa thams cad kyang*// mdor bsdus ston pa po yin no// rnam dag gsal dang mi gsal ba'o// sangs rgyas yon tan de dag kun// dkyil 'khor du ni brjod pa yin// sems can kun don brtson rnams kyis// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi de nyid bstan// zhes brjod la don bshad de/

dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing bstan pa'i cho ga'o// gnyis pa dbang bskur ba la gsum ste/ rdo rje slob mar dbang bskur ba/ slob dpon du dbang bskur ba/ rjes gnang sbyin pa'i cho ga'o// dang po ni slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul la/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur nas// 'gro ba skyob phyir gzi brjid can// ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas stsal// de bzhin bdag la deng stsol cig /ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab la/ dbang rdzas bum pa dang slob ma gnyis ka bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du slob ma dang bum pa'i chu rnams hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las nam mkha'i he ru ka sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa yum dang bcas par bskyed/ de dag gi dpral bar oṃ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūm̐ bsam/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas spyan drangs te/ gnyis ka la bstim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod/ de nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes bum chus dbang rdzas la dbang bskur sku thams cad gang chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas dbang rdzas kyi lha yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba'i bum pa'i chur gyur par bsams la/ bum pa gzhan gyi chu rnam rgyal du bsdu/ de nas bla ma'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas mi bskyod pa yab yum gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs la/ slob mas/ rdo rje can gyis 'gro bskyab phyir// sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur ba// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal// de bzhin bdag la'ang stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/

sems ma rnams kyis glu len/ khro bo khro mo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ rigs ma rnams kyis bum pa dkar po byang chub kyi sems kyi gang bas dbang bskur bar bsams la/ dngos su las kyi rdo rjes rnam rgyal bum pa bteg ste/ slob ma'i phyogs su cung zad yo bar bzung*/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas slob ma la me tog gtor zhing*/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// zhes sogs bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyis rnam rgyal bum pa blangs te/ slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po yi// khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa/ zhes brjod cing*/ rdo rje khu tshur gyis bum pa'i chu blangs la/ slob ma'i spyi bor blugs shing dbang bskur/ 'thung zhing khrus byas pas sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag par bsam/ yang ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes chu'i dbang bskur/ chu'i lhag ma yar 'khyil pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ de'i tshe mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang gi lha rnams slob ma'i ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas zhugs nas lus thams cad la thim par bsgoms la/ sngar ltar mchod/ de ltar na mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas chu'i dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang dag dri ma dang bcas pa'i de bzhin nyid gnas gyur pa'i chos kyi dbyings shin tu rnam par dag pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa dang*/ de'i rigs kyi lha dang*/ de la brten pa'i dngos grub dang*/ phrin las sgrub pa la dbang bar byas/ zhes rtogs pa bskyed de chu'i dbang ngo*// de nas dbu rgyan dang slob ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang*/ nyi ma'i steng du ām̐ las rin po che ām̐ gis mtshan pa de las sa'i he ru ka zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa yum dang bcas par bskyed la gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/

ye shes pa gzhug dbang rdzas la dbang bskur ba sogs sngar ltar bya/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i cod paṇa du bltas la/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis spyan drangs pa'i rin chen 'byung ldan gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang gi lha rnams la/ rin chen can gyis 'gro bskyab phyir// zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas rig ma rnams kyis rin po che'i cod paṇa gyis dbang bskur bar bsam zhing*/ dngos su slob dpon gyis gser la sogs pa las byas pa'i cod paṇa slob ma'i mgo la bzhag la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal srid che// dbu rgyan rin chen dam pa ste// rin chen kun gyi mchog byed pas// rdzogs sangs rgyas su dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye sogs dang*/ a bhi ṣiñtsa zhes brjod/ yang oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur zhing*/ chu'i lhag ma yar 'khyil pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par bsams la/ dbang gi lha rnams bstim/ mchod pas mchod/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sgo nas cod paṇa gyi dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa nga rgyal dag ser sna'i dri ma sbyangs/ nyon mongs pa can gyi yid gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan dang*/ de'i rigs kyi lha dang*/ de la brten pa'i dngos grub dang*/ phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so// zhes brjod de/ cod paṇa gyi dbang ngo*// de nas rdo rje dang slob ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du/ dz+rīṃ las pad+ma dz+rīṃ gis mtshan pa de las me'i he ru ka zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa yab yum du bskyed la/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa gzhug dbang rdzas la dbang bskur ba sogs bya/ zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rjer bltas la/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis spyan drangs pa'i 'od dpag med gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang gi lha rnams la/

pad+ma can gyis 'gro bskyab phyir// zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab la/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i dbang bskur bar bsam zhing*/ slob dpon gyis slob ma'i gnas gsum du reg la lag pa g.yas par gtad la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// dngos grub phyir na rdo rje longs// badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa/ zhes dbang bskur/ yang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pad+ma a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes chu dbang bskur te/ chu'i lhag ma yar 'khyil pa las/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par bsams la/ dbang gi lha rnams bstims la mchod/ 'od dpag med kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba thob/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags sbyangs/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag med dang*/ de'i rigs kyi lha dang*/ de la brten pa'i dngos grub dang phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so// zhes brjod de rdo rje'i dbang ngo*// de nas dril bu dang slob ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du khaṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje khaṃ gis mtshan pa de las rlung gi he ru ka zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa yab yum du bskyed la/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa gzhug dbang rdzas la dbang bskur ba sogs bya/ thugs ka'i sa bon 'od kyis spyan drangs pa'i don yod grub pa gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang gi lha rnams la/ sna tshogs can gyis 'gro bskyab phyir// zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ rig ma rnams kyis dril bu'i dbang bskur bar bsam zhing*/ dngos su slob ma'i lag pa g.yon par dril bu gtad la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dril bu'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas nyid du rab bsgrub phyir// dril bu 'di ni khyod kyis longs// zhes brjod/ slob mas rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i lag pa gnyis pad skor sngon du 'gro bas/

'khyud pa'i tshul byed du gzhug ste/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsā mi/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes bdag po'i dbang sbyin/ yang*/ karma a bhi ṣe ka ta sogs kyis chu dbang bskur/ chu'i lhag ma yar 'khyil pa las don yod grub pas dbur brgyan par bsam/ de la dbang gi lha rnams bstims la mchod/ don yod grub pa'i sgo nas dril bu'i dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa phrag dog sbyangs/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes gnas gyur pas bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don yod grub pa dang*/ de'i rigs kyi lha dang*/ de la brtan pa'i dngos grub dang*/ phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so// zhes brjod de dril bu'i dbang ngo*// de nas ming dbang la dbang rdzas med pas/ slob ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa de las chu'i he ru ka zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa yab yum du bskyed la/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa gzhug thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis spyan drangs pa'i rnam par snang mdzad gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang gi lha rnams la/ 'khor lo can gyis 'gro bskyab phyir// zhes pa'i tshigs su bcad pas gsol ba gdab/ de nas rig ma rnams kyis dbang bskur bar bsam zhing*/ dngos su slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang dril bu mnyam par bzung ba slob ma'i mgo bor bzhag cing*/ rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas// rtag pa'i rdo rje rab zhugs te// mi shigs rdo rje'i ming ldan pas// bu khyod de ring dbang bskur ro// oṃ badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsā mi badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye zhes bos la che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// zhes sogs me tog gang la phog pa'i rigs dang rjes su 'brel pa'i ming gis dbang bskur te/ de'ang gtso bo la phog na/ mi bskyod rdo rje dang*/ zhe sdang rdo rje sogs btags/

yum la phog na gsung gi rdo rje/ pad+ma'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang*/ sa'i 'khor lo la phog na/ rin chen dang*/ ser sna rdo rje dang*/ rdo rje'i 'khor lo dang*/ nam mkha'i 'khor lo dang*/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams la phog na gtso bo bzhin du btags/ snying po dang*/ me dang*/ gsung gi 'khor lo'i lha rnams la phog na 'od dpag med dang 'dod chags rdo rjer btags/ yon tan dang*/ chu dang*/ sku 'khor rnams la phog na rnam snang rdo rje dang*/ gti mug rdo rje dang*/ rlung dang ye shes kyi 'khor lo dang*/ sgo mtshams ma rnams la phog na/ don yod rdo rje dang*/ phrag dog rdo rje sogs su btags la yang ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bud+dha a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes chu'i dbang bskur/ chu'i lhag ma yar 'khyil pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsams la/ dbang gi lha rnams bstims la mchod pas mchod/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas ming gi dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa gti mug sbyangs/ kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa gnas gyur pas me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ de'i rigs kyi lha dang*/ de la brten pa'i dngos grub dang*/ phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so// zhes brjod de ming gi dbang ngo*// dbang lnga po de dag gis ni spang bya ma rig pa lnga spangs shing gnyen po rig pa ye shes lnga bskyed par bsam/ thams cad du sangs rgyas spyan ma la sogs pa rig pa'i lha mos dbang bskur bar byed pa'i phyir/ rig pa'i dbang zhes bya ste/ dbang de thob pas bya spyod kyi rgyud man chad nyan pa dang 'chad pa dang*/ sngags bsgrub pa la dbang ba'i slob dpon du 'gyur ba yin no// zhes brjod de rig pa'i dbang lnga'o// de nas slob dpon la phyag dang yon phul la/ sngags kyi dbang bskur ye shes mchog /dngos grub ster ba bdag la stsol// zhes lan gsum brjod la/

slob dpon gtso bor gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ yi ge hūm̐ de'i mthar g.yas skor gyis gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po bkod/ de las sngags kyi phreng ba mar me las mar me chad pa'i tshul gyis bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'thon zhal gyi sgo nas byung ste/ slob ma'i rna ba g.yon pa nas zhugs/ slob ma bde mchog tu bsgoms pa'i snying ga'i hūm̐ gi mthar bris pa bzhin du byung bar mos pa gyis byas la/ slob mas thal mo sbyar bas me tog phreng ba bzung la gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po lan gsum gsum rjes su bzlas par bya'o// me tog de bla ma la drin lan gyi tshul du 'bul zhing*/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyis// bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod/ bla mas me tog de slob ma'i mgo bor bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod pas sngags bsgrub pa la dbang bar bsams te/ sngags kyi rjes gnang ngo*// de nas rdo rje dang slob ma stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje de las rgyu rdo rje 'chang dkar po yum med par bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa bstim/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur nas mi bskyod pas rgyas gdab/ zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rjer bltas la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs// phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan// zhes slob ma'i lag pa g.yas par sbyin/ des kyang lan gsum gsor zhing snying gar bzung la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ dha ra yā mi badz+ra satwa/ hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ yang oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa/ zhes slob ma la dbang bskur nas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsams te/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs so// dril bu dang slob ma stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i gdan la baṃ las rdo rje/

de las rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis ma/ rtsa zhal dmar/ g.yon ljang*/ rgyab dkar/ g.yas ser ba/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag bcu gnyis kyi dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ lhag ma rgyu'i he ru ka dang 'dra ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbur brgyan cing*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can du bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa bstim/ dril bus dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyi rgyas gdab/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dril bur bltas la/ de slob ma'i lag pa g.yon par gtad de/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed// ces brjod de/ slob mas oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥ.aḥzhes brjod cing dkrol/ chu'i dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ dril bu'i brtul zhugs 'di ni grags chung yang cho ga 'di gnyis dang ye shes zhabs lugs pa rnams bzhed pa mthun no// de nas/ gang gi lha yi dbang bskur ba'i// gang de'i dngos grub the tshom med// gang rnams lha ni mngon byas pa'i// las rnams 'bras bu 'grub par byed// ces pa ltar/ lha so so'i dngos grub dang phrin las bsgrub pa dang las tshogs mtha' dag bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so// zhes brjod do// gnyis pa rdo rje slob dpon du dbang bskur ba la bzhi las/ dang po bum pa'i dbang ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su khru do tsam spangs pa'i sar/ rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyed tsam gyi/ dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ shar dkar po la sogs pa'i phyogs mdog can/ dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ ge sar dang bcas pa'i phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la shar du 'khor lo/ lhor rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ral gri bris pa'i dbus su shing gdan zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bris pa bkod/

steng du bla re dang*/ g.yas su oṃ las gdugs dkar po dang*/ g.yon du hūm̐ las rgyal mtshan/ mtha' skor du mchod pa mang po bkod do// de nas slob mas phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul la/ thal mo sbyar te/ bdag ming rdo rje che ge mo// byang chub sems ni bsgom byed pa// slob dpon zhabs kyis chu skyes la// dbang bskur don du gsol ba 'debs// slob dpon go 'phang rmad byung ba// skal ba chen po bdag la stsol// dbang bskur rgyal ba rnams kyis ni// sangs rgyas byang chub rab bsgrub pa// gang gis bdag sems can kun gyi// rnyog pa med pa'i don bya'o// khyod legs brtul zhugs bka' drin gyis// sangs rgyas kun don don bya'o// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba 'debs pa'i slob ma dbang stegs kyi steng du bzhag slob dpon gtso bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas slob ma stong pa'i ngang las dbang stegs kyi khri'i steng du sna tshogs pad nyi la hūm̐ las rdo rje/ de las dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho zhal phyag rdzogs pa yab yum dang bcas par bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ go cha bgo phaiṃ gyis sngags rgyas ye shes pa bkug la bstim mo// de nas slob mas dbang bskur bar gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la phog pas/ de dag gi thugs rgyud bskul bar bsam zhing*/ sngar bsnyen pa gang la byas pa'i gsang sngags dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zlos bzhin pas/ dkyil 'khor la yungs kar gtor/ de'i mthus dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams dgyes bzhin du/ slob ma rdo rje 'chang gi rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ thugs ka nas dkyil 'khor pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros nas nam mkha'i khams khyab par byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad pa nas bkra shis brjod pa'i bar chu dbang ltar byas la/ rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa'i chu spyi bor bzhag cing*/

oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa a bhi ṣe ka twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsā mi sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi pa ti twe na dṛḍho me bha wa sid+dh+ya na maste bha ga wān ma hā badz+ra dha ra su ra ta s+t+waṃ a haṃ badz+ra satwa oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa/ zhes brjod/ de bzhin du g.yon skor gyi rim pas/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang dpa' bo so so'i sngags kyi rjes la/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa btags la dbang bskur ba ni chu dbang ngo*// slob ma mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor gyur pa'i mgo bor sangs rgyas thams cad kyis cod paṇa bcing bar bsams la/ sngar gyi tshigs bcad dang sngags kyi dbu rgyan dang*/ dar dpyangs dang bcas pa'i rdo rje'i phreng ba sbyin pa ni cod paṇa gyi dbang ngo*// de nas sngar gyi tshig gis khro bo'i rdo rje lag pa g.yas su sbyin la/ des kyang snying gar bzung la/ rtag tu 'dod chags las byung khro// rdo rje me yi phung po'i sku// 'bar ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor che// kun nas mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'o// zhes dang*/ hrīḥzhes brjod pas/ slob ma'i sems thugs rdo rjer gyur bar bsams pa ni rdo rje'i dbang dang*/ rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig lhan cig tu sbyin pa'o// yang sngar gyi tshigs bcad dang*/ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs kyis dril bu g.yon du sbyin/ des kyang dkrol zhing*/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de// nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med// nam mkha' dang ni mnyam sbyor ba// thams cad mchog nyid bsgrub par bya// ces dang*/ dhīḥzhes brjod/ yang*/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni// srid pa'i mchog tu byed par 'gyur// zhes de kho na nyid brjod pa ni dril bu'i dbang dang*/ dril bu gsung gi dam tshig lhan cig tu sbyin pa'o// slob ma'i spyi bor rdo rje dril bu bzung la/ sngar gyi tshig dang che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// zhes brjod pa ni ming gi dbang ngo*// de nas slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor gsal ba'i pang na rig ma rdo rje phag mor gyur pa'i nu ma sogs lus kyi gnas rnams phan tshun reg pas mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba skyes par bsams la/

rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pas 'khyud rgya byed du bcug la/ shin tu sla bas bde 'gyur dang*// sdug bsngal mang po zhi bya'i phyir// shin tu dam pa'i bde ba'i thabs// dam tshig 'di ni bde ba 'gugs// 'dod pa kun gyi longs spyod kyis// ji ltar 'dod pa bsten par bya// rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis// rang gzhan mchod pa nyid du bya// ji srid 'khor ba'i gnas 'dug pa// brtul phod mang por gyur pa yi// de srid sems can mnyam med don// mya ngan mi 'da' nus par gyis// gsung mchog dam tshig gi ni thabs// bsod nams byin rlabs kyis bsgrub pa// dngos grub kun dbang phyug grub pas// sems can don ni rtag par gyis// phyag rgya'i dam tshig mngon par bshad// yid kyi sku ni brtan pa'i phyir// gang gis thams cad sku bstan pa// de yi phyag rgya rab tu grags// zhes de kho na nyid brjod pas/ slob ma'i lus sku rdo rje bde stong gnyis su med pa'i lha'i sku sgyu ma lta bu zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa can du gnyis kas bsgoms pa ni phyag rgya'i dam tshig go /de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis bskul ba'i rdo rje 'chang gtso bor gyur pa'i nam mkha' khyab pa'i dbang gi lha rnams la/ bde gshegs kun gyis 'gro bskyab phyir// zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ sngar bzhin dbang bskur bar bsams la/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// zhes sogs dang*/ sngar slob ma'i dbang gi skabs ltar brjod cing*/ rnam par rgyal ba'i chus dbang bskur nas/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa la/ dbang gi lha rnams bstim/ de la mchod cing me tog gtor te/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing*/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po'i go 'phang thob par bsam mo// de nas slob ma dbang stegs nas babs nas sngar gyi gral du 'khod pa la/ de ltar khyod kyis dkyil 'khor bzhi las/

phyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ gtso bor lus kyi dri ma 'khrud/ lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa dang*/ dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis bsrung ba la dbang*/ sprul pa'i sku'i bag chags 'jog cing sku rdo rje mngon du 'gyur pa'i skal ba dang ldan par byas/ dpe zhing sa shin tu sbyangs pa dang 'dra'o// zhes brjod par bya'o// gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang ni/ bla ma la tshogs kyi mchod pa dang*/ rig ma dang maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ thal mo sbyar te/ skyob pa med pa'i skyob pa skyabs// 'khor lo sdom dpal bdag la skyobs// rgyu med par ni thugs rje che// mgon med mgon bdag bka' drin stsol// bdag nyid che khyod ci bzhin du// khyab bdag bdag kyang mdzad du gsol// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bdag bying 'di las bdag la skyobs// zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis ma dad pa spang ba'i phyir/ gdong g.yogs bcings nas/ bla ma mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang*/ rig ma rdo rje phag mor bsam/ yab yum gyi mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab/ lte ba dang snying ga sogs su sngags dgod pa nas snyoms par zhugs pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bya/ dga' ba'i sgra dang snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs zhal du zhugs nas bde ba chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bor zhu ste/ dngul chu'i rdog ma lta bu'i thig ler gyur pa rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor babs shing brtan par byas pa de/ rang gi mthe bong dang*/ srin lag gis slob ma'i lce thog tu sbyin par bsam zhing dngos su bdud rtsi ril bu sbrang rtsi'ang chang ngam bu ram sogs la sbyar ba lce la bzhag la/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba ni// sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya// oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes dang*/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sogs gzhan du bshad pa'i tshig gis kyang dbang bskur/

des kyang sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor mos te/ a ho ma hā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod cing myangs pas/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog 'gag gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skyes par bsams la/ gdong g.yogs bkrol/ de ltar na dkyil 'khor bzhi las bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob/ gtso bor ngag gi dri ma 'khrud/ lam srog rtsol gyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang*/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bstan pa la dbang*/ longs sku'i bag chags 'jog cing*/ gsung rdo rje mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba dang ldan par byas/ dpe zhing sa sbyangs pa la sa bon btab pa dang 'dra zhes brjod do// gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/ sngar gyi rig ma'am/ de las gzhan pa'i rig ma dang maṇ+ḍal phul la/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye// rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung*// mi phyed phyag rgya rab tu bsgrub// rdo rje rnal 'byor las byung ba// bdag nyid chen po khyod bzhin du// gtso bos bdag kyang mdzad du gsol// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba gdab/ phan tshun ngo tshas bcings nas ye shes ngos mi zin pas de dgag pa'i phyir gdong g.yogs bcing ngo*// de nas bla mas/ rgyal ba rnams dpang por byas la/ slob ma'i lag pa g.yas par rig ma'i lag pa g.yon pa gtad/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la skad chung ngus/ 'di ni khyod kyi gzungs ma mchog /brtan byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags// 'khor lo rim pa'i sbyor ba yis// bde ba yang dag myong bar gyis// thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas min// 'gro ba gsum po 'di yis dag /de phyir 'di dang mi 'bral zhing*// khyod kyis nam yang mi btang ngo*// 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rig ma'i brtul zhugs bla na med// rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed na// de la mchog gi dngos grub med// ces brjod// rig ma des kyang gos med par byas nas/

slob ma la/ bu khyod kyang ni 'dod dam ci// dri chen dri chu sogs za zhing*// sha khrag khu ba de bzhin du// de bzhin gzhan yang bud med gus// bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed pa// bu khyod smros shig ci bde bar// zhes dri bar bsam/ des kyang lan btab par mos te/ lha mo ci phyir bdag mi 'dod// khrag dang khu ba sogs za zhing*// bud med rnams la bdag gus bgyid// bha ga la yang 'o bgyid do// zhes brjod du bcug pas/ rig ma dga' ste thabs kyi gdong la blta zhing tsog pur 'dug pad+ma gsal bar bstan nas/ a ho bdag gi pad+ma 'di// sangs rgyas kun gyis byin brlabs pas// gang zhig cho ga bzhin bsten na// de yi mdun na bdag gnas so// ci ltar pad+ma'i dgos pa nyid// yang dag sangs rgyas mnyes byed sogs// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni// 'di nyid la ni yang dag zhugs// bhañdzaḥmok+ṣa hoḥzhes gsung zhing pang du byon par bsam/ de nas slob ma skad cig gis gtso bo dang rig ma phag mor bsam pa lha'i 'du shes/ mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ sngags rnams lus la dgod pa sgrub thabs bzhin rgyas par bya ba ni sngags kyi 'du shes/ thabs 'di la brten nas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du bya snyam pa chos kyi 'du shes te/ 'du shes gsum sngon du 'gro bas pad+ma'i rtsa bde ba mchog gi rten btsal nas snyoms par 'jug par bsams nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ rang dang bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa dang rig ma la sogs pa thams cad bkug ste lus la thim pas mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po ro gcig tu gyur par bsam/ de'i tshe yab yum rjes chags kyi mes gtsug tor gyi haṃ yig zhu ba'i thig le spyi gtsug nas dpral bar babs pas dga' ba/ mgrin pa nas snying ga'i bar babs pas mchog dga'/ gsang gnas kyi bar du babs pas khyad par gyi dga' ba/

rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mo'i bar du gang nas phyir ma 'phos pa cha bcu drug la chags pa dang chags bral zung du chud pa lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba ste/ de lta bu'i dga' ba bzhi ngo shes par byas la/ bde stong gi ngang la cung zad mnyam par 'jog tu gzhug ste/ gang de'am dga' ba'i gzugs kyis snying la bde ba byed pa de yang kun tu rtog pa tsam// gang yang chags bral rgyu yang de gnyis de yi de min srid pa'i rtse mo'i rgyu// ji srid rgyal ba yid la rnam par rtog pa 'phro ba spangs pa'i gzugs de srid// mya ngan las 'das gzhan na cung zad kyang ni yod min yul ni rnam par rtog pa'i bdag nyid bsam pa'o// zhes bshad pa ltar/ bde ba chen po rtog pa dang bral ba la yun ring du goms par bya'o// gal te bde ba nyams pa 'dra na hūm̐ zhes brjod cing*/ rlung gi sbyor bas gyen du drangs te/ lte bar dga' ba/ snying gar mchog dga'/ dpral bar khyad dga'/ gtsug tor tu lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba brtan par bsam/ ma nus na dal bus btang la/ pad+ma nas lces blangs te/ bde ba bsgom/ de'i tshe slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas mkha' 'gro ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa dkyil 'khor pa'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ slob ma'i snying la zhugs pas brtan g.yo mtha' dag bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du bsam mo// de nas gdong g.yogs bkrol/ ye shes kyi rten phyag rgya de gdan bzang po la bzhag la tshogs kyi yo byad dang*/ phyi nang gi mchod pa gtang rag tu phul nas/ de ltar na dkyil 'khor bzhi las khyod kyis kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ gtso bor yid kyi dri ma 'khrud/ 'dzin pa dang rjes su dran pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang bud med la mi smod pa la dbang*/ chos sku'i bag chags 'jog cing thugs rdo rje mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba dang ldan par byas/ dpe sa bon btab pa las myu gu 'khrungs pa dang 'dra'o zhes brjod do// bzhi pa dbang bzhi pa ni/

slob mas rin po che sna tshogs dang maṇ+ḍal phul la/ khyod zhabs pad+ma'i bka' drin gyis// gtso bos dbang bskur rnam gsum thob// de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*// bdag la bka' drin rab tu stsol// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab/ rnam rtog bkag sla ba'i phyir gdong g.yogs bcings la/ 'di skad brjod de/ khyod kyi shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi skabs su dga' ba bzhi pa lhan skyes kyi dga' ba brgyud la skyes pa'i dus su rnam rtog thams cad 'gag cing sems nyid bde ba chen po'i ngo bor shar ba de ni/ dbang gi ye shes sam mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes yin la/ des mtshon pa'i don gyi ye shes zung du 'jug pa dbang bzhi pa'i don tshig tsam gyi sgo nas bshad na/ dpal sam+bu ṭi las/ bdag dang gzhan du 'dzin spangs shing*// rang gi rig pa'i ye shes te// dngos dang dngos med bdag nyid mchog /mkha' mnyam stong pa rdul dang bral// 'dod chags chags bral 'dres pa ste// thabs dang shes rab shin tu 'dres// de nyid srog chags rnams kyi srog /de nyid mi 'gyur dam pa ste// de nyid kyis ni thams cad khyab// de 'dir sangs rgyas ye shes te// dpal ldan he ru ka zhes bya// zhes gsungs pa'i don/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi byed pa po ni rang gi sems ma gtogs pa gang yang med la/ sems kyi mtshan nyid kyang kun rdzob tu rig cing gsal ba tsam de nyid/ da lta dbang dus kyi bde ba'i mthus bde ba chen po'i ngo bor gsal ba yin la/ don dam par rang bzhin med pa/ nam mkha' lta bu spros pa thams cad dang bral ba nyid yin no// de lta bu'i bde ba dang stong pa de yang de nyid dang gzhan du brjod du med pas/ zung du 'jug pa'am dbang bzhi pa'i don yin la/ de lta bu'i chos gsum ldan de la sems can thams cad 'tsho bar byed pas srog dang*/ de nyid gzhan du mi 'gyur bas yi ge dam pa dang*/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad de las byung zhing*/

de'i rnam 'phrul yin pas dngos po kun la khyab ces bya ba yin zhing*/ de nyid la sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ gnyis su med pa dang*/ shrī he ru ka la sogs pa mtshan gyi rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgo nas gsungs pa rnams don gcig tu shes par bya'o// des na zab mo dbang bzhi pa'i don rtogs na chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs rtogs par 'gyur te/ ji skad du/ dngos gcig dngos po kun gyi ngo bo nyid// dngos kun dngos po gcig gi ngo bo nyid// gang gis dngos gcig de bzhin nyid mthong ba// de yis dngos kun de bzhin nyid du mthong*// zhes gsungs pas so// ji ltar rtogs pa'i tshul yang*/ sngags kyi theg pa 'dir/ thabs khyad par can/ dbang gsum pa la brten nas dpe'i ye shes dngos su skye la de nyid goms par byas pas don gyi ye shes dbang bzhi pa tshe 'di nyid la rtogs nas/ brtson 'grus can tshe 'di nyid la grol bar 'gyur ro// des na dpe'i ye shes de nyid bsgom pa la nan tan du byed dgos la/ de'i tshul yang rgyud sde rnams las/ ston tshul mi 'dra ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa gcig gsungs pa las/ rgyud 'dir/ shrī yig 'byung ba kun gyi don// phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid 'dod// 'di dag kun rdzob gzugs dang ni// 'gyur med bde ba'i mtha' can gang*// e waṃ la sogs gnyis med pa'ang*// shrī zhes bya ba'i yig des brjod// he yig snying ga nas kun du// he ru ka sogs rang 'khor 'gro// bsgom pa kun gyi 'byung gnas las// 'dzin pa la sogs rnam bskyed 'gyur// de ni rgyu stong bdag nyid de// rgyu yi bdag nyid mi rtog pa'o// rang bzhin chos bdag med pa nyid// de ni stong pa'i rnal 'byor gnas// bkod pa gang zag bdag med pa// rtog pa'i drwa ba chen po ni// ru yig rkyen gyi bdag nyid can// de dag bdag gis bkod bral ba'o// slar brjod ka ni ma lus pa'i// bdag gi gnyis char med shes gang*// gang phyir ci la'ang mi gnas pa// de phyir ka zhes bya bar brjod// ces gsungs pa'i don/

lus mnyam gzhag gi spyod lam dang ldan pas/ ngag rlung rgyu ba rang sor gzhag sems dug gsum gyi rnam rtog thams cad spangs te/ rang gi sems bde chen du skyes pa dang de'i ngo bo rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i stong pa nyid dbyer med du shes par byas la/ chu la chu bzhag pa ltar dbyer med du mnyam par bzhag pas/ de kho na nyid kyi don rim gyis rtogs par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod pas bsgom du bcug go /de nas gdong g.yogs bkrol la/ de ltar khyod kyis don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa tshig tsam gyi sgo nas thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa 'khrud/ lam ting nge 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang*/ dgongs te gsungs pa'i dam tshig bzhi bsrung ba la dbang*/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i bag chags 'jog cing ye shes rdo rje mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba dang ldan par byas/ dpe myu gu sngon po las lo tog phun sum tshogs pa grub pa dang 'dra'o// zhes brjod do// de ltar dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pas rgyud kyi don mtha' dag nyams su len pa dang*/ gzhan la 'chad pa la dbang thob pas sems can dpag tu med pa'i don gyi shig ces brjod la/ rdo rje dril bu byin te/ deng nas brtsams te rnal 'byor pas// rgyud kun las ni gsung rnams kyi// ma lus lus pa med pa yi// cho ga yis ni dkyil 'khor bri// ji ltar mngon par 'dod pa'i lha// rang gi 'dod pas 'jug pa nyid// rnal 'byor dmigs pa'i dngos grub ni// tha ma dang ni mchog dang 'bring*// phra mo yi ni las la sogs// ji ltar de rnams sgrub par byed// rang gzhan bshad pa'i dngos grub phyir// de yis 'grub par the tshom med// ces brjod la/ sngar ltar mchod cing rab tu gnas pa byas pas slob dpon du gyur par bsam mo// gsum pa rjes gnang gi cho ga ni/ rjes gnang dngos dang mtha' rten sbyin pa'o// dang po ni/
