de ltar dbang thob pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'dod yon gyi bde bas mnyes par byed dgos pas/ mchod pa'i rjes gnang sbyin te/ slob ma gzugs rdo rje mar bsgom du bcug la/ gzugs brnyan rnam par chos thams cad// srid mtshor de rnams lhag rtogs pas// chos thams cad ni zhes bya ba// gzugs brnyan lta bur dbab byas la// sems can kun la bstan par gyis// zhes dang*/ sgra rdo rje mar bsams la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// sgra yi rjes su 'gro ba yi// shes rab mngon du rtogs gyur cig /gang gis 'jig rten thams cad du// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// kun du sgra brnyan lta bu yi// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// dri rdo rje mar bsams la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// skye med lhag par rtogs gyur cig /gang gis sangs rgyas zhing kun dang*// 'jig rten kun du bla med pa'i// bsam gyis mi khyab pa yi dri// rang gi lus las spro bar byos// ro rdo rje mar bsams la/ ro kun gcig gi rnam par ni// rang bzhin med pa'i gzugs kyis su// lhag pa ru ni rtogs gyur cig /gang gis sangs rgyas byang sems dang*// srog chags gyur pa thams cad la// lha rdzas dpe med ro yi mchog /sprul nas su ni sbyin par byos// reg rdo rje ma'i nga rgyal gyis/ reg byas rjes su mi gos par// de ni lhag par rtogs gyur cig /gang gis reg bya'i khyad par rnams// rang gi sems las byung zhes par// lhag par mos byas sna tshogs pa'i// bla med reg bya'i khyad par rnams// rang gi sems ni yongs gyur las// lha thams cad du gnas rnams dang*// byang chub sems dpa' sogs kun la// kun sbyor reg bya'i bde ba ni// nges par sbyar bar bya ba yin// zhes brjod de/ lha mchod pa'i rjes gnang ngo*// de nas gser gyi thur ma la bcom ldan 'das kyi rtsa ba'i sngags kyis mngon par bsngags pas slob ma'i mig dbye ba'i tshul byas la/

oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i// rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal// ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten rab rib bsal bzhin du'o// zhes brjod cing slob ma'i mig la mig sman bsku ba'i tshul bya ste mig thur gyi rjes gnang ngo*// de nas āḥs bsngags pa'i me long bstan la/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// de ltar shes byas chos 'di ni// rang bzhin med pa rnyog med pa// sems can don ni mnyam med gyis// skyob pa rnams kyi rigs su skye// zhes pa me long dang po'i rjes gnang ngo*// de nas hoḥs bsngags pa'i mda' gzhu byin la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga yā mi zhes brjod/ slob mas kyang blangs la phyogs bzhi dang steng 'og tu 'phangs par bsams la/ a nu rā ga yā mi zhes brjod de/ mda' 'phangs pa'i rjes gnang ngo*// de nas/ badz+ra satwa a/ zhes pas me long rdo rje dang bcas pa bstan la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin nyid// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag po gang*// bu yi snying la gnas pa'o// zhes brjod de me long gnyis pa'i rjes gnang ngo*// slob ma'i mdun du hūm̐ gis chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ lag pa g.yon du āḥs dril bu dang*/ g.yas su shaṃ gis dung byin la/ deng nas brtsams te 'jig rten du// skyob pa rnams kyis 'khor rab bskor// chos kyi 'khor lo bla med pa// dri ma med pa kun tu longs// the tshom med pa'i sems kyis ni// 'di la blo ngan med par mdzod// chos kyi spyod pa'i tshul mchog ni// rang gi mnyam med rab tu ston// de ltar sangs rgyas rnams kyis ni// byas shes dgos pa byed ces brjod// de yi rdo rje 'chang kun gyis// thams cad du ni khyod bsrung 'gyur// zhes brjod de/

chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang ngo*// de nas dam tshig bsgrag par bya ste/ thabs dang shes rab sems kyis ni// mi bya ba ni ci yang med// rtag tu dogs med gyur byas nas// 'dod pa lnga la longs spyod bya// ji ltar ji ltar 'dul gyur pa// sems can de yi rang bzhin gyis// de lta de ltar sems can don// 'dod chags sogs pas dag par bya// rang bzhin dam tshig la sdang ba// dam tshig nyams pa'i skye bo de// 'bad pa yis ni gsad par bya// sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong ba la// sems can kun la phan don phyir// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor rab skyong ba// pha rol po yi sems rnams 'phrog /sdig pas gos par mi 'gyur ro// 'dod chags lta bu'i bde med pas// skye bo rnams la de rtag sbyin// sems can don du gzhan bud med// bsten pas bsod nams thob par 'gyur// sangs rgyas la sogs smod pa la// rin chen 'byung ldan rnal 'byor gyis// tshig ni rtsub mo la sogs pas// bla med dngos grub thob par 'gyur// 'od dpag med kyi rdzun ngag smra// don yod grub mchog ting 'dzin gyis// blo ldan rgyud gsung cho ga yis// dam tshig dag pa bsten par bya// zhes brjod de dam tshig gi rjes su gnang ba'o// de nas slob mas/ he ru ka dpal ye shes che// zhes sogs sam/ de tsam mi nus na/ kā ya wā ka sogs dang*/ yi ge nyi shu rtsa gnyis pas bstod cing phyag byas nas gral du 'khod pa la/ sems can kun la phan don du// sems can kun la thams cad du// ci ltar gdul bya sna tshogs pa// rdo rje'i 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// de bzhin gshegs kun rgyal ba rgyal// bdag po'i 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// zhes brjod de/ de bzhin du rigs gzhan bzhi la yang 'dod pa bsgyur te rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga'o// gnyis pa mtha' rten ni/ de nas grub na tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya bar bshad do// slob dpon langs te g.yon pas chos gos kyi grwa gnyis snying gar bzung g.yas mchog sbyin slob ma'i spyi bor brkyangs la/

ngas 'dir khyod la lung bstan bya// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir// srid pa'i ngan 'gro las bton nas// kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa grub nas khyod kyi dam tshig go /ces brjod cing*/ gang gi cho ga 'di yis ni// phyag rgya chen po'i tshul gang gis// gang la lung bstan byed bzhin pa// dpal he ru ka sogs lha dang*// sangs rgyas byang chub sems rnams dang*// dkyil 'khor 'khor du gnas rnams kyis// dam tshig spyod pa'i mgrin pa yi// rdzogs pa'i byang chub bstan pa mdzad// 'di ltar 'di'i phyag rgya chen pos mchog tu gsang ba chen po bzang po bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis 'grub par 'gyur te 'di'i dam tshig gi zhes bya ba la dad par bya'o zhes brjod de lung bstan pa'i cho ga'o// de nas/ gsang mchog dkyil 'khor dam par ni// bltas nas su ni rab zhugs pas// sdig pa kun las rnam nges grol// de ring legs par gnas par gyur// bde chen theg pa 'di las ni// slar yang 'chi ba yod ma yin// mi tshugs pa dang mi chom par// 'jigs pa med pas rol par gyis// srid pa'i sdug bsngal las ni 'das// srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir// dngos grub dam tshig sdom pa ni// 'di ni rtag tu bsrung bar gyis// rjes gnang mchog tu dbugs 'byin pas// sangs rgyas kun dngos rab tu gsung*// rdo rje zhes gang phyag rgya dang*// byang chub sems ni mi spang zhing*// gang gis bskyed pa tsam gyis ni// sangs rgyas nyid du dogs med pa'o// dam pa'i chos ni spang mi bya// mi shes pa'am rmongs pa yis// gal te na ni spangs pa na// gang las de ni nges par sbyangs// rang gi bdag nyid mi spang zhing*// dka' thub kyis kyang brtsir mi bya// ji srid bde ba'i bde ba bzung*// 'di ni ma 'ongs rdzogs sangs rgyas// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// nam yang spang bar mi bya'o// slob dpon smad par mi bya ste// 'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// gang zhig slob dpon la smod pa// bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// sangs rgyas thams cad smad pas na// des ni rtag tu sdug bsngal 'thob// rims dang dug dang dbyig dug nad// mkha' 'gros 'tshe dang gdon rnams dang*// bgegs dang log 'dren drag rnams kyis// bsad nas dmyal bar ltung bar byed// de phyir kun nas rab 'bad pas// rdo rje slob dpon bla ma che// dge mchog rab tu mi spyoms pa// nam yang smad par mi bya'o// bla ma la gus de la yon// de la rjes mthun dbul bar bya// de yis rim sogs gdung ba rnams// phyir zhing 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro// rtag tu rang dam tshig spyod pa// sbyin min bu dang bu mo sogs// srog rnams kyis kyang bstan bya na// longs spyod g.yo ba smos ci dgos// gang phyir bskal pa bye rnams kyis// rtag tu rnyed par dka' ba yi// sangs rgyas nyid kyang brtson ldan la// tshe 'di nyid la ster bar byed// rtag tu rang gi dam tshig bsgrub// rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa mchod// rtag tu bla ma la yang dbul// 'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// de byin sangs rgyas thams cad la// rtag tu byin pa nyid du 'gyur// de yis bsod nams tshogs yin te// tshogs las dngos grub mchog tu 'gyur// de ring bdag skye 'bras bur bcas// gang 'dir legs par rab tu gnas// dam tshig lha rnams dang mnyam mo// rang byung du ni da lta skyes// deng 'dir dbang bskur tshe ldan pa// rdo rje bcas sangs rgyas kun gyi// khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che// rgyal po bdag pos gnas pa yin// de ring bdud las rgyal byas nas// grong khyer mchog tu rab tu zhugs// de ring sangs rgyas nyid thob par// khyod 'gyur ba ni the tshom med// ces bya ba yi bka' drin rdo rje yid kyis te// rang gi dam tshig mi bzad bde bskyed bsten par gyis// shin tu skye sla'i bde ba sangs rgyas kun gzugs can// rtag pa nyid ni mngon par rtogs par 'gyur bar shog

/ces brjod de dbugs dbyung ba'o// de nas bla ma la phyag byas la/ gtso bo ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// zhes brjod/ slob dpon gyis 'di de zhes sogs tshigs bcad dang sngags rkyang bas rdo rje dang dril bu'i brtul zhugs gnyis sbyin/ de nas slob ma'i lus rgyan gyis brgyan/ spos dang me tog sna tshogs thogs shing mgo bor gdugs bzung nas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba bya ste/ mnga' bdag sku mdog sngon po rgyal gyur cig /dmar pos ji ltar mdzes byas rgyal gyur cig /dam tshig gis brgyan mdzes pa rgyal gyur cig /zla phyed dbu la brgyan pa rgyal gyur cig /lha mo'i 'khor los brgyan pa rgyal gyur cig /dang po sangs rgyas sku mchog gnas pa rgyal gyur cig /'dod pa thar pa nor dang chos sbyin rgyal gyur cig /rnam par dgyes rol rang bzhin rgyal gyur cig /phyag rdor bde ba'i mgon po rgyal gyur cig /de nas shar sgo gdugs dang bcas pas phyag byas la/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pa'i// slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags// zhes brjod la gdugs bsal te/ shar sgor de nyid du 'dug pa la/ slob dpon langs nas 'di skad bsgo ste/ de ring dkyil 'khor slob dpon dang*// sngags dang rgyud ni 'dzin par 'gyur// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// lha rnams kyis kyang mthun par bzhed// sems can la rjes brtse don du// khyod kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga yi// 'bad pa yis ni bri bar bya// sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor// ser sna dogs pa thams cad la// sems can rnams la phan pa dang*// de la bu khyod kyis bya ste// rang nyid dga' ba chen spang ngo*// zhes brjod de/ gzengs bstod pa'i cho ga'o// dkyil chog 'dir gzengs bstod kyi cho ga 'og rdul tshon bsdus tshar nas 'byung yang bod dpe 'khrugs pa'am rgya dpe 'khrugs pa las bsgyur ba yin gyis skabs der byed pa la dgos pa med pas/

cho ga dgu brgya pa ltar 'dir byed pa dag pa yin no// slob mas ci 'byor pa'i yon dang gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul te/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyed la bdag nyid 'bul lags na// khyed kyis slob mar gzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// zhes brjod de/ dbang bskur ba'i cho ga 'khor dang bcas pa'o// gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga ni/ bla mas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya/ de nas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod rgyas par byas la dngos grub blangs/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo zhing*/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod pa'i rjes la/ gang yang skye bo'i dngos gyur dang*// ma rnyed rnal 'byor dbang phyir dang*// nye bar dgos pa ma tshang ba'am// dran pa rab tu rmongs byas pa// de thams cad la bzod par rigs// zhes nongs pa bzod par gsol/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas rdo rje dril bu dang spos 'dzin pas/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥ zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ dam tshig pa'i lha thams cad dgyes bzhin du bzhugs pa'i thugs ka'i 'od zer sems can thams cad la phog pas/ de rnams sdig pa dang bral bar byas te/ slar 'dus lha so so la thim pas lha'i sku shin tu gsal bar byas par bsam/ de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer gyi tshogs lcags kyu lta bu spros pas/ dam tshig gi lha'i 'khor lo thams cad rang gi lus la zhugs par bsams la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbarjod/ de nas/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs brjod cing chos rnams kyi chos nyid dran pa'i sgo nas lag pa g.yon pas dril bu dkrol/ g.yas pas rdo rjes shar sgo nas brtsams te/ tshangs thig gi lam nas gtso bo'i gnas kyi bar du bsub cing*/

rang gi spyi bor rdul tshon bag tsam bkod la/ de nas pad 'dab la sogs pa dbyi/ de nas sgo dang*/ zur la sogs pa rdo rje'i rtse mos bshig cing*/ rdul tshon rnams phyags la las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// de nas phur bu rnams/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bi gh+nān badz+ra dha ro dzñā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes dang*/ skam pa'i phyag rgyas phyung la/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa ni sarba a tha sā dha ni swā hā/ zhes bzlas pa'i 'o ma khung bur gtor bas bgegs kyi rma sos par bsams la/ phur bu'i ye shes pa gshegs nas gnas dben par gzhag go /de nas rdul tshon don du gnyer ba yod na cung zad sbyin zhing*/ gzhan rnams rdul tshon spyan drangs pa'i cho gas rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu bor dor ro// slar yang nang du log ste/ thig rnams rjes mi mngon par bsub cing*/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byas nas bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pas bdag dang slob ma rnams bkra shis par bya'o// sbyin bdag gam slob mas kyang*/ slob dpon la mu tig dang gser la sogs pa ci 'byor pa'i yon gyis mnyes par bya zhing*/ mtshan mo de nyid la rnal 'byor pho mo'i tshogs pa yod na/ cho ga bzhin bcos pa'i chang dang*/ bsad pa ma yin pa'i shas tshogs kyi 'khor lo tshul bzhin du bya'o// sang snga dro la bab pa na rdo rje 'dzin pa dge slong dang*/ dge tshul du gyur pa rnams spyan drangs te sha dang bral ba'i sdig pa med pa'i kha zas kyis dbang gi ston mo bya ste/ rnal 'byor pa la tshogs 'khor dang*// dge 'dun ston mo nangs par bya// zhes gsungs pa'i lung gis so// gang gi tshe rdul tshon dang las kyi rdo rje du ma med pa de'i tshe/ ras ris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba 'di dang cho ga dgu brgya pa gnyis su 'byung bas/ de ltar na zhag gsum du byas la/ zhag dang po la bdag bskyed kyi phung khams skye mched lhar bsgoms te/

pra kṛ tas nga rgyal bzung ba yan chad rdzogs par bya/ de nas sa'i lha mo sta gon byas la/ las kyi slob mas ras ris dang mnyam pa'i sa zlum por bskor/ der lha gnas mi 'chol ba'i thig dang zlum skor ci rigs par byas la/ der dri'i thig le dang*/ me tog gi tshom bu bkod cing mchod pa rnams rgyas par bsham mo// slob dpon gyis sa lha'i sta gon zin ma khad/ srung 'khor nas brtsams te/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin rgyas par bsgom/ de nas lha sta gon bya/ bum pa sta gon la/ rnam rgyal la lha yongs rdzogs dang*/ las bum du dum skyes ma bskyed/ bum pa gnyis las mi mdzad/ gtor ma 'bul ba dang*/ grub na sbyin sreg rnams byas la/ slob ma lha gnas bya ba nas slob ma la rmi lam dri ba'i bar rdzogs par bya'o// nyi ma gnyis pa la mdang sta gon byas pa'i sa gzhir ras bzang po dang rten khebs la sogs pas brgyan pa'i steng du lha'i sku rdzogs par bris pa'i ras ris kyi dkyil 'khor rab gnas can zhal shar du phyogs pa'i tshul du bkan te bzhag de'i mthar mchod pa bsham pa nas/ phyi rol du gtor ma sbyin pa dang*/ sbyin sreg sogs sgrub mchod 'khor dang bcas pa bya/ de nas mdang sta gon byas pa'i slob ma rnams la 'jug pa nas rdo rje slob ma'i dbang gi bar rdzogs par bskur la sdom pa bsdus te khas blang ba dang yon dbul ba rnams bya/ slob dpon gyis ras bris la mchod bstod nongs pa bzod par gsol ba rnams byas la/ ras ris kyi dkyil 'khor la ye shes pa rnams brtan bzhugs byas la/ go cha bgo ba dang*/ bsrung ba rnams bya'o// zhag gsum pa la sgrub mchod 'khor dang bcas pa yan chad sngar bzhin byas la/ slob ma rnams kyis/ slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul zhing*/ gsol ba btab la/ rgyun bshags dang*/ sdom pa gzung ba rnams lan gsum du byas la/ dbang stegs kyi steng du bzhag pa sogs nas/

yon dbul ba'i bar rdzogs par bskur/ slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor la brtan bzhugs bya ba sogs sngar bzhin rdzogs par bya'o// gal te rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du zhag mang por sgrub mchod byed na cho ga tshar gcig sngar bzhin yin la/ tshar gnyis pa la bdag bskyed kyi tshogs rten nam mkhar spyan drangs pa la mchod pa nas rgyun bshags kyi bar byas nas/ de nyid mi gshegs par nam mkhar bzhugs par bsam/ de nas cho ga lhag ma mtha' dag rdzogs par byas nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la/ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor de bsre ba sogs tshul bzhin du bya'o// 'di ni cho ga dgu brgya pa dang*/ gzhung 'di gnyis kyi dgongs pa ste/ cho ga gzhan la lugs 'di bsre bar mi bya'o// 'khor lo'i dbang phyug dpal ldan he ru ka /bcu phrag drug dang gnyis kyi lhag pa'i lha// bde stong sku bzhi'i dpal gyis rab rtsen pa'i// dkyil 'khor cho ga rgyal ba bzang pos bkral// de nyid bshad pa'i rgyud 'dir legs sbyar nas// bskal bzang slob ma dbang gis smin byed pa'i// dkyil 'khor cho ga la sogs gzhung phran bdun// mkhas mchog rgyal ba'i sde yis rnam par phye// dpag med snying rjes 'gro la brtse ba can// rgyal ba'i sras de gangs can 'dir byon nas// sum pa rga lo rgya dang rje btsun te// skal ldan bzhi la rgyud 'di'i dga' ston spel// 'dir ni thub pa'i rgyal tshab sa skya pa// grub pa'i dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis// lo paṇa gnyis las dbang gi chu bo dang*// rgyud 'grel phran bcas nod de snang bar byas// yang dag brgyud pa'i bla ma'i srol las 'ongs// 'khrul dag gzhung gi dgongs pa ci bzhin phye// ma dag cho ga'i lag len thag bsrings pa// rnam dag cho ga 'di bskrun ya mtshan to// 'dir 'bad dge ba rnam dkar chu 'dzin las// dge legs dbang bzhi'i char chen legs spros pas// bskal bzang 'gro ba'i yid kyi sa gzhi la// bsod nams phan bde'i lo tog rgyas gyur cig

/dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga yon tan rin po che'i mdzod ces bya ba 'di ni/ gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa la rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros rgyas shing sdom pa gsum tshul bzhin du nyams su len pa sde snod 'dzin pa chen po dkon mchog bzang po'i bkas bskul ba la brten nas/ rang dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son pa rje btsun dam pa mkhas pa'i dbang po ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dza ya se na'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du kun dga'i lo cho 'phrul chen po'i zla ba'i mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus nyi shu lnga la dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi dgon par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni byang bzang ldan pa rin chen grub ces pas bgyis so// //i daṃ shā sa nash+tsa sarba satwā hi to bha wan+tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
